 The application is automatically activated via defined on-call service events in your calendar and performs the following functions during the on-call duties:
 Triggering of an alarm on the receipt of an SMS from the operations center as well as acknowledgment via SMS after the confirmation of the alarm by the user.
 Monitoring of the phone signal level and notification in case of bad or off signal level.
 Automatically control of the ringtone volume based on your day and night profile.
 Logging of alert incidents with start and end time as well as all associated SMS messages.

 On-call event calender
 History of all alert incidents

fdroid:com.filestech.agenda_tech.name: Agenda Tech
fdroid:com.filestech.agenda_tech.summary: Private offline calendar: encrypted, zero network, encrypted backups.
fdroid:com.filestech.agenda_tech.description:
Agenda Tech is a calendar for Android that keeps everything on your device. No cloud, no account, no ads, no trackers. It declares no internet permission at all, so it is technically unable to send anything anywhere — and you can check that yourself in Android's app settings.
It exists so that your calendar never has to live anywhere but on your phone. A calendar says a lot about a person: their doctors, their lawyers, their job interviews, who they meet and when.
 Features 
 Four views — Month (swipe between months; dots, titles in the grid or one row per day, pinch to switch), Week, Day and Agenda list
 Events — all-day, description, per-event colour, postal address and GPS coordinates that open in your maps app (with no location permission); deleted by mistake? "Undo" brings it back
 Share — send an event as text or as an .ics file to the app of your choice
 Public holidays — those of nine European countries and the United States, worked out on the phone, off by default
 Recurring events (RFC 5545) — daily, weekly on chosen days, monthly (on a date, on the second Tuesday, the last Friday or the last day), yearly; ending after N occurrences or on a date; edit or delete a single occurrence
 Reminders — exact alarms, re-armed after a reboot, free delay, your own sound, and a snooze button on the notification, from 5 minutes to 1 hour as you choose
 Encrypted backup — export your whole calendar to a password-protected .atbak file (PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 at 600,000 iterations + AES-256-GCM). Keep it anywhere, cloud included: it stays unreadable without your password
 Search — by title, description, place, address or city; accents and case don't matter
 Import from your device calendar — copies what the phone's own calendar apps have already synced onto it, read-only, without any network
 .ics import / export (RFC 5545) through the system file picker
 Optional PIN and biometric lock
 Home-screen widgets, dark theme, in English, French, German, Italian, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese
 Privacy 
 No INTERNET permission. Not "we promise not to" — the app cannot
 Encrypted at rest: SQLCipher (AES-256), master key sealed by the Android KeyStore
 Screenshots blocked (FLAG_SECURE), excluded from Android cloud backups
 Apache 2.0 — every promise on this page is checkable line by line
 Limits, honestly 
 Not a sync. Importing copies what is on the phone; an event created here does not travel back to the original calendar. That is the price of zero network, and it is deliberate
 No CalDAV, no shared calendars, no invitations — all of it needs a network. You can send an event, not share a calendar
 The encrypted backup is the bridge between your devices, and it is a manual one

fdroid:com.inspiredandroid.kai.name: Kai 9000

Open-source AI chat app that builds interactive screens, not just text. Kai 9000 is a free ChatGPT alternative with a soul, a heartbeat, persistent memories, and reinforced learning — an AI assistant that evolves with every conversation you have.
Unlike ordinary chatbots, Kai 9000 generates native interactive UI — buttons, forms, tables, charts, and full-screen apps — right inside the chat. Ask it to build a calculator, a quiz, a dashboard, or a to-do list, and it renders a real working interface you can tap, swipe, and interact with. This is AI beyond text.
🧠 Soul & Memory — A Chatbot That Knows You
Give Kai 9000 a personality by writing its "soul." It remembers what matters across conversations — your preferences, past learnings, and known issues — and reinforces that knowledge over time. Memories that prove useful get promoted into its permanent personality. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.
💓 Heartbeat — Your Always-On Personal Agent
Kai 9000 doesn't sleep. Its heartbeat system checks in on a schedule — reviewing pending tasks, emails, and trends — even when you're not chatting. Set the interval, active hours, and model. When something needs your attention, Kai 9000 surfaces it. When everything's fine, it stays quiet.
⚡ 24 Services — One App, Every Model
Connect to ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek, Llama, Mistral, Grok, and 17 more providers. Run local models via Ollama or LM Studio for private, offline use. Add multiple accounts, reorder priorities, and let the smart fallback chain handle outages automatically. A built-in free tier means you can start chatting with zero setup — no API key needed.
Supported Services
• OpenAI (GPT-4o, GPT-4, o1, o3)
• Google Gemini (with file attachments)
• Anthropic Claude
• DeepSeek (R1 reasoning)
• xAI Grok
• Mistral, Groq, OpenRouter, NVIDIA
• Together, Hugging Face, Cerebras
• Deep Infra, Fireworks, Venice, MiniMax, Moonshot
• Ollama / LM Studio / any OpenAI-compatible API
• Built-in Free tier
🛠️ 40+ Tools — Beyond Chat
Enable powerful tools that let the assistant act, not just talk:
• Web Search — real-time answers from the internet
• Email — check, read, reply, compose, and search
• Shell Commands — execute terminal commands on your device
• Task Scheduling — set up recurring tasks with cron expressions
• Calendar Events — create events directly from chat
• Text-to-Speech — hear responses aloud with natural voice output
• Notifications — triggered push alerts
• Location & Time — context-aware responses
• MCP Servers — connect to external tool servers
🖥️ Interactive UI Mode
Go full-screen. In Interactive Mode, Kai 9000 becomes a visual app builder — no markdown, no scrolling text. Just tappable, functional screens generated on the fly. Navigate entirely through buttons and inputs. It's like having a personal app developer in your pocket.
🔒 Privacy-First, Open Source & Ad-Free
All chat history is encrypted and stored locally on your device. No ads, no data collection, no tracking. API calls go directly to your chosen provider — Kai 9000 never sits in the middle. Run local models for a fully offline, private experience. Fully open source, fully transparent.
🌍 Works Everywhere
Use Kai 9000 on your Android phone, tablet, Chromebook, or desktop. Your assistant, always within reach.
Whether you're writing, coding, summarizing, translating, brainstorming, automating workflows, managing emails, or studying — Kai 9000 is the free, ad-free, open-source ChatGPT alternative that adapts to you.

INTERFACE

flathub:io.github.cosmic_utils.camera.summary: Camera for photos, videos and QR codes
flathub:io.github.cosmic_utils.camera.description:
Camera is a modern camera application for Linux, built for desktops and phones alike. Whether
 you need to snap a quick photo, record a video, or scan a QR code, Camera provides a clean and
 intuitive interface that stays out of your way.
 Just open the app and start capturing moments. Add fun filters to your photos, scan QR codes
 to open links or connect to WiFi, or use virtual camera mode to look great in video calls with
 your favorite filter applied.
 Key features:
 Photo and video capture: high quality and hardware accelerated
 Photo, video and timelapse modes, with a self timer and composition guides
 Manual controls: exposure, ISO, shutter, focus and white balance
 QR code scanner: open links, connect to WiFi, and more
 14 creative filters: Mono, Sepia, Vivid, Noir, Pencil, and more
 Virtual camera: use your filtered camera feed in video calls and other apps
 Multi-camera support: easily switch between cameras and microphones

flathub:io.github.denysmb.unify.name: Unify
flathub:io.github.denysmb.unify.description:
Unify is a web app aggregator that brings all your favorite web applications (Spotify, YouTube, Gmail, WhatsApp Web, and more) into a single, desktop-native window.
 Organize your web apps into workspaces, switch between them instantly, and enjoy desktop features like native notifications, screen sharing, and media session tracking.
 Features:
 Run multiple web apps in one application window
 Organize services into customizable workspaces
 Native desktop notifications integration
 Screen sharing and webcam support
 DRM content playback (Spotify, Netflix, Prime Video with Widevine)
 Media session tracking with "Now Playing" indicator
 Favicon auto-detection for service icons
 Detachable windows for individual services
 Keyboard shortcuts support

flathub:io.github.tom94.tev.name: tev
flathub:io.github.tom94.tev.description:
High dynamic range (HDR) image viewer for people who care about colors. It is:
 Lightning fast: starts up instantly, loads hundreds of images in seconds.
 Accurate: understands HDR and color profiles (ICC, CICP, etc.). Displays HDR on all operating systems.
 Versatile: supports many file formats and their quirks: gain maps, aux channels, animation, and more metadata than just EXIF & XMP. Advanced pixel peeping: histograms, tonemaps, error metrics, etc. in any color space.

flathub:io.github.wiiznokes.fan-control.name: Fan Control
flathub:io.github.wiiznokes.fan-control.summary: Control your fans with different behaviors
flathub:io.github.wiiznokes.fan-control.description:
You can add items with the buttons on the right of the app.
 To save a configuration, write a name in the "Configuration name" field, and click on the +.
 To modify the value of a fan, you must select it in a Control item (the left column), select a
 Behavior, and activate the swtich.
 Display sensors data on real time
 Control fans based on custom behaviors
 Save configuration
 Note: After installation, you will need to add the necessary udev rule to your system for
 this to work. See the GitHub page for more details.

flathub:io.gitlab.elescoute.spacelaunch.name: Space Launch
flathub:io.gitlab.elescoute.spacelaunch.description:
With Space Launch you can keep track of upcoming launches.
 Data on the launches are provided by spacelaunchnow.me.
 Space Launch is currently in alpha release. Some crashes due to problems of communication with spacelaunchnow.me server can remain. More features will be added later.
 Compatible with GNOME Mobile (PinePhone, Librem 5).

flathub:org.freeorion.FreeOrion.name: FreeOrion
flathub:org.freeorion.FreeOrion.summary: Turn-based space empire and galactic conquest game
flathub:org.freeorion.FreeOrion.description:
FreeOrion is a free, Open Source, turn-based space empire and galactic conquest computer game.
 FreeOrion is inspired by the tradition of the Master of Orion games, but does not try to be
 a clone or remake of that series or any other game. It builds on the classic 4X (eXplore, eXpand,

flathub:org.gnumeric.Gnumeric.name: The Gnumeric Spreadsheet
flathub:org.gnumeric.Gnumeric.description:
Gnumeric is a spreadsheet application for interactive manipulation of data.
 Gnumeric aims to provide high-accuracy computations, expressive graphs, and a wide selection of statistical analysis tools. Gnumeric can share files with Microsoft Excel and programs supporting the ODS standard.

flathub:org.octave.Octave.name: GNU Octave
flathub:org.octave.Octave.description:
GNU Octave is a high-level interpreted language, primarily intended for
 numerical computations. It provides capabilities for the numerical
 solution of linear and nonlinear problems, and for performing other
 numerical experiments. It also provides extensive graphics capabilities
 for data visualization and manipulation. Octave is normally used through
 its interactive command line interface, but it can also be used to write
 non-interactive programs. The Octave language is quite similar to
 Matlab so that most programs are easily portable.
 Octave has extensive tools for solving common numerical linear algebra
 problems, finding the roots of nonlinear equations, integrating ordinary
 functions, manipulating polynomials, and integrating ordinary
 differential and differential-algebraic equations. It is easily
 extensible and customizable via user-defined functions written in
 Octave's own language, or using dynamically loaded modules written in
 C++, C, Fortran, or other languages.

fedora-packages:ghc-zip-archive/ghc-zip-.name: ghc-zip-archive
fedora-packages:ghc-zip-archive/ghc-zip-.summary: Library for creating and modifying zip archives
fedora-packages:ghc-zip-archive/ghc-zip-.description: The zip-archive library provides functions for creating, modifying, and extracting files from zip archives. The zip archive format is documented in <http://www.pkware.com/documents/casestudies/APPNOTE.TXT>. Certain simplifying assumptions are made about the zip archives: in particular, there is no support for strong encryption, zip files that span multiple disks, ZIP64, OS-specific file attributes, or compression methods other than Deflate. However, the library should be able to read the most common zip archives, and the archives it produces should be readable by all standard unzip programs. Archives are built and extracted in memory, so manipulating large zip files will consume a lot of memory. If you work with large zip files or need features not supported by this library, a better choice may be <http://hackage.haskell.org/package/zip zip>, which uses a memory-efficient streaming approach. However, zip can only read and write archives inside instances of MonadIO, so zip-archive is a better choice if you want to manipulate zip archives in "pure" contexts. As an example of the use of the library, a standalone zip archiver and extracter is provided in the source distribution.

firefox-addons:2891684.name: OriginStory: AI Country
firefox-addons:2891684.summary: Prioritize American-made! OriginStory uses AI to show product origins & champions US alternatives. Shop USA with transparency.
firefox-addons:2891684.description:
Curious about where your online purchases really come from? Join the movement! 🇺🇸
Install the FREE extension now to instantly discover product origins and support American-made goods.
--
Why is OriginStory version 2.0 SO MUCH BETTER? 🤖
OriginStory v2.0 is officially here with a massively upgraded engine, delivering 35% more accurate AI-driven country-of-origin detection and a streamlined, faster experience. Our proprietary AI now includes a new User-Country Input feature for even greater precision, plus a 5x larger U.S. product database and a vastly improved similar product search to help you shop smarter and support the makers you care about.
--
Here's What You Get
🛍️ Instant Origin Insights: As you browse supported shopping platforms, see exactly where a product is made—whether it’s proudly crafted in the USA or produced globally.
🔍 Unmatched Accuracy: Our AI is now 35% more precise in identifying manufacturing countries, enhanced by the new User-Country Input feature, letting you refine results for pinpoint accuracy. 
🇺🇸 Expanded U.S. Database: Explore 5 times more products in our U.S. database, making it easier to find and support American-made goods. 
🔎 Enhanced Similar Product Search: Our massively improved search function connects you with alternative products that align with your values, like locally made options. 
⚡ Faster, Sleeker Experience: A complete engine overhaul ensures OriginStory is quicker, more responsive, and seamlessly integrated into your shopping flow. 
🤝 Contribute to Accuracy: Spot an error? Update the origin with verified details to keep our community-driven data accurate for everyone. 
🇺🇸 Support Local Makers: Easily prioritize U.S.-made products to champion American workers and industries. 
🔒 Privacy First: We’re not Big Tech. We collect no data, operate fully anonymously, and never profit by selling information.
How to Get Started
⭐ Add to Your Browser: Install OriginStory on Chrome, Edge, Opera, Brave, or Firefox. 
📌 Pin It: Add it to your toolbar for one-click access. 
🛒 Browse as Usual: Click the "Find Product Origin" pop-up on the product pages as you shop.
✏️ Confirm or Update: Have the product? Confirm origins by clicking "Help Find Origin," to ensure data stays accurate for all users.
Transparency Matters
⭐ Affiliate Note: OriginStory is ad-supported and participates in affiliate programs. Qualifying purchases via affiliate links may earn us commissions—at no extra cost to you. 🇺🇸 Supporting Us: These earnings fuel ongoing updates, like the massive v2.0 overhaul. 🇺🇸 Full Disclosure: We’re transparent about our Amazon Affiliate ties—details are in the extension and shared before installation, compliant with all regulations.
Changelog
v2.0 Complete Engine Overhaul: Streamlined and faster performance across the board. 35% More Accurate AI: Improved country-of-origin detection with smarter algorithms. New User-Country Input: Add your insights to boost accuracy. 5x Larger U.S. Database: Massive expansion of U.S. product data. Massively Improved Similar Product Search: Find better alternatives with ease. Enhanced UI for a smoother, more intuitive experience.
v1.8 Removed Google Docs Affiliate Link Spreadsheet due to user feedback (no data collection, just listed similar USA-made products). Minor bug fixes.
v1.7 Fixed major bug ignoring on-screen text (e.g., "Made in USA") and defaulting to incorrect origins. Improved AI and database reliability.
v1.6 Added basic Walmart support. Improved on-screen widget for quick access.
v1.5 Updated branding and boosted AI call speed.
v1.4 Added extension image overlay on product pages for quick access. Fixed Firebase manufacturer data glitch.
v1.3 Fixed override bug causing incorrect country defaults for some brands. Improved similar product suggestion accuracy.
v1.2 Refined design for a sleeker look. Added ads for similar U.S.-made products.
v1.1 Fixed bugs for smoother performance. Removed unneeded permissions to enhance privacy. Improved detection for products with multiple variants.

firefox-addons:2856346.description:
Are you missing the comment section on Crunchyroll? Crunchy Comments is here to revive the community experience by restoring over 150,000 comments from Crunchyroll, giving anime fans the space to engage and reconnect. Our seamless, open-source comment section is powered by Comentario, bringing back the lively discussions you’ve missed.

firefox-addons:2732273.name: AutoJWT
firefox-addons:2732273.summary: Developer extension to automatically find, parse, and copy JWT authorization tokens
firefox-addons:2732273.description:
AutoJWT is a tool that aids in the development of websites and APIs that use JSON Web Tokens in their Authorization request headers. It installs as a new tab in Developer Tools. When open, it automatically searches for network requests that contain a JWT authorization header and lists unique examples. These examples can then be selected to:
View the JSON Web Token payload.
See a list of all requests that used the same token.
Open the JWT in a new tab on https://jwt.io .
Copy the JWT to the clipboard.
Copy the Payload to the clipboard.
View request and response contents.

firefox-addons:3015644.name: MochiTranslate - AI Image Translator for Manga, Co
firefox-addons:3015644.summary: AI manga, manhwa & manhua translator. English renders in the speech bubble. Japanese, Korean, Chinese. BYO Gemini key.
firefox-addons:3015644.description:
MochiTranslate - AI Manga, Comic & Webtoon Translator
MochiTranslate is an AI translator for manga, comics, webtoons, manhwa, manhua, doujinshi, and any image with foreign-language text.
Hover over any panel, click translate, and the translation is rendered back into the original speech bubble in your chosen language. No floating tooltip. No messy overlay. No pasting text over the artwork.
Read raw chapters without waiting for an official translation.
Standard translator extensions usually do not work on text inside images. Screenshot translators often cover the panel with translated text. MochiTranslate is built specifically for image-based reading.
Click the translate icon on any panel and the speech bubble is translated in seconds. MochiTranslate detects the text, sends the panel to your own Gemini API key, and renders the translated text back into the original bubble. Cached re-reads stay free.
Works Automatically On
MangaDex
Comick
 Bato.to 
AsuraScans
Webtoons
MangaPlus
Cubari
Tapas
Pixiv
You can also enable MochiTranslate on other manga, manhwa, manhua, comic, doujinshi, and webtoon sites with one click.
Why MochiTranslate?
Reading raw manga, manhwa, and manhua is hard when you cannot read the source language. Most translation tools are not built for image-based reading.
Standard translator extensions do not read text inside images
Screenshot translators paste text on top of the artwork
Batch translators process every panel, including ones you can already read
Floating tooltips cover the panel while you read
Copy-pasting image text is slow and awkward
MochiTranslate is different.
It uses a vision-capable AI model with per-bubble prompting to produce natural translations, then re-renders the translated text back into the original speech bubble in a style that fits the panel.
The result feels closer to reading a translated manga page, not looking at a machine translation overlay.
Spot Translation
MochiTranslate is built for the panel you cannot read, not the whole chapter you are already reading.
Translate only what you need.
Each translation uses your own Gemini API key and usually costs only a small amount per panel. Re-reading a translated panel uses your local cache, so cached translations do not need another API call.
Source and Target Languages
MochiTranslate can translate from common manga, comic, and webtoon source languages into your chosen target language.
Source examples include:
Japanese - manga, doujinshi, light novel covers, Pixiv captions, JRPG screenshots, and visual novel screenshots
Korean - manhwa, Korean webtoons, and screenshots
Chinese - manhua, simplified Chinese, traditional Chinese, and foreign-language image content
Target languages can include English, Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Indonesian, Thai, Vietnamese, and more, depending on Gemini support.
More language pairs may be improved over time based on demand.
Bring Your Own Gemini Key
MochiTranslate uses your own Gemini API key.
Paste your Gemini API key from Google AI Studio once
Translation requests go directly from your browser to Google’s Gemini API
Google bills your account directly for API usage
No MochiPanel markup
No MochiPanel proxy
No subscription from MochiPanel
Cached translations are stored locally in your browser
MochiPanel does not see, proxy, or store the panels you translate.
Built for Manga, Comics, and Webtoons
Most translator extensions are built for normal website text. MochiTranslate is built for image-based reading.
Features include:
AI translation for manga, comics, webtoons, manhwa, manhua, and doujinshi
Translate raw panels into your chosen language
Speech-bubble detection
Per-bubble translation
Translated text rendered back into the original bubble
Matching manga-style text rendering
Sound-effect translation alongside dialogue
Japanese, Korean, and Chinese source language support
Multi-language output support through Gemini
Tone-preserving translation prompts
On-device translation cache
Hover-to-translate on any image
Per-site enable and disable
Bring your own Gemini API key
Spot-translate workflow
Privacy-First
What you read is your business. MochiTranslate is designed to stay out of it.
No account required
No analytics
No tracking
No telemetry
Translation cache is stored locally in your browser
Translation requests go directly from your browser to Google’s Gemini API
MochiPanel never sees the panels you translate
License validation only happens after you enter a license key
Pricing
MochiTranslate - $19 lifetime
One payment. Lifetime license. Future updates included.
Your only ongoing cost is your own Gemini API usage, paid directly to Google. Cached re-reads do not require another API call.
No subscription. No account. Lifetime license.

bluejetty:00136001:ios.name: Peekaboo Barn for Baby/Toddler
bluejetty:00136001:ios.summary: Discover Peekaboo Baby & Toddler Books, an interactive app designed for babies and toddlers! Read baby books – the Farm, Forest, Sea, Kitchen, City, House, and People – full of surprising peekaboo situations filled with colorful animations
bluejetty:00136001:ios.description:
Discover Peekaboo Baby & Toddler Books, an interactive app designed for babies and toddlers! Read baby books – the Farm, Forest, Sea, Kitchen, City, House, and People – full of surprising peekaboo situations filled with colorful animations and enchanting sounds. Watch as your infant clicks on various elements, revealing hidden objects, people, and animals in this digital twist on traditional lift-the-flap baby & toddler books.
- Toddler Books Reinvented
Our app transforms traditional lift-the-flap baby into an interactive digital experience. Say goodbye to paper flaps and enjoy vibrant, animated peek a boo surprises in this app for babies and toddlers. What sets us apart? Every time your child opens a book, it's a new adventure! Different things are hidden, making it each time unique and exciting.
- Explore the Peekaboo Barn and More
Discover the wonders of the Peekaboo Barn, embark on an underwater adventure Under the Sea, and encounter adorable puppies, animals, people and objects. The books provide a diverse and engaging learning experience. More peekaboo books and babies games will be added soon!
- Hide and Seek for Early Learning
Encourage the love of baby sensory exploration and the joy of discovery with our Hide and Seek game for little childs, embracing the Montessori preschool philosophy. Let your little one interact with the screen, unveiling surprises and making connections between actions and reactions. Watch as they learn about the world around them through this delightful hide-and-seek experience.
- Interactive Baby Learning
Transform your child's screen time into a valuable learning experience. Our baby books app, inspired by Montessori preschool principles, combines the joy of hide and seek with learning, fostering cognitive development and enhancing sensory exploration and their understanding of the world.
- Bright, Colorful, and Educational
Captivate your child's attention with vibrant colors, lively animations, babies games and funny sounds. This app isn't just about peekaboo – it's a visual and auditory feast that promotes learning in a fun and interactive way.
- Apps for Babies – Engaging and Educational
Designed with a preschool approach and babies games in mind, our app is striking the perfect balance between entertainment and education. It's a safe and enriching app for your little one to explore. Explore without interruptions – our app works offline and without ads.
- Explore Various Peekaboo Baby Books:
The farm: Peek behind the tractor, in the barn, and more!
The forest: Discover tents, bushes, and hidden zoo friends.
The sea: Coral, fisherman, and seven sea surprises.
The kitchen: Teapot, cabinet, and sizzling pan delights.
People: Balloons, readers, and hat-hiding fun!
The city: Peek behind buildings, signs, and meet friends!
The house: Turn on the light, peek behind the curtains, and explore various rooms!
Currently the English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Danish, Norwegian, Italian, Chinese and Dutch language are supported (more languages are coming!)
Download our Peekaboo Baby & Toddler Books app today and embark on an educational journey of hide-and-seek that will bring joy to your little one's world. Enjoy the classic charm of lift-the-flap baby books, now reimagined as an app that blends tradition with technology. Peekaboo – where learning meets play!
For feedback contact support [at] wienelware.nl

bluejetty:00149481:ios.description:

Money is a game everyone's forced to play, but not everyone's been taught the rules. Short video lessons teach you the rules.

Busy people who know they should be investing and setting money aside, but don't have time to figure out how. The average Moola member is 45 and has a family. If that's you, you're home.

bluejetty:00022244:ios.summary:
SK-51 is Fingerlab's all-in-one emulation of the Casio SK-1 and SK-5 — an 8-bit lo-fi keyboard from the 80s with sampling features and onboard drum machine, available for iPhone, iPad & Mac.
Called the "poor man's sampler" in its time, this
bluejetty:00022244:ios.description:
SK-51 is Fingerlab's all-in-one emulation of the Casio SK-1 and SK-5 — an 8-bit lo-fi keyboard from the 80s with sampling features and onboard drum machine, available for iPhone, iPad & Mac.
Called the "poor man's sampler" in its time, this iconic Casio keyboard was used by Fatboy Slim, Portishead, Autechre and Nine Inch Nails — and now it fits in your pocket.
At Fingerlab, some of us composed our first songs with it as kids in the eighties. We wanted to bring back that unique feeling, so we built SK-51: a faithful recreation of the Casio SK-1 and VL-Tone, recorded note by note at professional audio quality (16bit / 44.1kHz).
SK-51 is a universal purchase — one buy covers iPhone, iPad & Mac.
Sample your voice, fire up the drum machine, play a chord — and you've got a track.
Free version includes:
• 3 instruments (Flute, Piano, Trumpet)
• 14 drum kits & 6 drum pads
• 4 sampling slots
• 3 demo drum patterns
• Full Mixer
• AUv3 Audio Unit
• Full MIDI & MIDI Mapping support
• AudioBus & Inter-App Audio (iOS)
• Ableton Link support
Full Version (IAP) includes:
• 19 instruments (Brass Ensemble, Vibraphone, Chorus and more)
• 21 demo drum patterns
• 5 FX: Tube Amp, Phaser, Delay, Reverb & Compressor
• Live Recording
Questions or feedback? We'd love to hear from you: contact@fingerlab.net
Stay tuned!
The Fingerlab Team

bluejetty:00177340:ios.description:
Aviation Weather — Fast, Visual, and Intuitive
METAR · TAF · NOTAM · ATIS · Radar · Maps
Decode aviation weather in seconds
WHY PILOTS CHOOSE STATIONWEATHER
- Fully decoded METAR and TAF reports, including graphical TAF
- Live D-ATIS reports — now available worldwide
- Interactive weather maps with route overlay
- Calendar import for instant flight briefings
- Widgets, Live Activities, and Apple Watch support
- Smart NOTAM filtering and prioritization
Aviation weather without the complexity
StationWeather transforms raw aviation weather data into clear, visual information — so you spend less time decoding reports and more time making decisions.
KEY FEATURES
METAR and TAF Decoding
Read METAR and TAF reports in a fully decoded, human-readable format. Understand weather conditions at a glance without interpreting raw data.
Graphical TAF
View the complete forecast in a visual timeline. See how wind, visibility, and conditions evolve at any given time — instantly.
Flight Briefings from Your Calendar
StationWeather reads your roster or flight schedule directly from your device calendar. Departure airport, destination, and flight times are detected automatically — no manual entry needed. The app then pulls the right weather reports for each airport at the relevant times, selects suitable alternates along the route, and presents everything at a glance. Your briefing, ready before you even open a chart.
Route Weather on the Map
Overlay your flight route on interactive weather maps to see radar, turbulence, cloud tops, wind, and pressure along your exact path — at the times that matter. From local conditions to a full en-route picture, everything is in one place.
Widgets and Live Activities
Put key weather data right on your Home Screen. Widgets for METAR, TAF, and more let you monitor conditions without opening the app. Live Activities and Apple Watch complications keep you updated throughout your flight day.
Worldwide D-ATIS
Live D-ATIS reports are no longer limited to a handful of US airports — StationWeather now delivers them worldwide. Get the current ATIS for your departure, destination, and alternates, wherever you fly.
Aviation Charts
Browse over 700 aviation weather charts across all ICAO regions, including significant weather (SIGWX) charts.
NOTAM Management
Filter, sort, and color-code NOTAMs by relevance. Fully customizable for your specific operation.
Global Coverage
Search more than 40,000 weather stations worldwide. Link nearby stations when direct data is unavailable.
Solar Radiation Risk
A 3-day solar radiation risk forecast for high-altitude operations, split across polar, mid-latitude, and equatorial bands. Available as an in-app tool and Home Screen widget.
Terms of Use: https://stationweather.com/terms-of-use-app

bluejetty:00037170:ios.description:
Do you love Art and its History? Get inspired & Learn something new every day!
Smart Art helps everyone to brighten up the day and enjoy the unrivaled works of art, discover brilliant artists and learn more about their art and its history in a fun and interactive way.
In Smart App we have brought together:
- curious and relatable stories and quizzes on arts and culture written in a witty, conversational tone,
- fully-searchable collection of high-quality images of beautiful and extraordinary artworks,
- and spiced it up with fun interactive features to take art discovery among young and old, enthusiasts or pros to a new level of engagement and fun. 
KEY FEATURES
• Daily Stories - 1000+ original short thematic history and artwork background stories that enlighten, entertain, and inspire. New one released every day!
• Art History Quizzes - another way to discover brilliant art and check your knowledge along the way.
• Preview Bubbles - fun and entertaining Video & Photo previews of original content and art history news.
• Easy to navigate Collection - Over 80,000 classified paintings (continuously growing and upgrading) from Medieval Manuscripts to Abstract Expressionism.
• Thematic Search - Browse artworks by filtering them by style, genre, artist, school, and other tags.
• Home Screen WIDGET - Enjoy new art every hour & Learn its story in 1 click.
• Artwork Zoom - Explore masterpieces in every detail.
• Personal collection - Save and share your favorite pieces.
• Push Notifications - Never miss your daily art inspiration and insights.
• Ad-FREE in all modes - 'cause we respect art and its viewers [you!].
Our mission is to make you feel inspired and know your way around in arts and culture. Use Smart Art for pleasure and leisure, in addition to your art education or professional research.
SUPPORTED BY ART LOVERS LIKE YOU
Smart Art isn't supported by banner ads. It is supported by art lovers like You. If you find this experience valuable, keep this project evolving and improving by becoming a subscriber. 
THE STORY BEHIND SMART ART
We’re a family team of two passionate art lovers, researchers, and ArtTech enthusiasts exploring new ways to make world art heritage more accessible and take brilliant artists of the past out of obscurity. 
Smart Art was born as an online community of thousands of passionate art lovers meeting daily to see and enjoy beautiful art and discuss the story behind it.
Now we invite you to join us on this journey and discover the whole universe of arts and history with Smart Art!

Terms of Use: https://getsmartart.com/terms

Swipe to steer, stay on the track, and
bluejetty:00080400:ios.description:
Ball Master 2048: Ball Run 3D is a ball run and 2048-style merge game where you merge same-number balls to grow your number and aim for 2560. Classic ball run 2048 feel with quick, satisfying merges.
Swipe to steer, stay on the track, and merge with a ball of the same number. Each merge makes the ball bigger and changes color. Numbers start at 1 and combine up to 2560. Easy to start, tough to master. Can you make a rainbow-colored 2048 ball?
How to play
- Swipe to move.
- Hit a ball with the same number to merge and increase.
- Number order: 1-5-10-20-40-80-160-320-640-1280-2560.
- If the ball falls off the rail, you restart from the beginning.
- If you get stuck on thorns, your number decreases.
- Reach the goal with the highest number to unlock the next level.
Tips
- Plan your line early to set up clean merges.
- Protect high numbers by avoiding risky angles and thorns.
- Aim for steady growth rather than rushed merges.
Start your next ball race in Ball Master 2048: Ball Run 3D. Get it now and enjoy quick, skill-based runs you can play anytime.
Note: 2248, 2468, and 2048 are representative numbers for merge games. Please share feedback if you would like these adjusted.

bluejetty:00174973:ios.description:
*Over 10,000 5-star ratings*
The Crossrope app is the best way to get fit jumping rope or using ropeless. We have hundreds of quick and effective guided jump rope, ropeless, and bodyweight workouts designed by the Crossrope Athletes utilizing our weighted Crossrope jump ropes.
If you have AMP, our Bluetooth-connected jump rope handles, the Crossrope app counts your jumps in workouts with Personalized Jump Targets and enables Free Jump and Benchmarks.
We release new workouts every week and new fitness challenges regularly. Our library of individual workouts and fitness programs has workouts to help you achieve your personal fitness goals, whether that’s burning fat, getting stronger, or increasing your endurance.
Use the Crossrope App to:
- Do workouts for cardio, weight loss, and strength
- Stay motivated with monthly fitness challenges to do along with our jump rope community
- Achieve your fitness goals with programs, like the 14-Day Fat Burning Program and 30-Day Six-Pack Starter Program
- Compete against your best jumping times and set records with Benchmarks
App Features
- Custom workout timer guides you through workouts with intuitive audio and visual cues
- AMP integration, to count your jumps with our Bluetooth-connected jump rope handles
- Activity tracking makes it easy to follow your workout completion, challenge progress, and total calories burned with options to sync to Apple Health
- Quick-start tutorial to get jumping quickly
- Learn new skills and exercises with our library of comprehensive jump rope tutorials
FAQs:
Do I need a Crossrope set to use the app?
The workouts are optimized for the AMP and the Crossrope weighted ropes, though if you have other Crossrope handles or another jump rope available, you can still follow along.
Where do I get a Crossrope set?
You can find our most popular ropes at www.crossrope.com
Do I need any other equipment to do these workouts?
No. All you need is your jump rope set, this app, and enough space to jump (no gym required).
What do the workouts look like?
Crossrope workouts are built around different combinations of jump rope and bodyweight exercises to help you burn calories, build strength, and improve endurance. Workouts range from 5 to 60 minutes.
Subscription Details:
Upgrade to Crossrope Membership to unlock our entire library of 2000+ workouts and programs, and with AMP handles: Personalized Jump Targets, Free Jump, and Benchmarks.
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period according to the terms of your subscription. You can manage your subscription by visiting the iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
If you love the Crossrope app, please leave us a review on the App Store!
We love feedback, please email us at appfeedback@crossrope.com with any comments or suggestions to make the app even better.
Crossrope includes social features and community teams where users can post comments and share workout activity. We take moderation seriously, but users may encounter content that is not appropriate for all audiences. Please review our Terms of Service before participating, and parents and guardians should supervise any minor’s use of the Crossrope app and its social features.
Join the Crossrope Community:
Instagram: www.instagram.com/crossropejumpropes/
Facebook: www.facebook.com/crossrope
Community: www.jumpropecommunity.com
Need Help?
Support: support@crossrope.com

bluejetty:00024685:ios.description:
“FaceScore” scores the balance of your face!
It analyzes each part of your face and gives you a score based on how close it is to the golden ratio.
It also finds your personal color based on your skin, hair, and eye colors.
You can also check your face shape and find celebrities who look like you.
See how close you are to the golden ratio!
Results may vary depending on your expression and makeup when the photo is taken.
Try a smile, a serious face, or different makeup styles!
You'll also discover the colors that suit you best.
Try it with your family, friends, and partner!
It's a guaranteed hit at school, at work, or at parties!
【Easy to Use】
1. Take a photo of your face.
2. Follow the instructions and align the guide lines on the screen.
3. When the analysis is complete, your results will appear.
4. Share your results with friends.
【Detailed Results】
Your score is based on the proportions of each facial feature, such as your face contour, eyes, nose, and mouth.
See scores for size, symmetry, shape, balance, and apparent age.
Personal color analysis also shows the colors that suit you.
Use your personal color as a guide for makeup and outfits.
【Personalized Advice】
AI gives you tips for getting closer to the golden ratio based on your results.
Find the hairstyles and makeup that suit you best.
【AI Chat】
Ask AI about your beauty and fashion concerns.
It answers questions about skincare, makeup, diet, cosmetic surgery, outfits, hairstyles, and more.
【Celebrity Look-Alike】
Find celebrities whose facial proportions are similar to yours.
You might be the next superstar!
【Colors That Suit You】
See a list of colors that suit you.
Discover your own personal color!
【Styling Suggestions】
Get outfit, makeup, hairstyle, and hair color suggestions based on your latest results.
【Body Type Test】
Find your body type based on your body lines,
and see the fashion styles that suit you best.
【Skin Test】
Check your skin condition and concerns,
and get skincare recommendations for you.
【Hairstyle Test】
Analyze your face shape and features from a photo,
and find hairstyles that suit you.
【Face Shape Test】
Analyze the outline and features of your face from a photo to find your face shape.
Your face is classified into one of 6 types: round, oval, oblong, heart, square, or diamond.
【What Is the Golden Ratio?】
The facial golden ratio refers to proportions that many people find attractive.
The closer your features are to the golden ratio, the more attractive your face tends to look.
Three elements of facial proportions affect attractiveness:
(1) Overall facial balance (length, width, length-to-width ratio, etc.)
(2) Position of facial features (eyes, nose, mouth, eyebrows, etc.)
(3) Size of each feature (eyes, nose, mouth, etc.)
【What Is Personal Color?】
Personal color refers to the colors that suit you best, based on an analysis of your skin, hair, and eyes.
There are two main undertones: warm (yellow-based) and cool (blue-based).
Personal colors are also grouped into four seasonal types: spring, summer, fall, and winter.
Using your personal colors in your makeup and clothing brings out your natural appeal.
【Notes】
• Results may vary depending on the angle of your face in the photo.
• Photos taken in the app are not saved.
• Photos are used only for analysis and for no other purpose.
Feel free to use the app with peace of mind.
【In-App Purchase】
• The VIP plan removes ads and unlocks more advice on getting closer to the golden ratio.
• The subscription renews automatically every month from the date you subscribe.
• To stop auto-renewal, cancel at least 24 hours before the renewal date.
• You can cancel anytime in your App Store account settings (Subscriptions).
【Note】
This app is for entertainment purposes only.
【Terms of Use】

bluejetty:00024082:ios.summary: Adopt a dog, cat, bird, hamster, or other cute puppies and take them to your home. Explore all the locations and role play with all characters! Take care of pets and create amazing stories! If you like pets, then you will love our pet game!
bluejetty:00024082:ios.description:
Adopt a dog, cat, bird, hamster, or other cute puppies and take them to your home. Explore all the locations and role play with all characters! Take care of pets and create amazing stories! If you like pets, then you will love our pet game!
Take care of pets with love! Visit a Pet Salon, Pet store, Animal Shelter and other locations where you can play with many characters and pets! Dress your adorable mini pets in costumes you like, take them to a spa day and make sure their fur looks shiny and fluffy!
ADOPT A PET
Our Animal Shelter has many pets that you can adopt. Adopt dogs, cats, birds, hamsters and other cute puppies. Visit the Animal Shelter before they close the store and pick up a new puppy that you can take home. Check all the tiny houses where they live and explore all the rooms!
PLAY AS A VET
Take care of pets and take them to a vet. Play vet games and make sure your mini pets are healthy and ready for puppy playtime! Roleplay as a vet doctor and take care of pets in the Pet Salon. Enjoy Vet games on your phone and make amazing stories.
SPA DAY FOR YOUR PET
Visit a Pet Salon and let your mini pets have a spa day. Make sure that puppies are appropriately dressed. Our animal games for kids allow you to customize the outfit so your mini pets can look cute & fluffy. Did you know that My Town Pet Salon has a dress studio for your mini pets? Yes, you can bath your cute puppies in our salon and change their fur style to look fantastic and clean!
TAKE PETS TO A PARK
Take your pets for a walk, play with them and let them enjoy nature! Take care of your pets, and make sure you clean the poop! Your cat would like a new collar, or your hamster needs a leash? Visit My Town Pet Store to buy all items. My Town Pet Store has all you need, so your mini pets look adorable! My Town pet games for kids are for all pet lovers!
ANIMAL & PET GAMES FOR KIDS:
• Explore: Animal Shelter, Vet Store, Pet Store, Pet Salon, Animal Park and more
• Adopt a pet: birds, hamsters, cats, & dogs
• Play as a Vet and take care of all cute animals
• Dress up your mini pets in a cool outfit
• It's time for puppy playtime! Take pets to Animal Park
• Our pet game is for kids of all ages
• Take your puppies for a walk and visit a Park
• Take pets to a spa, bath them and make them look nice
• Visit a Pet store and buy cool accessories
• From creators of My Town Home and other My Town games.
IMPROVE YOUR IMAGINATION AND CREATIVITY
My Town games are made to improve kids' creativity and imagination. There is no competition. You can explore, make decisions on your own and interact with almost everything. It's up to you how the game will go. Start an adventure and play with your favorite dollhouse characters. 
Chose who you want to be, play animal games and have fun for hours! Visit Pet Salon, Pet Store, Animal Shelter and check all the rooms for more fun. Be a Vet a play vet games! Dress up all animals and puppies in cute outfits. My Town World of Pets has many lovely animals you can take home!
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
Kids 4-12: My Town games are safe to play even when parents are out of the room.
ABOUT MY TOWN
The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse-like games that promote creativity and open ended play for your children worldwide. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com

bluejetty:00175422:ios.description:
Teladoc Health is the leader in virtual care. Our doctors diagnose, treat and prescribe when
needed. You can also use our app to help manage weight, diabetes, blood pressure and your
overall health.
Our services include:
24/7 CARE
-On-demand visits with board-certified doctors and nurse practitioners
-Help with time-sensitive concerns like cold and flu
-Prescriptions and limited refills
PRIMARY CARE
-Care provider who gets to know you over time
-Annual checkups and ongoing care
-Prescriptions, lab tests and referrals
CONDITION MANAGEMENT
-Help managing weight, blood sugar and blood pressure
-Connected scale, blood glucose meter or blood pressure monitor
-Tips and tools to help manage your health, including AI-powered food tracking
-Unlimited 1:1 health coaching
-GLP-1 support for those who qualify
MENTAL HEALTH
-Therapists, psychiatrists and coaches
-Personalized digital program
-Help with stress, anxiety, depression, relationships and more
DERMATOLOGY
-Photo review of skin concerns
-Treatment plan delivered by message within 24 hours
-Prescriptions and limited refills
NUTRITION
-Registered dietitians
-Help with your conditions and goals
-Personalized meal plans, grocery guides and more
SEXUAL HEALTH
-Confidential lab testing for STDs through STDcheck.com
-Results in under three days
SECOND OPINIONS
-Expert opinions on diagnoses and care
-Help choosing a treatment
-Many available specialties
***
Care at Teladoc Health is:
COVERED BY MOST MAJOR HEALTH INSURERS
More than 1 in 4 Americans have Teladoc Health coverage through their employer or health
insurance. When you create an account, we’ll help you check if you’re covered. But coverage isn’t
required. Many services are available without it.
PERSONALIZED
Our care providers get to know you and tend to every part of your well-being. We also offer digital
tools and programs designed around your needs. You can even connect Apple Health to sync your
data and get health insights.
CONVENIENT
We can address most common health needs anytime, anywhere. With some programs, you’ll get a
blood pressure monitor, scale or blood glucose meter sent to your home. We also offer in-home
lab services and prescription delivery in some locations. If you need in-person care, we can refer
you to in-network providers.
HIGH-QUALITY
Teladoc Health has been caring for people virtually for more than 20 years. More than 50 million
visits later, we’re the leader in virtual care. Newsweek has recognized us as one of the most
trustworthy companies in America. USA Today has called us one of America’s most trusted brands.
PRIVATE AND SECURE
Teladoc Health takes your privacy seriously. Your health information is protected by federal and
state laws, including HIPAA. View our privacy policies for more information on how Teladoc Health
uses your personal information: https://www.teladochealth.com/legal/privacy-policy.

bluejetty:00034734:ios.description:
Experience Chinese Like Never Before
Elevate your learning journey with Talk Chineasy, the revolutionary app designed to take you from the basics to fluency in no time. Seamlessly blending engaging videos, advanced voice recognition, and interactive scenarios, Talk Chineasy is here to enhance the way you learn Chinese.
Start from Scratch or Level Up
Whether you’re a complete beginner or looking to refine your skills, Talk Chineasy offers a comprehensive range of video lessons. Begin with the essentials and progress to advanced conversations, all at your own pace.
Perfect Your Pronunciation
Our state-of-the-art voice recognition technology ensures you get instant feedback on your pronunciation. Practice makes perfect, and Talk Chineasy makes it fun and accurate.
Immerse in Real-Life Scenarios
Learn through theme-based scenarios that are both fun and practical. From ordering food to making new friends, you’ll gain the confidence to apply your skills in real-life situations.
Engaging Exercises for All Skills
Talk Chineasy isn’t just about speaking; it’s about listening and understanding too. Dive into a variety of exercises that will enhance both your listening and speaking abilities, ensuring a well-rounded mastery of the language.
What Makes Talk Chineasy Special?
◉ Comprehensive Video Lessons: Start from the basics and advance to fluent conversations.
◉ Voice Recognition Technology: Improve your pronunciation with instant feedback.
◉ Theme-Based Scenarios: Apply what you learn in fun and practical contexts.
◉ Interactive Exercises: Enhance both your listening and speaking skills.
◉ Engaging and Fun: Learn through captivating content that keeps you motivated.
Join thousands of learners who have discovered the joy of learning Chinese with Talk Chineasy. Embrace the journey, and watch yourself transform from a novice to a confident speaker. The future of language learning is here – and it’s incredibly fun!

bluejetty:00070677:ios.description:
O aplicativo Detran GO ON foi criado para simplificar o acesso a diversos serviços do Departamento Estadual de Trânsito de Goiás. Com ele, você pode resolver tudo de forma prática e rápida, direto do seu smartphone, sem precisar sair de casa. Tenha todos os serviços relacionados à habilitação, veículos e processos sempre ao seu alcance.
Alguns dos serviços disponíveis no app são:
* Registre a Intenção de Venda (ATPV) e comunicado de venda de forma gratuita.
* Realize a indicação de real condutor quando você não for o infrator (transferir pontos).

The integration of artificial intelligence in tattoo artistry has ushered in a new era of creativity, innovation, and personalization. At the forefront of this technological revolution is the AI tattoo generator, a groundbreaking tool that empowers both tattoo enthusiasts and artists to explore, conceptualize, and create unique tattoo designs with unparalleled ease and precision.
Utilizing cutting-edge AI algorithms and intuitive design interfaces, users can generate bespoke tattoo designs tailored to their individual preferences, aesthetic sensibilities, and personal narratives. These platforms analyze vast repositories of tattoo imagery, artistic styles, and cultural motifs to produce diverse design options that reflect the unique identity of each wearer. The AI tattoo generator transcends traditional design boundaries, offering limitless possibilities for customization. Users can explore a wide spectrum of artistic styles, from minimalist geometric patterns to intricate floral motifs and bold tribal designs, curated by AI algorithms that adapt to user preferences.
This feature allows the AI to generate stunning ink designs, blending artistic expression with digital precision. Users can experiment with intricate patterns, textures, and compositions, pushing the boundaries of tattoo design and enhancing their creativity and self-expression. AI tattoo design apps equipped with the tattoo maker feature facilitate the transition from digital sketch to physical tattoo. By generating high-resolution tattoo stencils and templates, these apps streamline the tattooing process, ensuring precise placement and execution of the final design.
The AI tattoo generator serves as a valuable resource for tattoo artists, offering access to a vast library of design inspirations and artistic references. This fosters a culture of innovation and artistic growth within the tattoo community, encouraging artists to explore new techniques, styles, and motifs. By harnessing the power of machine learning and deep neural networks, the AI tattoo generator represents a significant advancement in the realm of tattoo artistry, providing an innovative platform for creativity and self-expression.

bluejetty:00136749:ios.description:
Introducing the ECG Insight App: Your Personalized Heart Rhythm Analyst
The ECG Insight App is your go-to tool for unlocking the secrets of your heart's rhythm using data from your Apple Watch. Built to provide accurate and reliable insights, this app is designed to enhance your understanding of your heart's health and empower you to make informed decisions about your well-being.
Key Features:
1. Atrial Fibrillation vs. Sinus Rhythm: 
Gain a clear understanding of your heart's rhythm patterns based on Apple's data.
2. HRV Analysis: 
Delve into your heart's variability and uncover insights about your overall well-being. Our app performs Heart Rate Variability (HRV) analysis, offering a deeper understanding of your cardiovascular health.
3. Stress and Energy Levels: 
Learn how your heart responds to stress and energy demands. Our app interprets data to give you insights into your stress levels and energy reserves, helping you manage your lifestyle more effectively.
4. Holistic Health Snapshot:
Get a comprehensive overview of your health trends. By combining data from heart rate, HRV, and other factors, our app creates a holistic health index, allowing you to track your well-being over time.
5. Personalized Insights: Benefit from personalized recommendations based on your heart's data. We provide actionable suggestions for stress management, relaxation techniques, and healthy habits tailored to your unique needs.
6. Historical Tracking: Monitor your progress and improvements. Our app enables you to explore historical data and trends, empowering you to make proactive choices for a healthier future.
Why Choose ECG insight?
The ECG Insight App is your dedicated partner in understanding your heart's rhythm and overall health. We are committed to using only Apple's reliable data, ensuring that you receive accurate insights without unnecessary notifications. Whether you're proactive about your health or you're simply curious about your heart's behavior, ECG Insight is here to provide valuable information in a user-friendly interface.
Start your journey towards a more informed and empowered lifestyle today. Download the ECG Insight App and let your heart's data guide you towards optimal well-being. Your heart, your data, your insight.
Disclaimer:-
This app is not to be used as a medical device.
Please consult your doctor incase of any medical condition, seeking medical advice or making medical decisions.

Privacy policy:- https://www.ecgapplewatch.com/legal
Customer support:- ECGanalyze@gmail.com

bluejetty:00063101:ios.description:
Get ready to have an amazing adventure as your favourite pet (dog or cat) in a wonderful land full of crazy fun things to do. 
NEW: OWNER MODE: Play as the owner - get kitty to chase a ball, follow a laser, have a bath and run for food. (only for cats)
Super cute. Super exciting!
NEW LEVEL :RESTAURANT - exciting new level with lots of fun new activities.
NEW: Collect Coins and Diamonds as you Play in our exciting new locations to Unlock new Cats, Pets and Accessories!
NEW: SURVIVAL MODE: mom and dad want to give you a bath - don't let them catch you! hide behind the sofa or run away. 
Play as your favorite cat or dog!
Hundreds of fun interactions in great environments for hours of solid good fun.
MULTIPLAYER: 6 new Multiplayer levels - every level is now playable as multiplayer. Create your own rooms and invite your friends.
Check out the accessories - hats, helmets, moustaches, glasses and loads more then take a photo and share it on Facebook or Twitter with your friends.
See if you can get the highest score or unlock all the achievements.
CATS & DOGS:
With over 20 pets to choose from there's no end to the fun!
Free to unlock.
LOCATIONS:
Farm Level : Lets help drive a tractor? Go on quests to help the crows and help the horses escape!
Playground: Want to fly on a kite, eat ice cream or go on the swings?
Schools out! Play Dominos, Ride on a skateboard, play in the gym.
Home: Dads playing golf - lets play too and steal the ball. Whats cooking in the kitchen? Interact with the family - If you're nice maybe they'll feed you.
Garden: Chase ducks, help with the planting, make friends with the dogs in the garden or maybe the squirrels?
Beach: Jetski? set off some fireworks, play in a band, dig sand with a dozer, build a sand castle and more!
Supermarket level - Cause havoc in the supermarket, play with the toys, chase mice, set off the fire alarm, fly on a plane, ride on a trolly and lots more!
DRESS UP:
All accessories, places and pets can be unlocked for free, so dive right in to play with Porky Pig, Billy the goat, Shadow the dog, Sammy the tomcat cat or any of the many pets.
GAME:
Use the joypad to move around and swipe the screen to get a 360 degree view of your pet.
Knock stuff around.
Prepare for catlateral damage in the cat simulator in their wild, fun lives.
New: play in HD or SD quality mode.
Time Trial mode added!
Extra cat games levels added all the time.
What do they get up to in their secret time?

bluejetty:00071472:ios.description:
Keep your workouts, training schedule and body weight in one calendar.
Track machine exercises, free weights, bodyweight training and cardio.
LOG YOUR WORKOUTS
Save your usual exercises as a menu, then select them to add a workout to your calendar. Record weight, reps, sets, duration, distance and notes. Review previous workouts or copy a past entry.

bluejetty:00019297:ios.name: OneBit Adventure Roguelike RPG
bluejetty:00019297:ios.summary: "Can you survive one more floor when the next move could go wrong? In OneBit Adventure, every step gives monsters a turn too, turning a pixel roguelike RPG adventure into a careful dungeon crawl with loot, classes, and offline play. Pick yo
bluejetty:00019297:ios.description:
"Can you survive one more floor when the next move could go wrong? In OneBit Adventure, every step gives monsters a turn too, turning a pixel roguelike RPG adventure into a careful dungeon crawl with loot, classes, and offline play. Pick your hero and make the next move count!
A run in OneBit Adventure can feel calm for a few steps, then dangerous right after. The monsters move with you, so crawling through pixel dungeons is really about timing, loot, health, and knowing when not to take another fight. Level up, stay careful, and see if this run goes deeper.
Turn-based roguelike combat
This is more about careful moves than fast tapping. Each step can open a path, start a fight, or put your hero into trouble.
You can swipe or use the d-pad as you explore, but the real choice is usually what comes next. Attack, heal, move away, save an item, or risk one more turn.
Choose your class and build your hero
Pick a hero class that matches your playstyle and grow stronger through each run:
- Warrior for close-range power
- Archer for ranged attacks
- Wizard for magic damage
- Necromancer for dark abilities
- Pyromancer for fire-based play
- Blood Knight for risky survival
- Thief for speed and clever moves
A class choice changes how the run feels. Some heroes are safer early, some need better timing, and some become much stronger once the right skills and loot start coming together.
Pixel dungeon crawl with loot
Caves, Castles, the Underworld, and other areas all bring their own danger. Some rooms give you coins or useful items, while others put a monster or boss right where you did not want one.
Loot matters here. Find gear, collect coins, buy items, heal when you can, and unlock skills as your hero gains XP. A good item can save a run. A bad choice can end it.
That is what makes the dungeon crawl hard to put down. One run is about exploring carefully, another is about a lucky loot drop, and the next one might last longer because you leveled up at the right time.
Play offline or compete online
OneBit Adventure can be played offline, which makes it easy to start a quick run, continue during travel, or play longer without worrying about an internet connection. When you are back online, your best runs can still matter through the global Rankings.
It works as a quick offline RPG when you only have a few minutes, but longer dungeon runs can turn into a tougher roguelike challenge as you push deeper.
Fair challenge, no loot boxes
OneBit Adventure is about skill, builds, and decisions. There are no loot boxes. Progress comes from learning enemies, using items well, choosing the right upgrades, and knowing when to take a risk.
If you enjoy pixel RPG games, dungeon crawler games, traditional roguelike games, or turn-based RPG adventures, this game gives you a clean retro style with real survival pressure.
Why play OneBit Adventure?
- Pixel roguelike RPG adventure with retro one-bit style
- Turn-based combat where each move matters
- Dungeon crawl gameplay with loot, bosses, XP, and upgrades
- Multiple hero classes with different playstyles
- Offline RPG play with optional online Rankings
- Endless adventure built for replayability
- No loot boxes, just skill-based progression
Download OneBit Adventure if a pixel roguelike RPG with slower, smarter dungeon runs sounds like your kind of game. Use turn-based combat, find loot, build hero classes, and play offline when you need to. Choose your class and chase a run worth surviving!"

bluejetty:00100444:ios.description:
Sweatmates is a simple accountability app for people who want to stay consistent with working out.
Instead of tracking stats or metrics, Sweatmates focuses on showing up together.
How it works
Set a weekly goal
Choose how many days you want to work out each week.
Log workouts with a photo
Use SweatCam to take a quick photo when you work out. Your partner sees it instantly.
Stay accountable as a team
See each other’s progress throughout the week and stay motivated to hit your goal.
Add light stakes
If you miss your weekly goal, you owe a simple wager like buying dinner or doing a chore. Hit your goal and you are safe.
Build consistency over time
Sweatmates helps turn workouts into a shared habit instead of a solo chore.
Why our users love Sweatmates
Builds accountability without pressure
Makes workouts feel shared even when apart
Simple and fast with no stats or tracking required
Designed for real life not perfection
Whether you are just getting started or trying to stay consistent, Sweatmates helps you show up together.
Sweamates has paid functionality.
*WORKOUT LOGGING REQUIRES A SUBSCRIPTION

bluejetty:00152853:ios.description:
We believe that being aware of your emotions is the key to understanding yourself. 
MindAware helps you build that awareness as a daily practice — through mood tracking, journaling, and AI reflections that notice what you might not, surfacing patterns over time and helping you see what's showing up in your own words.
A daily practice — a few minutes to check in and notice what's there. Done consistently, awareness becomes a habit.
What you'll find inside:
Basic:
— Mood check-ins that guide you from broad feelings into more specific emotional states
— Space to write freely through journaling
— A personal history of your moods and emotional experiences over time
Premium:
— AI-generated reflections after every mood log and journal entry
— Weekly and monthly reflections that reveal recurring emotional patterns
— Deeper insight into emotional themes and shifts that may otherwise go unnoticed
Basic is where the journey begins. It’s designed to help you explore the app, begin logging in your moods and building a journaling habit. 
Premium is where meaningful growth happens. As your journal grows, each entry adds context, helping you develop greater self-awareness, emotional clarity, and understanding. The more consistently you engage, the more personal and valuable your insights become. 
Premium subscription required for full feature access.
Privacy Policy: https://www.mindawaregroup.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00029777:ios.summary: With the Hilton Grand Vacations mobile app HGVClub Members and Vacation Package Holders have direct access to all the outstanding content and functionality found online - all with a tap of their smartphone. Plus, Members will have a digital
bluejetty:00029777:ios.description:
With the Hilton Grand Vacations mobile app HGVClub Members and Vacation Package Holders have direct access to all the outstanding content and functionality found online - all with a tap of their smartphone. Plus, Members will have a digital travel guide and interactive resort concierge designed to deliver a better experience before, during, and after a stay. 
Note HGVClub Members and Vacation Package Holders: 
If you have already created an account on the HGVClub Member Website (club.hiltongrandvacations.com) or the Vacation Package Holder Site (concierge.hiltongrandvacations.com), please Sign In with the email address and password you created during that process. 
Key features include: 
MY TRIP: View a snapshot of your trip details, including reservation information, on-property activities and dining options, as well as any events or promotions offered on property or near you during your stay 
GUEST FEEDBACK: Provide your thoughts and feedback regarding your stay while you’re on vacation and once you return home 
PUSH NOTIFICATIONS: Receive messages and alerts directly to your smartphone so you can stay informed and focused on enjoying your vacation 
Plus unique features for Hilton Grand Vacations HGVClub Members: 
MOBILE BOOKING: HGVClub Members can search for the perfect vacation with our new mobile-friendly booking engine. Choose “My Dates” if you know the exact dates you’d like to travel and only see availability for what you are looking for. If your dates are flexible, choose “Flex” and you can see availability across a range dates, or choose “Open Season” and see just what’s available during the Open Season rental window. 
FRONT DESK MESSAGING: HGVClub Members can now chat with the front desk during their stay at many Hilton Grand Vacations resorts. This new feature allows you to quickly make requests and get answers to questions about your stay directly from our mobile app. The Front Desk Messaging feature will be available on the My Trip Dashboard throughout your stay at eligible HGV resorts. 
CLUB GUIDE: Connect with fellow HGVClub Members in an online community where you can post questions and make or read recommendations on what to do during your trip 
CLUB DASHBOARD: Make and manage reservations, points, membership details, and more...just like you would on the HGVClub website 
Travel easier tomorrow…download the Hilton Grand Vacations App today. 
Note: 
-This app will only be accessible by Hilton Grand Vacations HGVClub Members, Hilton Grand Vacations Package Holders and Hilton

bluejetty:00070978:ios.description:

Life of King is a vibrant idle tycoon decision making game full of Stone Age wonders, wacky decisions, and not-very-smart kings. bluejetty:00031290:ios.description:
Stay up-to-date with the latest news and weather in the San Antonio area on the all-new KENS 5 app.
Our app features the latest breaking news that impacts you and your family, interactive weather and radar, and live video from our newscasts and local events.
LOCAL & BREAKING NEWS
• Receive real-time notifications for breaking news
• Read the latest news as it happens in your area
• Explore exclusive investigative stories
• Browse photos, news clips, and raw video
LOCAL WEATHER
• Daily and hourly forecasts for your city
• The latest forecasts from our meteorologists
• Interactive radar maps
• Automated hyperlocal severe weather alerts
LIVE VIDEO
• Watch live video newscasts and breaking news from KENS 5
PERSONALIZATION
• Discover and dive into topics that matter to you
• Favorite topics to receive personalized updates
Other Features:
• Share stories & videos directly with your friends and family
• See the latest updates and behind the scenes photos from your favorite anchors and reporters
• Get information on school delays & closings as they happen
• Cast videos and livestreams directly to your TV or streaming device, so you can lean back and enjoy your favorite programming on your biggest screen.
This is the official app of KENS 5 and KENS5.com, the CBS affiliate serving San Antonio. 
Got feedback? Let us know how we can make this the best app experience for you! Send us a note at appfeedback@tegna.com.

bluejetty:00168919:ios.description:
Unzip, Open, and Manage Any File on iPhone & iPad
Unzip is a powerful all-in-one tool that helps you extract, view, and manage files without a computer. Open compressed files, stream videos inside an archive, browse your documents, and organize everything in one app — no extra software required.
Whether it’s class materials, work documents, downloaded videos, cloud drive archives, or game files, Unzip makes it easy.
Lightning-Fast Unzip & Compression
- Supports DZIP, ZIP, RAR, 7Z, LZH, TAR, GZ, ISO, and more
- Works with multi-part archives (.001/.002/.003…)
- Extracts encrypted archives with passwords
- Create ZIP, 7Z, and DZIP files
- One-tap to compress multiple files and folders
- Fast, stable performance for large files
Supported formats include: DZIP, ZIP, RAR, 7Z, LZH, ZIPX, TAR, GZIP, BZIP, TGZ, TBZ, ISO, DEB, CAB, JAR, RPM, and more.
Desktop-Style File Manager
- Create and manage folders
- Move, copy, rename, delete files
- Batch operations
- File categories: Documents, Videos, Audio, Photos
- Import from the Files app
- Download files directly from your browser
- Share via other apps or AirDrop
Play Videos Directly Inside ZIP Files
- Supports MKV, MP4, MOV, and more
- Automatic subtitle loading (SRT, ASS)
- External subtitle support
- Full-screen and playback speed control
- Smooth playback for large files
- 4K hardware decoding
Great Audio Playback Experience
- MP3, AAC, FLAC, WAV, and more
- Play audio files directly inside archives
- Import and organize music easily
Read Any Document On the Go
- TXT, PDF, Markdown, DOC, and more
- Smooth reading experience for large TXT/PDF files
- Search and jump to sections
- Dark Mode for comfortable reading
Connect to All Your Storage
- FTP, SMB, WebDAV
- iCloud Drive sync
- Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive
- Wi-Fi file transfer
- Scan a QR code to transfer files between devices
Why Unzip
- Extract, compress, manage, and play — all in one app
- Save time and storage: no need to extract everything
- Works with all major formats and multi-part archives
- Reliable and easy to use
- Designed for both work and entertainment
Privacy First
Your files are yours. We don’t read or upload any of your content.
Premium Access
Unzip offers optional premium upgrades:
Lifetime Pro
One-time purchase. Use forever.
Annual Pro (Auto-Renew)
Enjoy full access with automatic renewal.
Support
Privacy Policy:
https://www.dkzip.com/PrivacyUserTerms/privacy.html
Terms of Use:
https://www.dkzip.com/PrivacyUserTerms/user_terms.html
Contact us: techsupport@dkzip.com

- iOS Siri

- Smart Car Locator
- Indoor Parking Reminder
- Parking Meter Reminder
- Car Battery Health Monitor
Other common features:
- Family Sharing

bluejetty:00169861:ios.description:
*This is a third-party application and is not affiliated with, sponsored, or endorsed by Amazon.
Tool4seller is an Amazon seller app that helps you understand and manage your Amazon business. 
With functions to monitor, analyze, and present data of your Amazon business, including sales, keywords and search terms, PPC Ads, cost & revenue, FBA inventory status, your true profit and more, you can also create, start, pause, and edit your PPC campaigns just like on Amazon seller central.
The services we provide:
Product Research
Do product and keyrword research by simply scanning a barcode or searching products on Amazon. Help you find the next best seller with the powerful data to assess market demand and valuate product opportunities.
Profit and Sales Analysis
Provide a clear breakdown of your cost and revenue of your Amazon business to offer you a clear image of what cost is eating into your profit margin. You can also dive deeper into specific ASINs to see which products are actually making you money.
PPC Optimization
Track, view, adjust your campaign details, you can even set automation rules to make your PPC easier and drive maximum results for your Amazon advertising.
Sales Trend
With an overview of data on your Amazon sales and profit and you can drill down into specific ASINs as well to review its sales trend to help you forecast your sales, focus on the most profitable products and assist with your inventory management decisions.
Inventory Management
Whether FBA or FBM, you can use historical data to help forecast and suggest when and how much you should restock. There is an inventory reminder to let you know when your inventory level is low and needs to restock.
Email Automation
Set auto email templates to request customer reviews. You will also get review alert that can help you maintain a positive seller reputation and provide a better customer service experience. Plus, you can track your email marketing effects to regularly adjust your email strategies.
Real-Time Alerts
Know what‘s going on with Amazon your business even if your not in the office.
Keyword research and Category Ranking
Provide category and keyword ranking to see where you are place in the category or keyword search result, which you can use to determine the direction and correctness of your operation strategy. 
Free Tools
Plenty of useful features such as FBA Calculator and Keyword Search Volume.
Support All Current Amazon Marketplaces
Australia, Canada, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico, Netherlands, Poland, Saudi Arabia, Spain, Sweden, United Arab Emirates, Singapore, the United Kingdom and the United States,Turkey, Brazil, Belgium, Egypt.
[Subscription Description for Monthly Plans]
1. Service Name: Monthly Plans include Startup Monthly Plan, Standard Monthly Plan, Professional Monthly Plan, and Premium Monthly Plan.
2. The monthly subscription automatically renews and extends for 1 month. The iTunes account will be charged 24 hours before expiration day.
3. To cancel the subscription, manually open the "Settings" on the Apple device, go to "iTunes & App Store", click "Apple ID", select "View Apple ID", go to "Account Settings", click "Subscriptions", and cancel the corresponding monthly plan. If the subscription is not canceled at least 24 hours before expiration day, it will be automatically renewed.
4. Terms & Conditions: https://www.tool4seller.com/terms-and-conditions.html
5. Privacy Policy: https://www.tool4seller.com/privacy.html

bluejetty:00068946:ios.summary:

YOUR PERSONAL MEDITATION COACH
