bluejetty:00068946:ios.description:
Improve your stress, sleep, and more with Balance’s personalized guided meditation program.
YOUR PERSONAL MEDITATION COACH
Balance is your personal meditation coach. Each day, you’ll answer questions about your meditation experience, goals, and preferences. Using an audio library of thousands of files, Balance assembles a daily guided meditation that’s perfect for you. The more you share over time, the more personalized and effective your meditations become.
LEARN MEDITATION FUNDAMENTALS
Balance’s daily meditations are organized in 10-day Plans that teach fundamental meditation skills geared toward your goals and needs. You’ll discover how to bring awareness to your day, increase your focus among distractions, and find deep relaxation in moments of stress.
CLEAR YOUR MIND ANYTIME, ANYWHERE
Singles are bite-sized guided meditations you can use anytime—even on the go. Wake up gently with a morning meditation, stretch, and then make your commute less chaotic with a meditation customized to your journey. Clear your mind with animated breathing exercises, and lower your stress, find energy, and increase your focus with quick Relax, Energize, and Concentrate meditations—and many more.
SLEEP WELL WITH BED-TIME RELAXATION EXERCISES
You'll rest easy with our Sleep meditations, Sleep Sounds, and Wind Down activity—a first-of-its-kind interactive that uses bilateral stimulation and controlled breathing to help you relax before bed and find more restful sleep. You'll also experience cutting-edge Immersive Meditations, which blend vibrations, sound effects, and coach guidance to create a brand-new type of meditation experience.
TAKE YOUR MEDITATION PRACTICE TO THE NEXT LEVEL
Get started with our Foundations Plan, where you’ll train your focus and reduce anxiety. Or, if you already meditate often, start with our Advanced Plan, which helps you take your meditation practice to the next level.
WHAT’S INCLUDED
- Personalized guided meditations tailored to your mood and goals
- 10-day Plans to help you develop your meditation skills
- Bite-sized Single guided meditations you can use to get more out of any moment
- First-of-their-kind Immersive Meditations to help you relax through a blend of vibration, sound effects, and guidance
- Research-backed activities to help you relax and prepare for restful sleep
- Mindful Minutes integration with Apple’s Health app
- 10 concrete meditation techniques to build your practice: Breath Focus, Body Scan, and more
In meditation, “one-size-fits-all” fits no one. We all have our own ways of finding relaxation, focus, and rest. With thousands of paths and options, Balance helps you reach your goals—your way—through guided meditation that adapts to you.
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Start your free trial to experience the benefits of Balance. After the trial, Balance offers two auto-renewing subscriptions at $11.99/month and $69.99/year. These prices are for United States customers, pricing in other countries may vary.
Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of each subscription term unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the term. Subscription renewals cost the same as the original subscription, and your credit card will be charged through your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
Balance also offers a Lifetime subscription which is paid for by a one-off upfront payment of $399.99 with unlimited access to the Balance library forever.
For additional information, please read our Terms of Service (http://www.balanceapp.com/balance-terms.html) and Privacy Policy (http://www.balanceapp.com/balance-privacy.html).

Your undead hero runs and fights automatically. You choose his equipment and upgrades, shaping how he grows between battles.
Two thousand years after the first Knight Hero, the same hero rests in a tomb. Grave robbers disturb his sleep, awakening him as a mummy with a reason to seek revenge.

Collect weapons, shields, and armor. Equip new gear and improve your hero for the battles ahead.
TURN UNWANTED GEAR INTO MAGIC
Turn unwanted equipment into magic. Brew it and choose one potion.
BUILD UP FOR THE NEXT BOSS
Use skills against enemies and bosses. Keep improving your hero through repeated runs.
CHANGE YOUR UNDEAD LOOK
Use barber coins to customize your hero. Gradually change his appearance from a wrapped mummy toward a human look.
TAKE THE FIGHT BEYOND THE TOMB
Battle through different worlds and enter dungeons as your adventure continues.
The hero handles the running and fighting. You choose how he develops. Equip your next upgrade and begin another run in Knight Hero 2.

bluejetty:00174935:ios.name: Salt & Pepper
bluejetty:00174935:ios.summary:
For restaurant owners, bake shops, caterers, manufacturers of food products, chefs, and even home cooks. With Salt & Pepper, you can:
Create recipes with an ingredient list, procedure, yield, preparation time, notes, and photos/videos. C
bluejetty:00174935:ios.description:
For restaurant owners, bake shops, caterers, manufacturers of food products, chefs, and even home cooks. With Salt & Pepper, you can:
Create recipes with an ingredient list, procedure, yield, preparation time, notes, and photos/videos. Choose your recipe ingredients from your dynamically-filtered master ingredient list, then select various preparations (such as "finely-diced" or "sautéed"), from a pick-list of over 40 options.
Enter costs for each ingredient in your recipe, and Salt & Pepper will display the total cost of the recipe, and the cost per serving. Set a recipe's selling price, and Salt & Pepper will calculate the mark-up and profit information. You can also add "other costs" to your recipes, which can be a percentage of the total ingredient cost, or based on quantity, such as per serving, per batch, or per unit."
Use the Suppliers screen to create, edit, and delete ingredients. Changes made to an ingredient's name, price, allergens, food energy, density, or usable portion are applied to all recipes containing that ingredient. You can organize your ingredients by supplier, and further by category.
Record your inventory, and set minimum values. Salt & Pepper will calculate the monetary value of each stock item, and the total value of your entire inventory.
Scale your recipes up or down, or to a desired yield. The amount and cost of each ingredient, and the total cost of the recipe, are adjusted accordingly.
Separate a recipe's ingredients into multiple sections, such as "For the Cake", "For the Frosting", and "For the Ganache". Re-order your ingredients and preparation steps by dragging them.
Use one recipe as an ingredient in another recipe. When "Recipe A" is used as an ingredient in "Recipe B", the cost, allergens, and food energy of "Recipe A" become part of "Recipe B" (based on the quantity used).
Duplicate recipes, in order to experiment with multiple variations.
Track the expiration dates of your ingredients. If you choose, Salt & Pepper will notify you before your ingredients expire.
Enter densities for your ingredients. Densities allow the calculation of a recipe's cost or calories when an ingredient is purchased by weight, but the recipe measurement is in volume.
Manage shopping lists. You can add ingredients to your shopping lists directly from your recipes. Quantities from multiple recipes are automatically summed. You can arrange your store's aisles to match the physical stores at which you shop, and you can arrange your ingredients in the order that they appear on the actual store shelves. 
Create notes, with checklists, photos/videos, and a due date (with alarm).
Create custom categories for filing your recipes and notes. A recipe or note can belong to multiple categories. For meal planning, custom recipe categories can serve as menus, such as "Rehearsal Dinner Menu". You can also create "outlets" to further categorize items based on location. For instance, if you operate a number of restaurants, you could create a separate outlet for each. 
Link your recipes and notes to related recipes and notes.
Share individual recipes, suppliers, shopping lists, and notes with co-workers, family, and friends. When changes are made to a shared item, everyone receives the changes. You can also set "abilities" for each user. For instance, you can specify whether a particular user is allowed to view or edit ingredient costs.
Print your recipes, suppliers, shopping lists, and notes.
E-mail recipes and notes. You can send them in PDF format, and as Salt & Pepper data files, which the recipient can import into Salt & Pepper.
Use the Conversions screen to convert units of weight, volume, and temperature, and to perform price comparisons.
Sync your recipes, suppliers, shopping lists, and notes between all of your iOS devices.
Salt & Pepper contains no advertisements.

bluejetty:00023977:ios.name: Football Head Coach 27 - FHC
bluejetty:00023977:ios.summary:
The new Football Head Coach 27 season is here!
The gridiron's most immersive coaching simulation kicks off a brand-new season! Football Head Coach 27 puts you in the headset as Head Coach — draft, train, and build your franchise from the g
bluejetty:00023977:ios.description:
The new Football Head Coach 27 season is here!
The gridiron's most immersive coaching simulation kicks off a brand-new season! Football Head Coach 27 puts you in the headset as Head Coach — draft, train, and build your franchise from the ground up in one of the most immersive American football games out there. Fresh rosters and more ways to outcoach the competition all season long.
Build Your Dream Roster
Assemble a championship-caliber lineup with officially NFL Players Association-licensed athletes. Sign rising stars like quarterback Drake Maye, workhorse back Kenneth Walker III, and explosive rookie Jahmyr Gibbs. Stack your defense with hard-hitting edge rusher Demarcus Lawrence and rock-solid linebacker Carson Schwesinger, then power your offense with electric playmaker James Cook and battle-tested veteran arm Brock Purdy. Open player packs, browse the player market, and outbid rival coaches for the talent your franchise needs.
Command the Sidelines
Take full control of tactics as Head Coach. Call plays from a deep library of real American football formations, or design daring new combinations to catch defenses off guard. A next-level simulation engine reacts to every audible, blitz, and trick play, delivering some of the most unpredictable football games around — so no two matches ever play out the same.
Chase Championship Glory
Guide your team through a full regular season, battle rival coaches for playoff seeding, and manage depth charts and matchups week to week as you build a true dynasty this new season.
Train, Compete, Repeat
Jump into Quick Match to test new plays and lineups anytime. Run daily training to sharpen your roster and keep every player playoff-ready.
Download Football Head Coach 27 now and lead your team to glory. Outdraft, outcoach, and outplay every rival in one of the most complete football games available today.
Note: Some in-game items can be purchased for real money. Football Head Coach 27 includes packs that drop the available items in randomised order. Information about drop rates can be found by selecting a pack in game and tapping the 'info' button. Packs can be purchased using in-game currency 'Gold Bars' or earned through gameplay. FHC has a yearly season reset before the start of the new season, in order to get all players and rosters updated and accurate for the new season. Review our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy for additional details.

bluejetty:00063176:ios.name: MultiSudoku: Samurai Sudoku
bluejetty:00063176:ios.summary: Play six different Samurai Sudoku variations in a single app! Start with the easier 2-Grid puzzles and advance all the way to the huge challenging 8-Grid puzzles. Each variation has a different overlapping grid configuration and provides a
bluejetty:00063176:ios.description:
Play six different Samurai Sudoku variations in a single app! Start with the easier 2-Grid puzzles and advance all the way to the huge challenging 8-Grid puzzles. Each variation has a different overlapping grid configuration and provides a unique twist of brain challenging logic.
With its diverse variations and straightforward no-frills game design, MultiSudoku brings a new dimension to Sudoku mobile gaming - on both iPad and iPhone. 
To help see the puzzle progress, graphic previews in the puzzle list show the progress of all puzzles in a volume as they are being solved. A Gallery view option provides these previews in a larger format.
For more fun, MultiSudoku contains no ads and includes a Weekly Bonus section providing an extra free puzzle each week.
PUZZLE FEATURES
• 104 free MultiSudoku puzzles
• Variations include puzzles with 2, 3, 4, 5 and 8 overlapping grids
• 2-Grid Combo variation combines Diagonal, Irregular and OddEven puzzles
• Extra bonus puzzle published free each week
• Multiple difficulty levels from easy to hard
• Puzzle library continuously updates with new content
• Manually selected, top quality puzzles
• Unique solution for each puzzle
• Hours of intellectual challenge and fun
• Sharpens logic and improves cognitive skills
GAMING FEATURES
• No ads
• Unlimited check puzzle
• Unlimited hints
• Show conflicts during gameplay
• Unlimited Undo and Redo
• Pencilmarks feature for solving hard puzzles
• Autofill pencilmarks mode
• Highlight Excluded Squares option
• Lock number on keypad option
• Concurrently playing and saving multiple puzzles
• Puzzle filtering, sorting and archiving options
• Dark Mode support
• Graphic previews showing puzzles progress as they are being solved
• Portrait and landscape screen support (iPad only)
• Track puzzle solving times
• Backup & restore puzzle progress to iCloud
ABOUT
MultiSudoku have also become popular under other names such as Samurai Sudoku, Combined Sudoku and Gattai Nanpure. All puzzles in this app are produced by Conceptis Ltd. - the leading supplier of logic puzzles to printed and electronic gaming media all over the world. On average, more than 20 million Conceptis puzzles are solved each day in newspapers, magazines, books and online as well as on smartphones and tablets across the world.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.conceptispuzzles.com/index.aspx?uri=info/doc/220

bluejetty:00177792:ios.description:
Ready for an epic Idle RPG War? Command adorable Slimes in this action-packed, AFK, auto-battle adventure! Collect loot, evolve heroes, conquer stages—even offline!
Humans have invaded the peaceful Slime forest. Rally your Slime clan, summon legendary heroes and monsters. Evolve your skills, and guard your homeland in endless battles for gold, rewards, and glory! Whether you're online or offline, your Slime keeps battling for endless rewards and upgrades!
Legend of Slime: Idle RPG War combines AFK rewards, strategic battles, endless progression, and charming monsters in a magical adventure!
Idle Auto-Battle & AFK Rewards
- Your heroes fight automatically—even when you’re offline!
- Enjoy hands-free gameplay with strategic auto-battles.
- Collect gems, gold, loot, and endless rewards anytime, anywhere.
Epic RPG Adventure & Strategic Battles
- Embark on an adventure with cute, collectible Slimes.
- Defeat warriors, knights, and fearsome bosses in endless battles.
- Plan your deck of slime, companions, gear, and items for strategic PvE and PvP showdowns.
Upgrade, Enhance, and Evolve
- Summon, collect, and level up your slimes to form your ultimate Slime legion.
- Enhance weapons, armor, and skills for unbeatable power.
- Unlock new features, evolve your Slimes, and customize your lineup!
Endless Loot & Events
- Smash enemies to plunder gold and treasures.
- Raid villages, conquer stages, and challenge various dungeons.
- Enjoy seasonal events, mini-games, and daily missions with epic rewards.
PvP Arena & Region Wars
- Test your strategy in competitive Arena battles.
- Join the regional wars and alliances.
- Climb the ranks and prove you're the ultimate Slime commander!
Why Gamers Love Legend of Slime: Idle RPG War
- Adorable Slimes in a cute-meets-action style!
- Casual gameplay perfect for busy players.
- Endless progression without heavy grinding.
- Free-to-play with generous AFK rewards and loot drops.
If you love idle RPGs, AFK auto-battlers, strategy RPG games, and adorable collectable heroes, *Legend of Slime: Idle RPG War* is your next obsession!
Download now and lead your Slime clan to victory in this epic idle RPG war!

bluejetty:00090821:ios.description:
Olive: Your Community, Your People
Olive is a community platform built to bring people together through friendships, events, group conversations, and meaningful relationships. Designed with Middle Eastern, North African, and neighboring communities in mind, Olive creates a space where culture, connection, and community come first.
Whether you're looking to make new friends, meet someone special, discover local events, or join conversations with people who share your background and interests, Olive makes it easy to build genuine connections in one place. Every profile is reviewed before joining to help create a respectful, authentic, and welcoming environment where members can connect with confidence.
What You Can Do on Olive
    •    Make Friends: Expand your social circle and connect with people in your community.
    •    Dating: Meet others who share your values, culture, and interests through a thoughtful dating experience.
    •    Community Events: Discover and attend local events, social gatherings, networking opportunities, and cultural experiences.
    •    Group Chats: Join conversations around shared interests, cities, hobbies, and community topics.
    •    Verified Community: Every member goes through a manual approval process to help maintain a safe and authentic community.
Olive is more than an app—it's a place to build friendships, create memories, celebrate culture, and strengthen the communities we call home.
EULA & Terms of Service: https://joinolive.com/tos
Privacy Policy: https://joinolive.com/privacy

bluejetty:00178855:ios.name: London Tube Live - Underground
bluejetty:00178855:ios.summary: London Tube Live is the most beautiful London Underground app you'll find. It includes all of the features you'll need - whether you're a commuter or a visitor - so you'll be able to navigate the tube with ease. Most importantly all functio
bluejetty:00178855:ios.description:
London Tube Live is the most beautiful London Underground app you'll find. It includes all of the features you'll need - whether you're a commuter or a visitor - so you'll be able to navigate the tube with ease. Most importantly all functionality can be used for free, with none of those annoying in-app purchases to unlock important functionality like you'll get with our competitors.
FEATURES
- Officially licensed London Underground map from TfL (Transport for London license number 23/M/3694/P).
- Live up-to-the-minute departure information for all tube lines, including DLR and London Overground (Powered by TfL Open Data)!
- Up-to-date Journey & route planner for all stations in the network, which takes into account engineering works!
- Tube exits - discover the best carriages to board so you're right at your exit when you leave the train!
- Find the first & last tube of the day - great for when you're on a night out!
- Line statuses & weekend engineering work details so you can plan ahead!
- Get directions to a station and find out whether it has facilities before you get there (whether it has a car park, toilets or a waiting room)
All of these features are included for free, you'll never be forced to pay anything extra with London Tube Live. Don't settle for less with other apps - download it today. It's similar to apps such as Tube Map, TfL Go, Citymapper and London Tube Deluxe.

bluejetty:00005454:android.description:
Hey~ we got this shop for you. Now, you'll be the only artist here and we really need your help. Uh-oh, we're getting busier as more and more guests come in. Give them fine makeup looks, dress them up nicely, and take good pictures for them. Oh, we have some VIP guests, serve them well and you'll get generous gifts. Moreover, makeup artists from all over the world will be invited to join an annual contest. Practice yourself and we believe you'll absolutely surprise them all!
Features:
- Choose from lots of gorgeous outfits and accessories
Pick the best outfits for the royals, and claim mysterious decorations.
- Listen to the guests and show us your sense of fashion
Get to know what the customers need, observe their preferences, then you'll be a really good stylist.
- Challenge other artists in world contest
Join the contest to stun the audience and win rare outfits and props!
- Come back and sign in every day
Remember to sign in every day, we got extra beauty tools and fashion outfits of limited edition for you!

bluejetty:00062705:ios.description:
No sign up required to start playing Spanish Safari! All subscriptions come with a 14 day free trial. Spanish Safari is the most comprehensive Spanish learning app for kids. Let's unlock their bilingual brains using our narrative-based gameplay, 3D animated characters, creative video lessons, and hundreds of activities to teach your child(ren) in the most fun and intuitive way. Our unique methodology is expertly designed for children 3-9 years old.
HOW DOES SPANISH SAFARI TEACH SPANISH TO MY CHILD?
OUR UNIQUE METHOD INVOLVES:
► INTERACTIVE LEARNING: Children are active participants in an amazing 3D world in which they explore in order to finish activities and collaborate with the animals of the savanna.
► GRADUAL IMMERSION: We don’t believe in throwing your kids into the deep end! With our one-of-a-kind system, Spanish Safari interacts with your child in both English and Spanish! As your child builds confidence and progresses through the syllabus, we carefully reduce the amount of English content to give them the best possible immersive experience.
► GAMIFIED LEARNING: Spanish Safari incorporates the same techniques used in the most popular games to keep kids engaged and motivate them to learn more educational content.
► SPACED REPETITION: Research shows that repetition of information that is spaced out over time is highly effective for long-term retention. We gradually increase the intervals of time to take advantage of this little-known, but super-important technique.
► STORY-BASED LEARNING: Spanish Safari - Spanish learning App incorporates an engaging narrative throughout the app to give your child a sense of ownership and purpose! Children are asked to join the World Explorers and help the local animals solve the mystery of the missing water. This clever storyline has been designed to keep kids interested and ensures that they are motivated to make it through to the end of the app to solve the mystery.
WHAT WILL MY CHILD LEARN INSIDE THE SPANISH SAFARI APP? 
TOPICS:
• Alphabet
• Phonological awareness
• Animals
• Numbers
• Shapes
• Colors
• Food
• Sports
• And So Much More!
FEATURES OF OUR SPANISH SAFARI - SPANISH LEARNING APP:
- A giant 3D Savanna to explore
- 170+ Lessons and Quizzes for kids
- 25+ Different interactive games for kids
- Different badges to motivate your kids
- 100+ New exciting video lessons for kids
- Spaced repetition of key Spanish vocabulary
- Awesome animations with 3D characters
- Newly designed Grammar Dojo for fun and practice of key principles
- Explorers’ HQ: Where your child will find access to hundreds of lessons, activities, mini-games, and more!
- Parent Portal: Specifically designed for you! You’ll have access to progress reports, settings, and account information
- A BONUS 76 Page printable workbook to supplement their learning
SUBSCRIBE TO OUR SPANISH SAFARI - SPANISH LEARNING APP's PRO PLANS:
- Spanish Safari Offers Two Premium Plans ►Monthly and ►Yearly
- Both plans have a 14-Day free trial before your subscription begins
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at the end of your free trial
- We will also send you a reminder on day 12 of your trial that your trial will end on day 14
Your subscription will automatically renew each month (or each year) 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your credit card will be charged through your iTunes account unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription.

If you are enjoying our Spanish Safari - Spanish learning app, please rate us on the app store. You can also reach our at development@learnsafari.com or you can visit our site at www.learnsafari.com.

bluejetty:00129623:ios.description:
Enter the colorful world of the Cross Stitch coloring quest! A relaxing color by number game for all ages, with a huge selection of beautiful cross stitch and embroidery sewing patterns. Cross-Stitch mandala comes with hundreds of beautiful mandala designs and patterns to work with solids, glitters, and crayons. A Cross-Stitch art design comes to life as you build it up stitch by stitch.
Creating your cross-stitch pattern can develop your creativity at home. The easiest way to create a cross-stitch pattern is to mimic the shape with mandala patterns. Cross-Stitch Mandala comes with over a thousand beautiful patterns to work on, just select the right color thread and click to place stitches. Drop all the colored cross-stitches in the correct place and watch your embroidery.
Concentrate on it, cross stitching the Landscapes, Famous Buildings with mandala designs, Famous Paintings. Craft products are embroidered with drawings for decorative clothes, home furnishings, or wall hangings. Just enjoy the leisure time with coloring mandala designs.
How To Play:
- First of all, watch a video tutorial to know how to start stitches.
- Choose a category and select your favorite image to color with numbers.
- Paint by numbers in this interesting sandbox coloring game.
- Pick up number colors and start painting pixel art images.
- Identify the target area by using the hints system that appear at the top of the app.
- Recolor & colorfy pages by just tapping to place stitches on the boxes or long-press for brush mode coloring experience.
- It looks like you are solving a color crossword.
- Complete the flower-rich mandala designs with soothing music.
- Get more hints or unlock pictures by watching ads.
- Get everything unlimited in the premium offer.
Features:
- Colouring by number activity perfect for adults.
- The perfect relaxing game for sewing enthusiasts.
- A large collection of beautiful Cross-Stitch patterns to play.
- Stress-relieving adult coloring book to color floral motifs with different colors.
- New patterns released regularly in this coloring activity.
- Great time killer, relieve your pressure and helps to forget your sadness.
- Practice cross-stitching skills and increase your creativity.
- You will get the feeling of actual cross stitching with this relaxing game.
A differently colored thread can make a subtle but important difference in your projects. Cross Stitching Mandala has a great history and some people still find it interesting to make old-style designs. All these designs look really antique, as something is forgotten a long time ago but still alive and meaningful. But if you know the route of each Cross Stitch Pattern your work won't be just a craft, it will be a message for everyone.
For those of you who want to try to create a cross-stitch pattern mania with your creations, we recommend this app to make it easier to design your cross-stitch pattern. When you are finished coloring cross-stitching, frame the finished piece and hang it beside the actual picture.

bluejetty:00145425:ios.summary:
► HAVE YOU GOT A TALENT FOR SEEING THE BIG PICTURE?

bluejetty:00145425:ios.description:
► HAVE YOU GOT A TALENT FOR SEEING THE BIG PICTURE?
Were you one of those children who could spend hours with their puzzles, whiling away a rainy afternoon or cold winter’s day putting together a 500-piece jigsaw of the Eifel Tower or London Bridge? Well, now you can revisit your childhood on your smartphone or tablet from anywhere in the world. Melt away from reality with this captivating puzzle game that challenges you to use your thinking skills to connect virtual pieces in real time and create unique images of increasing complexity. Arrange a variety of items to produce a pretty picture right on your screen, while developing your abilities as you progress through the levels. You’ll never be bored again!
► GET YOUR JIGSAW ON…ANYWHERE!
We all agree that solving puzzles is great fun, but it’s hardly practical to take one on the plane, train or bus. You’d be sure to lose some pieces and almost certainly run out of table space. Thanks to CPI, though, you can now get your puzzling fix wherever you find yourself. On your lunch break at work, waiting at the doctor’s office, or even standing in line at the supermarket, this one-of-a-kind game allows you to dive right in anytime.
► NO MORE INTERRUPTIONS
Remember when your mom would call you for dinner right in the middle of a puzzle? There’s nothing worse than being cut short when you’re in the zone. Instead of one picture with many pieces, CPI offers you many pictures with few pieces. Now, you never have to stop mid-puzzle – just quickly finish the level you’re on and pause until you can get back to work. It’s that simple!
► PICTURE THIS
Enjoy the thrill of recreating original artworks that get more and more complex as you progress through the game. From cute, animated characters and delicious dishes to space rockets and even a classic arcade machine, marvel at the wide range of enchanting images that materialize before your eyes as you connect piece after piece in this enthralling test of your thinking skills.
► TURN IT UP TO 100
Don’t you just hate it when a game is too short? Sometimes it seems like you’ve barely started and it’s already finished. With 100 progressively difficult levels to keep you occupied, CPI is one puzzle game that won’t disappoint. Start simple with 2-3-piece furry friends and go all the way up to double-digit brain teasers as you think your way to a hundred. You’ll forget what boredom felt like with this highly-addictive, drag and drop puzzler.
So, if you’re the sort of person who prefers thinking to racing, running or shooting, then this is just the game for you. CPI means no more pieces to lose, all you need is your mobile device, and you can jigsaw anywhere. Lose yourself in a magical world and kill time with your favorite pastime…all from the comfort of your phone or tablet.

bluejetty:00078712:ios.description:
What makes Privoto different from other photo vault apps?
None of the photo vault apps we investigated provide genuine data encryption. Essentially, these apps only offer a passcode screen as a form of protection when the application is launched. Consequently, the data stored in your phone remains unencrypted and susceptible to easy access.
In contrast, Privoto employs robust security measures by encrypting all imported photos and videos with a 256-bit encryption key. This key is directly linked to the passcode you establish for the app. This ensures that not only are others unable to access your data, but even we, as the app creators, do not have access to it. The exclusive individual with the ability to decrypt the data is the one possessing the passcode – you.
◉ KEY APP FEATURES AT A GLANCE
▸ Lock your photos and videos with passcode or Face/Touch ID.
▸ Most secure level of encryption: no hacker is able to break the encryption.
▸ Import photos and videos from your local camera roll.
▸ Use iCloud Sync to share photos & videos across devices securely.
▸ Copy & paste to import photos from other apps.
▸ Pin photo/video to the top of album.
▸ Minimal design: let the user focuses on their photos and videos.
▸ Transfer photos and videos from your computer via Wi-Fi.
▸ No ads at all.
▸ No register needed.
▸ Works offline without internet.
◉ PREMIUM FEATURES
▸ Easily transfer data to a new device.
▸ Separate passcode for each album.
▸ Safe mode passcode - enter separate album without sharing your real passcode.
▸ Disguise Mode.
▸ Login activities.
Are you excited to try it out to prevent unauthorized access to your photos and videos? Download Privoto today.
◉ WE LOVE FEEDBACK
If you have any feedback for us, please send an email to hello@ideanology.co.uk and we will be happy to act on it to improve your app experience.

bluejetty:00132559:ios.description:
Included Health is a healthcare benefit provided by employers to help members track healthcare spending, find a high-quality doctor, get 24/7 health advice, and more. We’re not an insurance company, but a team of healthcare experts available over the phone, in the app, or online.
Why use Included Health?
It’s free to activate. – You don’t have to pay a cent to access your benefits because your employer has already footed the bill. 
Primary, urgent and mental health care – See a board-certified doctor, licensed psychiatrist, or therapist in person or virtually with best-in-class care available 24/7.
Unbiased insurance and claims support – For billing issues, we work directly with your insurance to resolve problems for you.
Experts opinions from leading specialists – With access to 4,000 of the nation’s leading specialists, get the best doctor in the country to review your current care.
Experts available around-the-clock – With an on-call care team answering any healthcare questions, you get treated the way you deserve without having to wait on hold for answers.
Welcoming care for every community – We ensure every member from every community has access to high-quality care that’s safe, welcoming, and inclusive.
How It Works:
Download the app.
Enter your employer information.
Get access to amazing benefits offered at no cost to you.
Common healthcare needs Included Health supports
- Insurance and benefits questions
- Access to in-network, high-quality care
- Expert second opinions from leading specialists
- Support for chronic conditions
- Advocating for the healthcare needs of Black and LGBTQ+ patients
- Deductible, healthcare spending, and claims tracking
- Mental health support
- Prescription refills & lab orders via virtual care
Frequently Asked Questions
Who has access to Included Health?
Included Health is available to members and their covered dependents enrolled in an employer-sponsored benefits plan that includes coverage of Included Health. Top employers, including one third of the Fortune 100, provide this service so that employees have access to the best medical care possible. 
When is Included Health available to help?
While availability depends on your specific package, for millions of members, our team is available 24/7, 365 days a year, including weekends and holidays. 
Who are the doctors and specialists Included Health offers access to?
Included Health contracts with experts based on many indicators of quality, including their education and training, patient outcomes, and institutional affiliation. As a result, we’re able to match you with highly experienced doctors and specialists who are best suited to your personal preferences and medical needs. 
What can your virtual care providers treat? 
Our urgent care doctors can treat hundreds of issues, including cold and flu, urinary tract infections, allergies, headache, sprains, and skin conditions. They can also order labs and screenings to help with preventative care and help manage chronic care conditions. 
Is Included Health my insurance?
We’re not your insurance. We’re a health benefit offered by employers that works directly with your insurance on your behalf. So, instead of having to resolve claims issues on your own, we do the hard work for you. We have built extensive experience working with major insurance companies and can get claims processed and questions answered accurately.
*Not all benefits described above are available to all Included Health members. Services vary depending on your employer benefits package. 
Your Privacy is Our Priority
We adhere to strict HIPAA guidelines to protect your health data and personal information.
Our providers are unable to prescribe controlled substances. 
Get Started Today
Join millions of members who use Included Health to get healthcare designed to treat you better. Download the app now to activate for free!

bluejetty:00186699:ios.description:

Included tools:
• Datasheet search
• Equivalent parts search (cross reference for transistors, diodes and ICs)
• Resistor color and digit marking (4, 5 and 6 band color code; 2 symbols, 3/4 digit and EIA-96 code SMD resistors code)
• Electronic schematic symbols (IEC 60617, IEEE 315 and GOST standards)
• Pinouts of connectors and interfaces (USB, HDMI, DisplayPort, DVI, VGA, Thunderbolt, Apple Lightning and 30-pin, SATA, PCI Express and M.2, Ethernet RJ45 with PoE, RJ11/RJ14/RJ25, RS-232/422/485, IEEE 1394 FireWire, ATX, computer fans, SD card, audio jack, RCA, MIDI, XLR, PS/2, D-sub, SMEMA)
• Pinouts of boards and microcontrollers (Raspberry Pi and Pico, Arduino, ESP32, ESP8266, STM32 Nucleo, Teensy, Orange Pi, RADXA Rock Pi, LubanCat, Flipper Zero, ATmega and ATtiny)
• Ohm's law calculator
• AWG converter (wire diameter, cross-section area, resistance and maximum current)
• Resistor for LED
• Voltage divider
• Wheatstone bridge (output voltage or unknown resistance, current and power of every arm)
• Capacitor code
• Capacitor markings
• Capacitor ESR tables
• Frequency response curve calculation of passive filters (RC, RL, RLC, LC)
• Inductor color code
• Air-core coil calculator (inductance or number of turns of a single-layer solenoid)
• Ideal transformer (winding turns, voltages and currents)
• Linear current regulator
• SMD packages list
• Reactance
• PCB trace resistance
• Active, apparent and reactive power
• RMS converter (peak, RMS and peak-to-peak values for seven waveform shapes)
• 555 waveform generator
• Operational amplifiers
• RLC circuit
• Number conversion
• Unit converter
• Cable voltage drop
• Battery life (runtime of a battery pack, with discharge curve)
• NTC thermistor resistance
• Logic gates
• RC circuit
• Decibels calculator

• Fuse color marking

• SMD components marking codes
• Diodes color code (Pro Electron, JEDEC and JIS-C-7012 standards)
• Linear voltage regulator
• Resistor value to color or SMD code marking converter
• Voltage rectifier
• Series or parallel electrical components' connection calculator
• Diode voltage drop
• Minimum PCB trace width
• Analog to digital conversion
• Attenuators
• 4-20 mA signal converter
• Thermocouple calculator
• Resistance thermometer
• Buck switching voltage regulator
• Wire resistance
• Zener diode regulator (Zener diode and series resistor selection from a catalogue of 438 parts)
• Load cell (bridge output voltage to weight, force, pressure or torque)
• BJT voltage divider biasing
• Transformer turns per volt (from core area, flux density and frequency)
• Junction temperature (with or without a heatsink, power derating curve)
• Solar string dimensioning (minimum voltage and current ratings for a PV array)
• Solar cable and fuse selection (NEC and IEC rules)
• 555 astable generator with variable duty cycle
• NTC thermistor in a voltage divider and with an ADC input

bluejetty:00061817:ios.name: Video Surveillance Ivideon
bluejetty:00061817:ios.summary:
Ivideon offers one of the best apps for video surveillance, remote video monitoring, and video recording for security cameras, DVRs, and NVRs.
It lets you keep tabs on things while you’re away, with event notifications and recordings stored
bluejetty:00061817:ios.description:
Ivideon offers one of the best apps for video surveillance, remote video monitoring, and video recording for security cameras, DVRs, and NVRs.
It lets you keep tabs on things while you’re away, with event notifications and recordings stored either locally or in the Ivideon cloud.
Ivideon easily supports both single and multiple locations. It tracks what matters most to you, no matter where you are. It keeps you updated on important events in real time and stores those events in the cloud for easy access.
Ivideon’s video-surveillance service is scalable, simple, and reliable. From a webcam monitoring a home to an IP-camera network serving an international business, Ivideon can handle it.
Every day, more than 2,000,000 individuals and businesses use Ivideon to:
• access high-quality video online (with sound) through any standard connected device including iPhone, iPad, Mac
• record and store video in the cloud with guaranteed reliability and data security
• receive automatic push- and e-mail notifications of suspicious movements or sounds
• quickly search and view recorded surveillance video
• access quality video over any bandwidth down to 3G
• easily expand to any number of cameras
• share camera access with PTZ, Archive, and Live options
• transfer and store data securely
• embed surveillance feeds in websites or blogs
• share camera links over social networks
• search video events linked to POS, access control, and home automation systems
Ivideon is safe. Ivideon is simple to install and maintain. And Ivideon is accessible from anywhere—but with all the functionality of more expensive and complex solutions.
And if you get stuck, our help desk is ready 24/7.
Plug and play
Big-name cameras like iLuv, Oco, Philips, Axis, Dahua, Hikvision, Milesight, and many others, love Ivideon right out of the box. Plug and play—no computer needed.
But all cameras—Swann, Lorex, FLIR, D-Link, Foscam, TRENDnet, EasyN, ACTi, Edimax, TP-Link, Logitech, Belkin, and many others—can be configured to work with Ivideon quickly and easily. All you need is a computer with an Internet connection and to download our free Ivideon Server app here: http://www.ivideon.com/get/. In five minutes you’re good to go.
See how easy it is, for free!

bluejetty:00123770:ios.name: Halloween Car Match Games
bluejetty:00123770:ios.summary:
Beep beep! Do you love cars, driving, and matching games? 
Car Match 2026 - Traffic Jam for kids is a playful app designed especially for everyone that LOVE cars!! 
Created by teachers with over 15 years of childcare experience, this app
bluejetty:00123770:ios.description:
Beep beep! Do you love cars, driving, and matching games? 
Car Match 2026 - Traffic Jam for kids is a playful app designed especially for everyone that LOVE cars!! 
Created by teachers with over 15 years of childcare experience, this app is built around learning through play and is perfect for families looking for engaging car games for kids and car games for toddlers.
Car Match brings together driving, matching, and problem-solving in a gentle, age-appropriate way. Whether your child enjoys a simple car puzzle, cruising down the road, or tapping along to music, this app offers a calm and fun introduction to early learning through cars.
Driving and Traffic Jam Fun
In Car Match, little drivers hop into colorful cars and explore themed roads filled with fun surprises. Children will drive forward and slow down to avoid obstacles, helping them practice timing, coordination, and focus. The Traffic Jam style gameplay encourages kids to tap at the right moment, building early decision-making skills in a relaxed, playful environment.
This driving mode makes Car Match a favorite car game for boys and girls who love cars but are not ready for fast or overwhelming gameplay. It’s designed to be friendly, forgiving, and just challenging enough for young learners.
Car Puzzles 
Car Match also features adorable car puzzles created especially for toddlers and preschoolers. Children match shapes, colors, and vehicles while strengthening memory and recognition skills. These car puzzles are simple, rewarding, and perfect for early learners who enjoy hands-on play. As kids explore the puzzles, they build confidence and problem-solving skills while enjoying one of the most gentle and engaging car games for toddlers available on iOS.
Music, Movement, and Dancing Cars
For children who love sound and movement, Car Match includes playful interactive scenes where cars react with music and motion. Kids can tap to make cars move, dance, and respond, helping develop cause-and-effect understanding and sensory awareness. These moments of free play make Car Match feel joyful and expressive, especially for younger children just discovering games.
Designed by Teachers, Loved by Kids
Car Match was created by educators who understand how young children learn best. The app encourages fine motor skills, early thinking, and curiosity in a safe and supportive environment. Parents looking for a car game for boys, girls, and toddlers will appreciate the calm pacing, simple controls, and educational focus.
If your child enjoys car games for kids, Traffic Jam style driving, and fun car puzzles, Car Match is a wonderful choice. With colorful visuals, engaging activities, and a learning-through-play approach, Car Match turns everyday screen time into meaningful playtime for little drivers.

Use HomeKit scenes,
bluejetty:00170649:ios.description:
Pushcut helps you kick off your automation when it matters. Create fine-tuned interactions for HomeKit, Shortcuts, and custom workflows through smart notifications and widgets combined with powerful automation actions. 
Use HomeKit scenes, shortcuts, online integrations, and web services as notification actions that pop up exactly when they matter to you. Trigger these smart notifications from Shortcuts, HomeKit, schedules, locations, iBeacons, online services (like IFTTT, Zapier, Flow, Integromat, ...), home servers, or anywhere that knows what HTTP is.
Design beautiful custom widgets and display dynamic information that you can provide using Shortcuts actions, online services or our own API.
"The premiere companion utility for Shortcuts and Home on iOS" - Federico Viticci (MacStories)
"An essential tool for HomeKit power users" - Christopher Close (HomeKit Hero)
"Very powerful" - Rosemary Orchard (Take Control of Shortcuts)
Features
+ Set up alerts & reminders to trigger scheduled & location-based smart notifications
+ Combine time and location triggers (eg: "weekdays at 6 PM when I am at work")
+ Schedule notifications from Shortcuts
+ Schedule a shortcut from Shortcuts
+ Design custom home-screen widgets
+ Trigger notifications and widget updates through a secure webhook or Pushcut API
+ Trigger notifications and widget updates from third-party integrations and online services like Zapier, Integromat, IFTTT, etc.
+ Define notifications with custom titles and messages
+ Add action buttons to the notifications for quicker access
+ Run shortcuts directly from notification actions
+ Activate HomeKit scenes directly from notification actions
+ Add URLs to the push notifications and open them directly from the notifications
+ Run online actions (webhooks, HTTP requests) directly from notifications without opening any app or website
+ Execute online actions in the background based on location or iBeacon events
+ Customize notification sounds and images
+ Deliver push notifications to specific devices individually
+ Use a powerful JSON API to deliver dynamic texts, shortcut inputs, and URLs
+ Turn a dedicated iOS device into your personal Shortcuts and HomeKit server
Apple Watch
+ Interactive notifications (requires watchOS 6)
+ Run HomeKit scenes, online actions, and HTTP requests (like IFTTT webhooks) directly from your wrist
+ Execute multiple actions from one notification (with "Keep Open" flag)
(Note: Opening Shortcuts, Safari, or other apps is not supported on Apple Watch)
Free version limits:
+ define up to 3 notifications
+ define up to 2 background actions
+ define up to 1 action per notification
+ use with local triggers or basic webhooks (no dynamic content or online actions)
— Pro —
+ custom dynamic widgets
+ unlimited notification definitions
+ unlimited actions per notification
+ activate HomeKit scenes
+ unlimited background actions
+ dynamic notifications from service integrations
+ fully customizable actions using the powerful JSON API
+ execute online actions and web requests directly
+ input parameters for shortcuts and online actions
+ run and monitor an Automation Server (limits apply)
— Automation Server Extended —
+ schedule server actions periodically
+ trigger delayed server actions
+ up to 5000 server requests per day
Payments
You can subscribe to a monthly or annual subscription plan. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the time of purchase. A subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after making the purchase.
Terms of Use: https://www.pushcut.io/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.pushcut.io/privacy

bluejetty:00033017:ios.description:
Stay up-to-date with the latest news and weather in the Des Moines, Iowa area on the all-new free WeAreIowa app from ABC 5. 
Our app features the latest breaking news that impacts you and your family, interactive weather and radar, and live video from our newscasts and local events.
LOCAL & BREAKING NEWS
• Receive real-time notifications for breaking news
• Read the latest news as it happens in your area
• Explore exclusive investigative stories
• Browse photos, news clips, and raw video
LOCAL WEATHER
• Daily and hourly forecasts for your city
• The latest forecasts from our meteorologists
• Interactive radar maps
• Sign up for government-issued severe weather alerts in your area
LIVE VIDEO
• Watch live video newscasts and breaking news from WeAreIowa 
PERSONALIZATION
• Discover and dive into topics that matter to you
• Favorite topics to receive personalized updates
Other Features:
• Share stories & videos directly with your friends and family
• See the latest updates and behind the scenes photos from your favorite anchors and reporters
• Get information on school delays & closings as they happen
• Cast videos and livestreams directly to your TV or streaming device, so you can lean back and enjoy your favorite programming on your biggest screen.
This is the official app of ABC 5 and WeAreIowa.com, the ABC affiliate serving the Des Moines, IA area.
Got feedback? Let us know how we can make this the best app experience for you! Send us a note at appfeedback@tegna.com.

Do Not Sell My Information: https://www.weareiowa.com/do-not-sell-my-information

bluejetty:00115439:ios.description:
Welcome to Nuts Up! – A Fun Puzzle for Sorting Nuts & Bolts
Why You’ll Love Sorting Nuts & Bolts in Nuts Up!
At first, sorting nuts and bolts by color may seem easy, but each new level brings a fresh challenge. As you progress through the puzzle, the difficulty increases, requiring more strategic thinking to sort the nuts and bolts with precision. The more you sort, the more satisfying each nut sort puzzle becomes.
Features You’ll Love About This Nuts Sort Puzzle:
Addictive Nut Sort Puzzles: Sort nuts and bolts across a variety of colorful and challenging puzzles. Each level offers a unique color sort challenge that gets progressively more complex.
Simple, Yet Strategic: The gameplay is simple to understand, but solving the nut-sorting puzzles requires you to think ahead and plan your moves to complete each color puzzle efficiently.
Stunning Graphics: Enjoy vibrant, colorful nuts and bolts in a beautifully designed puzzle game that will keep your eyes and mind engaged as you progress.
Challenging Levels: Unlock new levels and face more intricate nut sort puzzles with different combinations of nuts, bolts, and colors that will test your problem-solving skills.
How to Play the Nut Sort Puzzle:
In Nuts Up!, your goal is to sort nuts and bolts by color into their correct spaces. It may sound simple, but as the levels progress, the challenges get tougher, with limited spaces and more complex color sort puzzles. Think ahead, plan your moves, and use your logic to solve each nut-sort puzzle efficiently.
Why Play Nuts Up!?
Brain Training: Sharpen your mind with nut-sort puzzles that require strategic thinking and logical reasoning. The game is designed to engage your brain and keep you sharp!
Fun & Relaxing: While each level is challenging, the gameplay is also relaxing and rewarding. It’s a perfect balance of fun and mental stimulation, allowing you to unwind while still being engaged.
New Levels & Challenges: As you progress, unlock new levels with more difficult nut-sort and color-sort puzzles. Each new level introduces fresh challenges and even more exciting nuts and bolts puzzles.
Extra Features That Make Nuts Up! Stand Out:
Special Power-Ups: Stuck on a level? Use special tools to help you sort nuts and bolts faster and with more precision.
Unlock Achievements: Track your progress as you unlock new nut sort puzzles and earn rewards for your efforts.
Endless Puzzle Fun: With hundreds of levels to explore, Nuts Up! offers endless entertainment for puzzle lovers. New nuts, bolts, and color sort puzzles are regularly added to keep the excitement going.
Ready to Master Nut Sorting?
Download Nuts Up! Sort & Match Puzzle today and start your journey through hundreds of exciting nuts and bolts puzzles! Sort nuts and bolts by color, unlock new levels, and become a nut-sorting puzzle master! The fun never ends!

• Learn Filipino

• Very Helpful when you travel Philippines

【应用简介】
你的人生剧本已加载！一秒穿书，人生结局由你掌握！
海量互动故事等你解锁，丰富的支线剧情自由选择，超多理想型男主等你攻略！
这里汇聚了众多原创互动故事，《女寝皆是修罗场》等都市校园类、《頭七》等末世怪谈类、《后宫三千人》等宫斗权谋类、《顶级练习生》等恋综娱乐圈类，更有都市豪门、穿越重生异世、末世怪谈无限流等丰富题材。
无论你是漫画迷、动画迷还是小说迷，橙光作品都能满足你！在攻略心仪男主的同时，还能享受高自由玩法的乐趣。海量互动作品等你来挑选，更有丰富福利活动等你来参与！
【平台特色】
海量佳作，任你选择
橙光APP汇聚数万部热门作品，古风类包含宫斗宅斗、宫廷权谋、江湖仙侠、修仙玄幻等，现代类包含豪门、娱乐圈、校园、名利场、怪谈等，还有奇幻类、悬疑类、兽世、异世玄幻等等……多元剧情任你挑选，每一部作品都是独一无二的创意世界。更有海量免费佳作，让你畅享阅读的乐趣，无限畅玩！
自由选择，剧情由你
在橙光，你是命运的主宰者。选择不同的剧情走向，探索属于你的独特结局。无论是纯爱战神还是多情海后，你的每一个选择都将开启全新的故事篇章。
深度客串，演绎梦幻人生
是否曾幻想过穿越书中，成为那个令人心动的角色？在橙光，你可以深度客串，以第一视角体验充满未知和惊喜的梦幻人生。每一个选择，每一次冒险，都将编织成你独一无二的传奇。
正版素材，激发无限创意
在橙光，我们尊重每一位创作者的权益。所有作品中的音乐、立绘、CG等素材均来自正版渠道，满足你创作各种题材故事的需求。
影视原著，由你创造
简单易学的制作工具，让每一个热爱故事的你都能成为创作者。准备好你的故事和热情，用橙光APP将你的创意变为现实。下一个橙光大神，就是你！
古风迷的挚爱：《龙雏》《后宫三千人》《为妃作宰》《青史何名》《海王修仙手册》等大热古风作品，包含宫斗、宅斗、仙侠、玄幻、江湖风云等各种剧情，让你沉浸在宫廷风云中感受宫斗、宅斗的紧张刺激；或是探索仙侠世界，领略玄幻江湖的风云变幻。
现代题材的盛宴：《一夜成名》《养鱼艺术家》《猎心人》《顶级练习生》《女寝皆是修罗场》《国服校花》等现代题材的作品，无论你是喜欢恋综、校园青春、娱乐圈争霸还是都市豪门恩怨，这里都能找到你的热爱！橙光APP带你领略现代都市的多彩魅力，满足你对现代题材的所有幻想！
穿越、玄幻、悬疑大冒险：《頭七》《兽世冤种实录》《重生之我是大佬》《十月怪谈》等穿越、玄幻、悬疑、怪谈类作品，带你穿越时空，感受玄幻、悬疑、怪谈的刺激与神秘。一秒代入角色，开启你的奇幻之旅！
橙光作品满足了漫画粉、动画粉、小说粉们的多重需求，海量互动作品随心选择，超多福利活动邀你体验！
【自动续费花篮】
--花篮权益：每日领取花篮花。
--订阅周期：1个月(花篮连续包月产品)，3个月(花篮连续包季产品)，3个月(花篮连续包半年产品)，12个月(花篮连续包年产品)。

--付款：用户确认购买并付款后记入iTunes账户。
--取消续订：如需取消续订，请在当前订阅周期到期前24小时以前，手动在iTunes/Apple ID设置管理中关闭自动续订功能。
--续订：苹果 iTunes 账户会在到期前 24小时内扣费，扣费成功后订阅周期顺延一个订阅周期。
--隐私政策：http://www.66rpg.com/user/userprivate

bluejetty:00039586:ios.summary: Pazarama, a subsidiary of İş Bankası, is a comprehensive online shopping app that combines all the products and services consumers need into a single platform. It offers fast and reliable solutions for every aspect of life, including online
bluejetty:00039586:ios.description:
Pazarama, a subsidiary of İş Bankası, is a comprehensive online shopping app that combines all the products and services consumers need into a single platform. It offers fast and reliable solutions for every aspect of life, including online shopping, hotel bookings, flight tickets, car rentals, pet supplies, in-car fuel payments, and online grocery delivery.
Pazarama Is Always by Your Side in Online Shopping Bringing a fresh breeze to online shopping, Pazarama lets you compare electronic products from top brands for your needs, such as mobile phones, computers, tablets, TVs, and small home appliances. Take advantage of current campaigns and enjoy rewarding shopping.
Find furniture, home decor, and home textile brands to transform your house into your favorite living space, and refresh your home in no time with fast delivery options. Follow the latest fashion in women's, men's, kids', and baby wear, and discover standout brands in personal care and cosmetics. If you love sports, check out sports and outdoor products from leading global brands, and easily complete your grocery shopping all in one place.
Boyner, Arçelik, Samsung, Koton, Madame Coco, Ebebek, Bosch, BKM Kitap, Atasun Optik, Mavi Jeans, Monster, Özdilek, Altınbaş, Birkenstock, Hotiç, Hummel, Schafer, Sportive, Kütahya Porselen, Pro Plan, Arzum, Cosmetica, and many more trending brands are with you at Pazarama!
Shop according to your budget thanks to Credit Card, Cash Advance in Installments, Shopping Loans, Maximum Card offers, PazaramaPoints, Pazarama Limit, and MaxiPoints advantages.
Pazarama Plus Privileges Designed to add value to your shopping experience, Pazarama Plus is an exclusive membership program open to all members. As a Pazarama Plus member, you can enjoy free shipping, earn PlusPoints on every purchase, and gain extra privileges at Pazarama Vacation. Save money while fulfilling your needs with exclusive discounts and offers tailored for Plus members.
Explore the World with Pazarama Vacation Always with you wherever you go, Pazarama offers accommodation, flight ticket, and car rental services through Pazarama Vacation. Incredible deals await you in top European cities like Paris, Rome, Berlin, and Amsterdam, as well as dream vacation spots in Türkiye including Istanbul, Izmir, Ankara, Bodrum, and Antalya.
Pazarama Pet Pazarama Pet is your go-to destination for all your pets' needs! Create a personalized profile for your furry friends and instantly order the products best suited for them. Whether you have a cat, dog, fish, bird, rodent, or reptile, everything they need is at Pazarama Pet! Get ready to discover pet food, hygiene and care items, pet toys, treats, and many more trending products.
Pazarama Insurance By your side in every aspect of life, Pazarama helps protect your future against unexpected situations with Pazarama Insurance. Offering a wide range of products, Pazarama Insurance provides solutions tailored to your needs, including Private Pension, Life Insurance, Traffic Insurance, Motor Insurance, International Travel Insurance, DASK (Earthquake Insurance), Health Insurance, Home Insurance, and Personal Accident Insurance.
Pazarama Mart All your home essentials are delivered right to your door with a single click! From fresh fruits and vegetables to basic groceries, cleaning supplies, and personal care products, thousands of supermarket items are just a click away with Pazarama Mart. Complete your kitchen shopping effortlessly with fast delivery and great deals.

bluejetty:00040548:ios.name: AI Translator・ Voice Translate
bluejetty:00040548:ios.summary: Our Translator is built on cutting-edge AI technology, making it your ultimate tool for seamless communication and understanding. With the power of artificial intelligence at its core, the app delivers precise and contextually accurate tran
bluejetty:00040548:ios.description:
Our Translator is built on cutting-edge AI technology, making it your ultimate tool for seamless communication and understanding. With the power of artificial intelligence at its core, the app delivers precise and contextually accurate translations across voice, text, objects, camera, and conversations. Whether you're traveling, studying, or working, Translator is designed to meet all your language needs with AI-driven efficiency, ensuring smooth and natural communication in any scenario.
Features:
> AI Magic Translator
Experience the next level of translation with our AI-powered Magic Translator. This core feature uses advanced AI to deliver more accurate and nuanced translations, minimizing misunderstandings and errors. Whether you're translating complex sentences or casual conversations, AI ensures every translation captures the right meaning.
> Voice Translator
Instantly translate your spoken words into any language with AI-enhanced precision. Speak into the app, and Translator will convert your speech into your chosen language with remarkable accuracy, making it perfect for on-the-go conversations.
> Conversation Translation
Break down language barriers in real time! Engage in seamless two-way conversations with foreign speakers. AI listens to both sides of the conversation, instantly translating to make communication smooth and natural.
> Object Translation
Translate the world around you with AI-powered object recognition. The app identifies up to three objects in real time and provides instant translations. Perfect for shopping, sightseeing, or satisfying your curiosity.
> Camera Translation
Use your camera to capture text and get instant translations with AI-enhanced accuracy. Snap a photo of signs, menus, documents, or any text, and Translator will quickly and accurately deliver the translation.
> 130+ Languages Supported
Access translations in over 130 languages, thanks to AI-driven optimization. Whether for major languages or lesser-known ones, the AI ensures flexibility and accuracy in connecting with people worldwide.
> User-Friendly Interface
The AI-enhanced interface provides an intuitive, smooth experience, allowing you to access all features effortlessly.
> Offline Mode
Stay connected even without the internet. Download AI-optimized language packs for offline use, ensuring you can translate and communicate wherever you are.
AI Translator is more than just an app; it's your personal language assistant, helping you navigate and understand the world around you.

bluejetty:00181207:ios.name: Connect Master - Tile Matching
bluejetty:00181207:ios.summary: Connect Master - Tile Matching is an adventure-themed onnect pair matching puzzle game with various game theme skins. Let you go on an adventure as an explorer while having fun and relaxing simultaneously. You can feel the warmth and harmon
bluejetty:00181207:ios.description:
Connect Master - Tile Matching is an adventure-themed onnect pair matching puzzle game with various game theme skins. Let you go on an adventure as an explorer while having fun and relaxing simultaneously. You can feel the warmth and harmony of the village tribe on the way and play on the sunny ocean beach. You can also visit the icy animal kingdom, find the mysterious magic forest and enjoy the desert culture. So, come on and try it out!
【Features】
1. Colorful collections of tiles - onnect cute animals, beautiful flowers, fruits & other cute things, impact your visual senses.
2. Set the game mall; you can buy the game props you need with gold as you like.
3. Game resurrection function, in case you fail to challenge, allows you to resurrect and challenge the game again.
4. You can log in to your Google and Facebook accounts and automatically save the level upgrade progress so that you can play anytime, anywhere!
5. Multi-language options
【How to play】
1. To connect and match, you need to find two tiles with the same pattern in a pile of pattern tiles.
2. In connecting two tiles with the same pattern, you can only use a maximum of three straight lines to connect them.
3. If you encounter difficulties, do not be discouraged; you can use powerful game props to get help.
4. You must match all the tiles successfully within the time limit; otherwise, the challenge fails.
【How to win】
1. Familiar with the game props function and flexible use of game props. Our game will provide you with four types of game props; they are to replace the pattern category, change the pattern position, eliminate the tiles and find the matching tiles.
2. You need to eliminate all the tiles in the fastest time; the shorter the time, the higher the score.
3. Insist level by level, get the star score reward, get the star treasure box, and give you various game props and theme awards!
4. You can play the game to win gold coins and use the gold coins to buy game props in the store to help you upgrade the game level!

Tired of asking strangers to take your photo? Be your own photographer.
LensPal turns your iPhone into a personal photoshoot assistant. Set it up, strike a pose, and let the app capture dozens of professional-looking shots automatically.
PERFECT FOR:
- Solo travelers who want stunning vacation photos
- Content creators building their Instagram, TikTok or YouTube
- Anyone who wants outfit pics without bothering roommates

Set your phone on any surface. Choose how many photos you want. Walk into frame. LensPal handles the rest — taking shot after shot until you get THE one.

- Burst Sessions — Take 5, 10, 50+ photos automatically
- Smart Delay — 3 to 60 seconds to get into position
- Interval Control — Set exact timing between each shot
- Built-in Gallery — Rate and pick your best shots instantly
- Portrait Mode — Professional background blur
- 48MP Capture — Full resolution on supported iPhones
- Video Mode — Same hands-free magic for video content
Stop satisfying with awkward arm-length selfies.
Start creating content that looks like someone else took it.

bluejetty:00024890:ios.description:
Plant App identifies more than 46,000+ plants with 95% accuracy-better than most human experts. 
Most accurate plant Identifier app on the market with the latest AI plant identification technology. 
Did you just come across a flower, herb, or weed that you don't know?
Simply take a photo of the plant and Plant App will complete a plant identification to answer all your questions about it!
Take care of your plants with Plant App — keep a journal to see how they grow, use reminders to help them thrive.
Our plant identification engine is always picking up new knowledge from experts and professionals, and it's all at your fingertips right now. Simply discover plants around you, identify plants, and you'll gain a new appreciation for nature.
–PLANT APP FEATURES–
PLANT IDENTIFIER
Identify plants instantly with our app! Our database contains over 12,000 plants, including flowers, succulents, and trees. To identify a plant, simply snap a photo or upload one from your gallery. But that's not all! Our plant identifier feature isn't limited to plant identification. We also have additional features like tree identification, flower identification, and weed identification. 
We're proud to offer the most accurate plant identifier app on the market, which includes additional features like tree identifier, weed identifier, and flower identifier.
PLANT CARE & DISEASE IDENTIFICATION
Identify plant diseases to quickly figure out ways of treating your plant.
Take a photo to determine diagnoses. Plant App will eliminate any potential disease-causing factors and notify you if your plant is healthy. Plant App will tell you if it needs special attention and how to take care of it. You'll receive comprehensive information about the condition, its causes, treatments, and prevention measures.
PLANT CARE GUIDES
Imagine, you receive a lovely flowering plant for your birthday. However, after a few weeks, it begins to send you signals that it is not at ease. How frequently has this happened to you? To keep your plant alive, you must understand how much water, light, and fertilizer it requires. PlantApp keeps all of this information in one place.
Plant care guides are essential for healthy plants!
WATER CALCULATOR
Get customized watering recommendations, based on your plant type and the size of a pot.
NOTES AND REMINDERS
Have you forgotten to water your plants on time? Not any longer! Set up plant care reminders to receive notifications when it's time to water, fertilize, or repot your plant. If your plant has specific needs, you can even create custom reminders. Don't let your plant wither without timely reminders.
PERSONAL PLANT COLLECTION - MY GARDEN
Create your own garden and plant collections. Add plants in your home and confidently grow and care for your plants with the support and inspiration you need.
RECOMMENDED ARTICLES
Learn about the variety of flora around the world by reading enlightening articles every day.
What kind of plant grows the quickest, do you know? Or what flower once had a value greater than that of gold? Knowledge is power. You will have this power by Plant App's in-depth plant descriptions and fascinating insights.
Get Plant App plant scanner & start your road toward being a true expert on nature right away. One tap will provide you all you need!

bluejetty:00138529:ios.description:
Introducing Car Mechanic Shop Simulator 3D, the ultimate mobile game where you can live out your dreams of managing a thriving car parts empire and immerse yourself in the intricate world of automotive maintenance and repair. This simulation game offers a comprehensive, in-depth experience that combines strategic business management with the technical intricacies of car maintenance, making it a must-download for enthusiasts and newcomers alike.
Build Your Auto Parts Kingdom:
Start your journey with a modest shop and strategically expand it into a premier destination for car parts and accessories. Car Mechanic Shop Simulator 3D allows you to deal with everyday items such as oil filters, tires, and brake pads, as well as high-performance components like V8 OHV engine parts, advanced suspension systems, and high-tech electronics. Your decisions will not only shape the operational aspect of your business but also influence its financial health and market reputation.
Master Inventory Management:
Develop your skills in inventory management by handling an extensive array of automotive parts, including alternators, clutch kits, radiators, exhaust systems, and sophisticated electronic systems crucial for modern vehicles. Learn to master the art of inventory control, optimize pricing strategies, and respond to market demand. Watch as your car mechanic shop becomes a local industry leader known for its efficiency and reliability.
Customize and Expand Your Shop:
Car Mechanic Shop Simulator 3D provides an array of customization options. Personalize your space with a variety of design choices—select the layout, themes, and decorations that reflect your personal style to attract more customers. As your business grows, you're tasked with expanding your shop's physical space to accommodate an increasing inventory and broadening the range of services offered, from routine maintenance to specialized repairs and custom modifications.
Unlock New Auto Parts and Technologies:
In order to stay competitive in the fast-evolving automotive industry, you'll need to continuously unlock new car parts and technologies. Secure licenses to sell and install advanced parts that meet the diverse needs of car enthusiasts and professional repair shops. This feature ensures your store remains at the cutting edge, offering the latest innovations in automotive technology, from hybrid engine components to autonomous vehicle systems.
Ensure Customer Satisfaction:
Car Mechanic Shop Simulator 3D places a strong emphasis on customer satisfaction. Pay close attention to customer feedback and adapt your business strategies to meet their expectations. Excellent customer service is pivotal in building a robust clientele base that depends on your shop for all their automotive needs, from simple oil changes to complex engine rebuilds.
Car Mechanic Shop Simulator 3D is not just a game; it’s a comprehensive simulation that tests your business acumen and management skills. Download now and prove that you can run the best car mechanic shop in the digital world!
IGRS rating: 13+

bluejetty:00015944:ios.name: zMahjong Solitaire by SZY
bluejetty:00015944:ios.summary:
This is the famous Zhongyuan Mahjong (Solitaire)! This game demands huge observation, great patience and challenging spirit! This is also an extremely relaxing game that tens of thousands of people are enjoying it every day! 
***Game goal
bluejetty:00015944:ios.description:
This is the famous Zhongyuan Mahjong (Solitaire)! This game demands huge observation, great patience and challenging spirit! This is also an extremely relaxing game that tens of thousands of people are enjoying it every day! 
***Game goal 
Clear the board by removing two identical tiles on a same line each time as quickly as possible. 
***Remove tiles
Two identical tiles on a same line are removable. Note that you can move tiles but only once.
****Game features 
The game proceeds with no hints, no help and no re-try. There is no any assistance to you but your hard observation. You can press the “End” button to see remaining removable pairs, but the game will end at the same time.
**** Compared with other games
Many people know similar games like Dikaku, Sichuan Mahjong or Shanghai Mahjong. But in fact, you will enjoy more in playing this game. The reason is that those games are merely static games, and you just play them passively. However, zMahjong is a dynamic game in that it keeps changing along with the whole game period. For example, when your game enters the mid-stage, you will probably find that it is becoming increasingly difficult and it seems as if there won't be any removable pairs. But often you will soon realize that once you can find out one pair, the whole game can totally change. Also, since the game allows tiles to be moved before one pair of tiles is removed, the game requires very much challenging spirit to find out the possible removable pairs. Once you can find out one pair and remove it, you will anticipate that new removable pairs can be created. Thus, whether you can finally complete the game or not, you have already been enjoying every step you have played. So that you will never be disappointed with yourself. You will start a new whether you have finished a game or not. This is zMahjong!
***World record (based on Game Center only, as of Aug 11, 2016)
Best Score: 1:37 by Juliett Bravo, Kristen Cooley, ++潇湘馆++
Most completion: 5,046 times by LPSdestin.
(Congratulation!)

bluejetty:00083516:ios.description:
Our app is designed to test the sound output of your device speaker, stereo systems, loudspeakers and other audio equipment. It’s perfect for anyone who wants to enjoy clear, high-quality sound. Also, with the help of the app, you can check the sound at different frequencies.
Here are the key features:
○ SOUND TEST & CHECK
This feature can help you identify any issues or areas for improvement with your device's sound. Just press the button and start sound checking.
○ TONE GENERATOR
Produce a wide range of tones and frequencies. You can set any value for the frequency to be tested. The application will be a great tool for checking the sound of your device's speaker, stereo systems, bluetooth speakers, etc. by testing at various frequencies in the range from 1 Hz to 22 000 Hz.
○ SOUND WAVEFORMS
The sound waveform display provides a visual representation of the sound being produced. You can choose the desired view - sine, square, or triangle.
○ STEREO & BASS TEST
Check the quality and performance of your device's bass and stereo output. The feature allows you to switch between stereo and bass and check the right and left channels, as well as change the playback speed.
○ HISTORY & GRAPHS
You can see a timeline of every cleaning session — how many times you've cleared water, dust, or debris from your speakers. The graphs show your device's speaker health over time.
○ BINAURAL BEATS*
We've added special frequencies and noises that will help you focus on important tasks, relax, or fall asleep easily.
○ NOISE MIXING*
Mix different types of noise and set a timer. This feature can be used for easy falling asleep.
○ SOUND METER
Instantly measure the noise level in dB and get a clear result.
○ BUILT-IN PRESETS
You can choose any of the ready-made presets to test the sound in the desired frequency range.
*Available with a subscription.
Overall, this app is an essential tool for anyone who wants to optimize their device's sound performance. With its range of features, our speaker cleaner app is an excellent choice for audiophiles, music lovers, and anyone who wants to enjoy clear, high-quality sound.
Important! We do not give a full warranty on cleaning your speaker. Various frequencies and sound vibrations can help clean the speaker if there is little dirt or water. In other cases, we recommend that you contact the service center.
We also would like to warn all users that sound testing at high volume can damage your devices or impair your hearing. We provide you with the best sound quality, but the final result depends on you. Please be careful.

The SikhNet Play app is supported thanks to the generous support of Avtar Singh Dhamija, of Akal Engineers and Consultants Ltd, Canada. SikhNet thanks Avtar Singh for his incredible enthusiasm to help the GMC app reach as many people as possible.

- SETTINGS - Customize the Gurbani Lyrics that display for audio, as well as change the audio quality setting according to your internet connection speed.

bluejetty:00071158:ios.description:
Chrome River provides highly-configurable cloud-based expense and invoice management solutions. Our suite of solutions offers a modern, elegant user experience to create, submit and approve expenses anywhere on any device. Now you can combine all the features of our solution with capabilities your mobile device provides, from biometrics to the camera, to easily access our web application. Because Chrome River is built with responsive design technology, you will always have a consistent user experience regardless of the device you are using. The Chrome River mobile app makes accessing the web application you know and love that much easier. 
This is an optional mobile application that can be downloaded to your personal device to help provide easier access to the Chrome River web app. We have made it easier for our users to access Chrome River on the go by allowing you to easily log in with biometric authentication or leverage single sign-on capabilities required by your organization. 
With Chrome River, you can:
 • Create, submit, and approve expense reports and invoices on-the-go
 • Capture and upload photos of your receipts with complete OCR functionality
 • Let business rules ensure expenses and invoices comply with spending policies.
 • Access your credit card data to quickly create expense reports. 
 • Itemize expenses including hotel receipts with Chrome River FOLIO
 • Easily log in using single sign-on authentication (SSO) or enable mobile biometrics like touch and face identification for simplified access
 • Much more
Learn more at www.chromeriver.com. Must be an existing Chrome River user.
System requirements: Chrome River's mobile apps support the most current generation and the 1 prior generation of iOS devices.
