bluejetty:00179519:ios.description:
المصحف المرتل هو تطبيق لسماع القرآن الكريم بأصوات قراء ومشايخ الوطن العربي.
يتميز التطبيق في هذا الإصدار بإحتوائه على القرآن الكريم كاملاً ل 48 من أشهر قراء الوطن العربي والإسلامي.
تصميم بسيط متطور عالي الجودة يتيح لك التنقل بين أجزاء التطبيق بكل سهولة ويسر.
يمكنك أيضاً التحكم في كيفية الإستماع فيمكنك الاستماع لنفس السورة مراراً وتكراراً أو مرة واحدة فقط أو الإستماع لسور القرآن بالترتيب.
التطبيق يتضمن مدير محتوى بحيث يمكنك تحميل أو تشغيل أو حذف أية سورة لأي قارئ قد قمت بتحميلها من قبل وذلك لتوفير المساحة التخزينية لجهازك.
يمكنك أيضاً تحميل جميع السور لقارئ معين أو حذف جميع السور لأي قارئ بضغطة زر.
يمكنك تصفح وقراءة القرآن الكريم من المصحف المدمج مع إمكانية عمل زووم لسهولة القراءة.
يمكنك البحث عن السورة التي تريد الإستماع إليها مباشرة لسرعة الوصول.
إمكانية تشغيل السور أثناء القيام بمهام أخرى على الجهاز في الخلفية أو في حالة وإن كانت الشاشة مغلقة لتوفير الطاقة.
برجاء إستخدام خاصية الإتصال بنا من داخل التطبيق في حالة إن وددتم إضافة قارئ جديد للتطبيق أو أي تعليق آخر.
------------------------------------------------------------
The Recited Quran is an app for listening to the Holy Quran with the voices of reciters from around the world.
The application is distinguished in this version by containing the entire Holy Quran for 45 of the most famous reciters of the Arab and Islamic world.
A simple, advanced, high-quality design that allows you to navigate between parts of the application with ease and simplicity.
You can also control how to listen, so you can listen to the same Surah repeatedly or only once or listen to the Surahs of the Quran in order.
The application includes a content manager so that you can download, play or delete any Surah for any reciter that you have downloaded before in order to save storage space on your device.
You can also download all the Surahs for a specific reciter or delete all the Surahs for any reciter with the push of a button.
A search box for the quick access of the Surahs.
You can browse and read the Holy Quran from the built-in Quran viewer with the ability to zoom for ease of reading.
The ability to play the Surahs while performing other tasks on the device in the background or in the event that the screen is closed to save power.

► Playable offline, making it easy to dive into the Word of God anytime, anywhere, without the need for an internet connection.

YOUR ALL-IN-ONE TOOL MANAGEMENT APP
Effortlessly manage, monitor, and maximize your tools with our app, designed to streamline your experience from registration to connected control. Whether you're registering your latest purchase, keeping
bluejetty:00165065:ios.description:
YOUR ALL-IN-ONE TOOL MANAGEMENT APP
Effortlessly manage, monitor, and maximize your tools with our app, designed to streamline your experience from registration to connected control. Whether you're registering your latest purchase, keeping tabs on your connected tools, or exploring our extensive product catalog, this app simplifies it all.
KEY FEATURES:
1. HOME DASHBOARD
 - Stay updated with the latest product releases, seasonal promotions, and personalized recommendations based on your tools and usage. 
 - Quickly view the status and key metrics of active tools at a glance. 
 - Discover accessories, tips, and promotions that help you get the most out of your tools.
2. TOOL BOX
 - Simplified product registration with OCR technology and barcode scanning to save time and improve accuracy. 
 - Access warranty claims and repair programs with ease to protect your investments. 
 - Quickly find post-purchase resources, such as product manuals, assembly instructions, and relevant accessories.
3. CONNECTED TOOLS 
 - Monitor and manage all your RYOBI™ connected tools from one convenient hub. 
 - View real-time updates tailored to each tool’s current state, such as charge levels, runtime, or error notifications. 
 - Rename tools, share access, update firmware, and track last-known locations directly from the app. 
 - Consolidated functionality from the RYOBI™ Riding Mower, Ryobi™ GenControl™, and RYOBI™ Hyper Charger apps into one platform, supporting all future connected tools.
4. EXPLORE PRODUCTS
 - Quickly scan barcodes or price labels to instantly access product details while shopping. 
 - Browse the full RYOBI™ product catalog with detailed specifications and features.
5. ACCOUNT & SETTINGS

bluejetty:00151847:ios.description:
Fortunate Arcane Pop offers a brand novel casual gaming experience. Whether you enjoy a challenge or prefer simple, relaxing gameplay, we have something for you!
Game Features
Challenge Yourself
You control the falling position of number balls to make balls with the same number meet and merge into a larger number. During this process, the balls cannot accumulate beyond a certain height, otherwise the game is over. Merging the target ball completes the level.
Simple and Casual
In the slot simulator, simply tap the spin button for a chance to obtain magic balls. Accumulating enough magic balls will trigger the Big Wheel, where you can spin for "Magnet" and "Wild Ball" power-ups – your strongest aids in synthesizing your target ball!
Opportunity and Challenge Coexist
During gameplay, power-up balls will be randomly generated. These help you trigger the Bing Wheel faster, but they also occupy your play space, increasing the difficulty of achieving your goal. These power-up balls cannot be eliminated until you complete the level.
Come and experience a whole novel world in Fortunate Arcane Pop!

bluejetty:00021991:ios.description:
"Instant Voice Translate" is a free and user-friendly language translation app powered by cutting-edge ChatGPT technology. Whether you're traveling abroad or connecting with people who speak different languages, this ChatGPT-powered app is your reliable companion.
===== FEATURES ===== 
1. Voice Translation: Speak naturally and let the app provide instant translations in real-time. Communicate effortlessly and break down language barriers.
2. Split-Screen: Talk easily with people from other cultures using the face-to-face feature. Have smooth bilingual chats and build connections easily.
3. Image Translation: Translate text within photos by capturing or importing them. Whether it's signs, menus, or documents, this feature helps you navigate the world around you with ease and confidence.
4. Text Translation: Obtain accurate and real-time translations for individual words or phrases, regardless of the context. No more language barriers hindering effective communication.
5. Slow Audio Playback: Don't worry about keeping up with normal audio playback. Utilize this feature to listen to translated phrases at a slower speed, allowing for better language learning.
6. ChatGPT Optimization: Boost the quality of translations using ChatGPT, ensuring more precise and natural translations.
7. Offline Translation: Translate while traveling, even if you don't have access to the Internet. Ideal for travelers or anyone who requires offline translation support.
Experience the remarkable capabilities of "Instant Voice Translate" and revolutionize your language interactions like never before. Download the app now and unlock a world of communication possibilities. Say goodbye to language barriers and hello to seamless conversations.
Choose from over 70 languages for translation and learning: 
▪ English
▪ Chinese - 中文
▪ French - Français
▪ German - Deutsch
▪ Hindi - हिन्दी
▪ Italian - Italiano
▪ Japanese - 日本語
▪ Korean - 한국어
▪ Portuguese - Português
▪ Russian - Русский
▪ Spanish - Español
There are more languages waiting for you to explore ...
===== PREMIUM ===== 
We offer premium subscription services on a monthly and yearly basis, granting users unlimited access to translation features and an ad-free experience. Upon subscribing:
* Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
* Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
* Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
* Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
* Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
TERMS OF USE

Experience entertainment like never before with RAVE, the smart app that explains any movie or TV show using advanced AI. Whether you’re exploring the latest blockbuster or revisiting a timeless classic, RAVE transforms how you discover, understand, and enjoy movies and series.

* AI Movie Explainer
Understand any movie or TV show instantly—our AI breaks down plots, characters, and themes so you never miss a detail.

Not sure what to watch next? Let our smart AI recommend movies and shows tailored to your taste.

Plan what to watch and when—because your time deserves great stories.

bluejetty:00166088:ios.description:

bluejetty:00069438:ios.description:
Will you be able to manage a fire station and become the firefighter tycoon? Idle Firefighter Tycoon is a rescue simulation and casual game that mixes firefighting management and earning money to become a rich billionaire while helping the city. 
Take control of emergency units, incident telephone calls, save lives, and much more. Handle the needs of your facility and make appropriate decisions to expand your business and improve the responsiveness of your area: customize your headquarters, expand parking spaces for fire trucks and fuel trucks; buy new and better fire trucks, install fire alarms, improve fire-retardant equipment for staff, or install new fire hydrants near important urban buildings. Each choice you make will have an impact on your development strategy! - Enjoy the dangerous adventure and challenge the different missions!
Expand your fire station office and increase productivity with firefighters who will automate the workflow of your city! - Online and Offline mode! Discover the manager's business strategy to invest in and earn as much cash as possible in this idle tycoon simulator - Live as a captain of a firefighter group! Make more money in this firefighter simulator until you become a rich manager tycoon! This is not a clicker game: no need for endless tapping like other idle simulators.
What are you going to do?
- Manage your firefighter team to rescue the city buildings (school, restaurant, hospital, shopping mall, and others) from dangerous fires and accidents.
- Use water cannons, fire trucks, and other special tools for the firefighter to extinguish the fire. 
- Hire manager staff to increase your firefighter's motivation and improve the business management.
- Build up multiple departments, such as emergency response staff, fire trucks, rescue teams, fire managers, etc. for rescue missions.
- Complete the firefighter missions and invest your idle money & cash to achieve the security levels required by the city.
IDLE FIREFIGHTER TYCOON - FIRE EMERGENCY MANAGER Features:
- Automate your fire station to make more idle income: no need for endless tapping like other online clicker or idle simulator games.
- Profit from investments to boost your cash income to make more money. You'll be a rich billionaire among the firefighting tycoon games.
- Build up your idle billionaire empire simulation without the endless tapping in other clicker and tycoon games!
- Develop the departments to resolve firefighting issues while earning money by optimizing the fire workstation in this idle manager game.
- Increase your idle money online or offline in this tycoon simulator game! 
- Upgrade firetrucks and emergency rooms to see exciting upgrades in this money and firefighting management simulator! 
- Different items that you can level up: Upgrade your firetrucks to make them faster and bigger! Upgrade your kitchen and bathroom so that your firefighters can prepare themselves faster. Level up your emergency room to become a rich tycoon in this idle simulation game!
Did you hear the fire alarm? It's time to get into your fire truck and rescue people's lives! Interesting missions are waiting for you. Try the game now and have fun!

bluejetty:00092203:ios.name: Attento Condomínios
bluejetty:00092203:ios.summary:
A ATTENTO Administração Condominial é uma empresa voltada e focada somente em administrar condomínio, na alta gestão com inovação e Tecnologia.
Para os condôminos, proporcionamos infraestrutura necessária para um atendimento de qualidade,
bluejetty:00092203:ios.description:
A ATTENTO Administração Condominial é uma empresa voltada e focada somente em administrar condomínio, na alta gestão com inovação e Tecnologia.
Para os condôminos, proporcionamos infraestrutura necessária para um atendimento de qualidade, e para os síndicos, prestamos serviços de qualidade e confiança na área administrativa, financeira, pessoal, contábil e jurídica, a fim de assessorar uma gestão mais tranquila e com bastante profissionalismo.
Respeitando o direito de escolha do nosso cliente e, proporcionando, um serviço de qualidade e na medida certa, atendemos de forma plena à expectativa e à necessidade do condomínio.
Tanto pelo site da ATTENTO quanto pelo aplicativo, os moradores, síndicos, conselheiros, funcionários e prestadores de serviço do condomínio podem realizar suas tarefas e organizar suas rotinas de forma simples, rápida, eficiente e acima de tudo de qualquer lugar e a qualquer hora.
Os recursos disponíveis vão desde a simples gestão dos boletos em aberto quanto à abertura de portas do prédio usando as integrações disponíveis no aplicativo. Tudo com o mesmo login e senha, recebendo pushs para questões mais importantes, acesso online e em tempo real.
Com a ATTENTO, a vida em condomínio é muito mais inteligente. Funcionalidades (variam conforme o plano habilitado):
- cadastro completo de condôminos, seus veículos, animais de estimação e outros moradores da unidade
- comunicação entre síndico e moradores com controle de pendências, grupos de discussão, achados e perdidos, avisos, manutenção, etc (com moderação).
- reservas no salão de festas, mudanças e outras agendas,
- acesso ao regimento e demais documentos do condomínio,
- boletos das taxas mensais - prestação de contas interativa mês a mês com anexos dos comprovantes e aprovação online da pasta
- visão da evolução dos gastos por conta e grupo de conta (Gastos com água, energia, contratos, manutenções, etc)
- comparativo de orçado versus realizado (gráficos e detalhamento)
- visão da inadimplência (relatórios e gráficos)
- gestão de contratos com terceiros
- gestão de manutenções preventivas e periódicas
- gestão e comunicação de multas e advertências com direito a defesa,
- visão da relação de funcionários e corpo diretivo do condomínio,
- cadastro de fornecedores e prestadores de serviço,
- acesso aos dados de departamento pessoal (folha, escala de férias, projeções)
- controle da entrada e saída de visitantes,
- autorização da entrada de visitantes,
- acesso às câmeras de segurança,
- avisos de chegada e retirada de encomendas,
- registro e publicação da leitura de água e gás,
- integração com sistemas de portaria remota, controle de acesso, automação e muito mais.
Qualquer dúvida ou questionamento, nos envie uma mensagem para attento@winker.com.br.

bluejetty:00183412:ios.description:
The Cousins Maine Lobster app is a simple and convenient way to place contactless orders, find our trucks and restaurants, and to earn loyalty points with every purchase that you can redeem for free items from our menu. Be sure to download our app, refer your friends, and show your loyalty card at your next purchase to start earning! 
ORDER AND PAY VIA THE APP
We're making Maine Lobster easy! Order ahead, pay directly on your phone, avoid the lines, and pick up your order at our truck pick up windows or our restaurant front of house.
LOYALTY REWARDS
Earn points for every order and redeem those points for free food! Orders placed directly in our app will accrue points automatically. If you order in person, simply present your in-app loyalty card to our cashier at time of purchase.
NEWS & CUSTOMIZED OFFERS
Be the first to get the latest news and receive custom offers just for using the Cousins Maine Lobster app and being part of our family.
FIND YOUR FAVORITE TRUCK OR RESTAURANT
We're bringing Maine Lobster to your neighborhood! Find your nearest Cousins Maine Lobster restaurant or truck and treat yourself today!
GIVE FEEDBACK
Submit your feedback and let us know how we're doing.
At Cousins Maine Lobster we bring authentic Maine Lobster to unique neighborhoods across the U.S. by way of our food trucks and brick & mortar restaurants. We stay close to the source, proudly serving wild-caught premium lobster from Maine, accompanied by our Downeast Maine hospitality. Food as unique as the place it comes from, and authentic as the people who harvest it - that's what we're about. We look forward to serving you!

bluejetty:00187154:ios.description:
BUILD AI APPS. TRAIN AGENTS. AUTOMATE EVERYTHING.
Taskade is an AI App Builder and Agent Platform that transforms your ideas into living software.
Meet Taskade Genesis.
Describe what you need in one sentence and Taskade instantly generates a fully working app with structured data, AI agents, automation, and real-time collaboration built in.
One prompt. One app. No code required.
TURN IDEAS INTO SYSTEMS THAT RUN
With Taskade Genesis, you do not generate files. You generate live applications.
Create:
- Dashboards and analytics tools
- Client portals and internal team hubs
- CRM systems with lead scoring and follow-ups
- Booking systems and scheduling tools
- Forms, calculators, and approval workflows
- Knowledge bases and project command centers
- Custom internal tools for any team
Just describe your idea:
"A CRM with lead scoring and automated emails"
"A client portal with booking and invoicing"
"A marketing dashboard that updates weekly"
Taskade builds the interface, database, AI agents, and workflows already connected and ready to use.
Publish instantly with a secure link.
Add password protection or connect your own domain.
Clone and remix community-built apps in one click.
IMPORTANT FOR EXISTING USERS
Taskade still works exactly as before.
If you prefer using Taskade as a fast, simple task and project manager, nothing has been removed.
Your lists are not going away.
Your workflows still function.
AI features are optional.
Genesis is optional.
You can continue using Taskade for tasks, notes, and collaboration without AI in your way.
Two paths. One workspace. You choose.
AI AGENTS - BUILD, TRAIN, DEPLOY
Create intelligent AI agents that think, learn, and act 24 hours a day.
Assign roles such as:
- Analyst
- Researcher
- Sales Assistant
- Support Representative
- Content Writer
- Operations Manager
- Project Coordinator
Train agents on:
- PDFs, documents, spreadsheets, and presentations
- Web links and live resources
- Workspace projects and structured data
- Your past conversations and ongoing updates
Run multiple agents together to brainstorm, analyze, review, and execute complex work.
Choose leading AI models including GPT, Claude, and Gemini.
Agents remember context and collaborate with your team in real time.
AUTOMATION - WORK THAT RUNS ITSELF
Build powerful workflows without writing code.
- Trigger automations from forms, schedules, emails, webhooks, or app events
- Let AI categorize, prioritize, and route tasks
- Automate onboarding, follow-ups, reporting, approvals, and operations

listings.name: Lendee App
listings.description:
Lendee lets you buy receivables: the remaining payments on payment plans that businesses have offered their customers. You buy those payments at a discount and collect them as the customer pays.

How It Works
1. Explore: Browse available contracts and filter by number of payments remaining, amount, term, and Lendee Score.
2. Evaluate: Review the business profile, the customer, and the payment history before you buy.
3. Purchase: Buy a whole contract or just part of its payments. The contract is assigned to you and tracked in the app.
4. Receive: As the customer pays, your share is credited to your Lendee Wallet on the contract's schedule.
5. Redeploy: Transfer funds to your bank account or use them to buy another receivable.

Why Businesses Sell Their Payment Plans
Dental, veterinary, optometry, physical therapy, and auto repair practices often let customers pay over time. Instead of waiting months to collect, they sell the remaining payments at a discount to get cash sooner.

What You See on Every Contract
• Contract details: payment amount, due dates, remaining term, and how much has already been paid
• Business profile: verified by Lendee
• Customer profile: payment history and Lendee Score

Servicing Is Handled for You
A servicer manages each contract for its full term: billing, payment reminders, payment tracking, follow-up on late payments, and recovery.

Your Lendee Wallet
See what you have received, what is still to come, and your upcoming payments in one place. Payments arrive on the contract's schedule, not as a lump sum.

Important to Know
Receivables are not bank deposits or savings products. They are not insured or guaranteed. Customers can pay late or stop paying, and you could get back less than you paid. A good payment history does not guarantee future payments. Review each contract carefully before you buy.

bluejetty:00150245:ios.description:
iScribe cures physician burnout and allows physicians to focus on caring for patients rather than the computer screen.
iScribe is an easy-to-use app that gives providers anytime/anywhere access via iPhone, iPad, or Mac to view and enter clinical information for patients. We leverage industry leading speech-to-text technology to increase provider efficiency and productivity while eliminating expensive transcription costs.
With iScribe’s real-time speech-to-text dictation feature, users can visually see the dictated text directly on the screen as they are speaking. Users can dictate directly into the appropriate sections (CC, HPI, ROS, PE, A/P) on the mobile device and save their documentation immediately into their EHR. By using the real-time speech-to-text feature, transcription costs can be eliminated. iScribe users have saved $15,000 - $25,000 per provider per year in reduced transcription costs.
iScribe reduces the time that healthcare providers typically spend in the EHR allowing more time to take care of patients. Physicians can complete their encounter without having to wait until the end of the day or after office hours and there is no waiting for pending transcription. iScribe’s modern mobile user experience allows the clinical documentation to be completed at the point of care without taking away from the provider / patient experience. Healthcare provider time should not be undervalued and iScribe helps to maximize efficiency and productivity unlike any other solution available today.

bluejetty:00087450:ios.description:
Welcome to BYDFi — the Official Partner of Newcastle United Football Club and recognized by Forbes as one of the Top 10 Best Crypto Exchanges, trusted by 1,000,000+ users across 190+ countries.
Founded in 2020, BYDFi has grown steadily over the past 6 years and is listed by leading data platforms CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko. With a focus on reliability and innovation, BYDFi has built a solid reputation among global crypto traders.
Why BYDFi should be your go-to platform — here are a few key reasons:
1. All-in-One: Spot, Futures & TradFi
Trade crypto spot, perpetual futures, and traditional finance assets — all in a single app. Switch seamlessly between markets without juggling multiple platforms. One account, one balance, endless opportunities.
2. A Diversified Universe of Assets
● Spot Trading: Buy and sell BTC, ETH, XRP, SOL, and other leading cryptocurrencies with ease.
● Perpetual Futures: Trade with 1–200x flexible leverage across a wide range of markets.
● Traditional Finance Assets (TradFi): Trade stocks, gold, silver and other precious metals, and crude oil — popular traditional-market assets — with easy access to the world's traditional markets.
3. Powerful Trading Tools for Smarter Strategies
Whether you're a beginner or an advanced trader, BYDFi's robust suite of tools helps you navigate the market with confidence:
● Copy Trading: Follow top traders and mirror their trades automatically with multiple smart copy modes — start from as little as $30.
● Grid Bots: Automate buy-low, sell-high strategies with Futures grids — perfect for volatile markets.
4. Low Fees, Easy Access
Lower your entry costs and improve efficiency through global fiat on-ramps and VIP fee discounts:
● Fiat On-Ramps: In partnership with Transak, Paybis, Mercuryo, and Legend Trading, we support 190+ countries/regions. Buy crypto via bank transfer (wire) and credit/debit cards to help reduce FX and intermediary costs.
● VIP Fee Discounts: A multi-tier VIP program with highly competitive fees relative to typical market rates, designed to deliver a meaningful long-term cost advantage.
5. Rewards That Keep You Going
● Daily Rewards: Earn trading bonuses, fee discounts and more through a variety of platform activities.
● Newcomer Activities: Join beginner-friendly activities to unlock extra trading perks and rewards.
Wherever you are, BYDFi is your trusted global partner in crypto. Our platform supports multiple languages and connects you to markets worldwide. Need help? Our expert team is available 24/7 to support you every step of the way.
BYDFi is committed to delivering a world-class crypto trading experience. BUIDL Your Dream Finance
A few of the many assets you can trade on BYDFi: BTC, ETH, XRP, SOL, BNB, DOGE, ADA, LINK, LTC, AVAX, DOT, TRX, XLM, BCH, ATOM, NEAR, SUI, APT, ARB, OP, AAVE, FIL, TAO, ZEC, HYPE, INJ, FET, VIRTUAL & more — plus TradFi (stocks, gold, silver, crude oil, platinum & Nasdaq) and RWA tokens like ONDO, PENDLE, ENA, PLUME & USUAL.

Business Inquiries: bd@bydfi.com
Customer Support: cs@bydfi.com

bluejetty:00115690:ios.description:
This location-sharing app is designed to keep you and your loved ones connected with ease and peace of mind. It lets you share your location in real time, see where your family or friends are, and receive instant notifications when they arrive at or leave specific places like home, school, or work. You can also view detailed movement history for any day to stay informed without asking “Where are you?” all the time.
With it, staying in touch feels effortless. Add places to get automatic check-ins, and use the built-in SOS button to quickly send a help alert with your live location to selected contacts in case of emergency. You can invite others by phone number, even if they haven’t installed the app yet.
This application is built to support real relationships — whether you're a parent, partner, or friend — by offering care and safety without pressure or over-monitoring. The app includes helpful tips on how to use location sharing respectfully and effectively, making it a simple and thoughtful choice for everyday peace of mind.
Don’t just track — connect! 
Privacy policy: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1eSOWbVKiT2147FroxZ-3WyuUInvC_c4DRND_3dnlrO4/edit?usp=sharing
Terms of use: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Vl9VHB68yKwCGWHtlM3wuEYy3lk-10aAaWHus9hVu4k/edit?usp=sharing

bluejetty:00144857:ios.description:
Ngheluon: Sách Nói Hay là một ứng dụng sách nói miễn phí, kho ebook, audio book, podcast mới nhất hiện nay. Ngheluon cung cấp những bản chắt lọc ý tưởng, bản tóm gọn từ những cuốn sách từ thư viện sách hay nhất trên thế giới. Ebook, Audiobook, Sách nói Ngheluon là nơi sẽ giúp bạn có thể đọc sách, nghe sách học tập và giải trí bởi những quyển sách hay nhất mọi thời đại về những câu chuyện kinh doanh, sách kinh doanh, sách self help, tự lực, sách tiểu sử, sách lịch sử.
Bạn từng được đồng nghiệp, người thân hoặc bạn bè tặng cho những quyển sách hay mà vẫn chưa đọc? 
Bạn từng thấy những cuốn sách kinh doanh, sách self help, tự lực nổi tiếng được khuyên đọc mà ngại mua?
Vậy thì ứng dụng sách nói miễn phí Ngheluon sinh ra là vì bạn. Đến với ebook, audiobook, sách nói miễn phí Ngheluon bạn sẽ nắm được tinh túy của những cuốn sách mà bình thường bạn không thể dành thời gian nghe.
LỢI ÍCH CỦA NGHE SÁCH NÓI, ĐỌC SÁCH EBOOK NGHELUON:
- Ngheluon: Sách Nói Hay cung cấp những bản chắt lọc ý tưởng, bản tóm gọn từ những cuốn sách từ thư viện sách hay nhất trên thế giới.
- Sẽ không còn phải mất hàng chục giờ đồng hồ để đọc những quyển sách vài trăm trang.
- Không phải mang theo những quyển sách to và nặng trong balo.
- Tiết kiệm thời gian và chi phí cho việc đọc sách và đầu tư phát triển bản thân.
ĐIỂM MẠNH CỦA EBOOK, SÁCH NÓI NGHELUON:
- Kho sách lớn, ebook phi tiểu thuyết hay nhất trên thế giới.
- Podcast, ebook (audio book) mới sẽ được cập nhật hàng ngày.
- Tóm tắt tổng quát được toàn bộ nội dung của những quyển sách hay mà người đọc cần biết.
- Có thể đồng thời nghe và đọc.
- Nhiều chủ đề, câu chuyện kinh doanh và thể loại sách hay để phát triển bản thân: sách kinh doanh, giáo dục, lịch sử,…
- Thiết kế mới, thân thiện hơn với người đọc hoặc nghe.
- Giọng đọc truyền cảm, thu hút người nghe.
- Có thể tải miễn phí ebook Ngheluon và không hề có quảng cáo.
THAM GIA CỘNG ĐỒNG SÁCH NÓI MIỄN PHÍ NGHELUON ĐỂ:
- Sở hữu một trợ lý đọc sách và tóm tắt toàn bộ những nội dung quan trọng cho bạn.
- Là bước đầu tiên để bạn có thể kinh doanh, đầu tư phát triển bản thân mình.
- Có cái nhìn mới hơn về công việc và cuộc sống của bạn.
- Đạt được những thành tựu cho bản thân mình.
- Trở thành con người mà bạn mong muốn: thông thái hơn và hạnh phúc hơn. 
PHẢN HỒI CỦA NGƯỜI NGHE VỀ SÁCH NÓI MIỄN PHÍ NGHELUON :
“Tôi đã nghe được nhiều cuốn sách mà tôi mua về nhưng không có thời gian đọc. Đó thực sự là một thành tích của tôi” ( (Nông Hiền, fashion shop owner)
“Từ khi tải Ngheluon về điện thoại, mình nghe được nhiều sách hay hơn. Suy nghĩ của mình mở rộng hơn chứ không còn bị bó hẹp vào quan điểm của một vài cuốn sách nổi tiếng nào đó” (Lê Duyên, nhân viên văn phòng)
“Giọng đọc hay, nội dung dễ hiểu và cách truyền đạt thì cực gần gũi. Khi ngồi xe, tôi hay mở cho người thân cùng nghe để bàn luận và ai cũng rất thích” (Trần Nam, chủ doanh nghiệp)
Terms of Service & Privacy Policy: https://www.ngheluon.com/#tos

bluejetty:00080754:ios.description:
Your story lives in the Winston-Salem Journal. From reporting on all of your favorite teams to the news that matters most in your community, we cover it all. Get in-depth stories from the Winston-Salem area and beyond – including news, sports, opinion, obituaries, entertainment, and politics.
Easily access the very latest news in an app built for you. Read, see, and hear exclusive commentary, stunning photography, video updates, and binge-worthy podcasts.
Plus, subscribers have the ability to upgrade to News+, our premium ad-free experience! That means faster-loading pages and an uninterrupted reading experience. 
Our app features:
* Your Stories – personalize your experience by selecting the local news topics that matter most to you
* Get notified – stay in the loop by selecting alerts for news, sports, weather, and more
* Easy navigation – see all the latest local stories by simply swiping up/down, and left/right.
* Read stories your way – either in the News Feed or via the E-edition
* Breaking news updates – top banners let you know what’s happening right now
* Follow author – get notifications whenever your favorite writers post a story
* Bookmark for later – save stories to enjoy at your leisure
* Listen to articles – press the play button to listen instead
* Customize your text size – make the content bigger or smaller in your profile settings
* Weather where you are – hourly, 10-day forecasts, and frequent video updates
Free to download. Subscribers enjoy unlimited access.
https://journalnow.com/terms/

bluejetty:00061493:ios.description:
You need to run ManageEngine OpManager server to work with this app.
OpManager is complete, end-to-end network monitoring software that offers advanced fault and performance management functionalities across critical IT resources such as routers, WAN links, switches, firewalls, VoIP call paths, physical servers, virtual servers, domain controllers, and other IT infrastructure devices. You are only able to access your machine setup using this app if you're already running OpManager on-premises, and you can use this app to access the machine setup from your Apple device (iPad and iPhone). This app helps data center administrators stay connected to their IT and access it from anywhere, anytime. It offers quick access to the OpManager on-premises tool to view the performance of devices and troubleshoot faults instantly. This app is not stand-alone.
Features
Lists all the devices in your network based on category, groups, business view, type, vendor, apps, protocol, severity.
Lists alarm and their causes based on the time and severity (Critical, Attention, Trouble, Service Down)
Lists all the down devices and their corresponding alarms in your network
Search for a particular device in your network and know its detail and status
Perform Test Monitor, Ping, Traceroute, and Workflow actions on devices
Perform actions such as Clear Alarm, Acknowledge Alarm, Delete Alarm, Suppress Alarms, and Add Notes on alarms
Push notifications for getting timely notifications on events that are generated in the OpManager server
With the help of Siri Shortcuts, execute actions to show a list of down devices, and filter alarms based on severity, category, time, acknowledged/unacknowledged
Home screen widgets to have a quick overview of alarms, down devices.
Applications Manager Plugin support
Ping Tools and Address Monitoring Tools
Support for Https
AD and SAML authentication support.
Compatible with OpManager and OpManager plus versions 12400 and later.
Want to try OpManager on-premises?
https://www.manageengine.com/network-monitoring/download.html?appstore

Insect Evolution is a hyper casual game where the purpose is to get as bigger and stronger as you can to take out insects and beat the level!
You as a small insect will start on a running track with evolution theme in mind. Getting bigger and stronger is the key in any evolution game and Insect Evolution could be the best evolution game you would have played till now.

Upgrading your insect at the start of every level will make you stronger enough to easily reach the level end and take down the boss insect.

bluejetty:00151699:ios.description:
READ BEFORE BUYING: Please expand this description and read the full list of supported devices below to confirm that your device is supported.
Before there was the Tomb Raider, there was Lara Croft; twenty-one years old and shipwrecked on her first archaeological expedition. To escape the mysterious isle of Yamatai, she must push far beyond her limits, leave innocence behind and be reborn a legend.
Explore Yamatai’s ancient ruins, unlock its riddles and fight for survival against its murderous inhabitants. 
Tomb Raider for iOS is the complete adventure, expertly adapted for mobile. Play it your way, whether using intuitive touchscreen controls, mouse & keyboard, or your favourite gamepad.
TOMB RAIDER COMPLETE AND UNCUT
Lara’s first AAA outing on iOS arrives without compromise — packed with exploration, intense firefights, puzzles and Challenge Tombs.
OVERCOME THE ODDS
Unlock skills, hunt for materials, and craft equipment to take Lara from desperate survivor to master adventurer.
UNCOVER A LOST KINGDOM
Discover lost relics and ancient scrolls to unravel the mysteries of Yamatai and the cultists who prowl its depths.
INCLUDES BONUS CONTENT
Tomb Raider for iOS comes with 12 DLC packs, including Skills, Weapon Upgrades and a variety of skins for Lara, plus a bonus Challenge Tomb.
TAILORED TO iOS
Includes gyroscopic motion-aim on supported devices, as well as optimisation presets for improved performance or visuals.
===
Tomb Raider requires iOS 18 or later. You need 11GB of free space on your device, though we recommend at least double this to avoid initial installation issues.
Supported iPhones: 
 • iPhone XS / XS Max and later
 • iPhone SE - 3rd Generation (2022)
 • iPhone Air
Supported iPads: 
 • iPad - 10th Generation (2022) and later
 • iPad mini - 6th Generation (2021) and later
 • iPad Air - 4th Generation (2020) and later
 • iPad Pro - 3rd Generation (2018) and later
• If you require assistance, please contact our support team at support@feralinteractive.com

bluejetty:00071053:ios.name: Merge Manor : Sunny House
bluejetty:00071053:ios.summary: Grandma? Where are you?! Something mysterious has happened in Sunny's family home! Unravel the family's hidden secret and renovate the mansion. Merge items to help Sunny design and decorate the mansion's garden to its former glory. Join Sun
bluejetty:00071053:ios.description:
Grandma? Where are you?! Something mysterious has happened in Sunny's family home! Unravel the family's hidden secret and renovate the mansion. Merge items to help Sunny design and decorate the mansion's garden to its former glory. Join Sunny's adventure to solve the secret of the mystery manor. Unfold a story full of surprises and turns! Help Sunny while enjoying the relaxing merge puzzles with different themes. Keep your mood SUNNY side up with Merge Manor: Sunny House
Game Features:
- RENOVATE, decorate, and expand your garden & mansion with unique locations that tie into the story!
Get ready to redesign, rebuild and customize things the way you want. In Sunny's House, you will manage the renovation of several parts of your estate: the facade of your home, the fountains, the old lake, beehives and dog houses, and much more! Complete the makeover of the whole garden and the mansion and receive tons of awards!
- MATCH flowers and solve hundreds of addictive merge levels!
To accomplish your design ideas, you will have to use stars. And for that, you'll need to play merging games of which there are hundreds available in Sunny House. Some of them can be challenging, but luckily, you will earn rewards throughout the game (like boosters!) which can help you overcome those fun but tricky merge blast merges!
- ENJOY plot twists in the story and uncover hidden secrets and mysteries along the way!
Sunny's House is not just a decorating and merging game, what makes it unique is its exciting story! You'll meet many characters and interact with them, prepare yourself for the most amazing encounters: from a strange (but cute!) neighbor to new family members and even some four-legged friends, including a curious cat!
- EXPLORE the garden with its hidden objects, dozens of flowers and unlock secret areas
The garden you will be remodeling is large and abounds with secrets and mysteries! As you advance in the game, you will get to explore new areas, come across many surprises, and be tasked with solving several enigmas!
- RELAX and dig into the mystery of the mansion!
Besides being a fun and beautifully designed game, Sunny's House is also an excellent way to relax! Take a break from your stressful activities and spend some time diving into a calming world of landscaping and yard decorating full of mystery. Not only will it be satisfying to revive your old family garden, but you will also love working alongside Sunny and her many challenges and tasks. You will also experience a real love story with your neighbors and meet so many quirky characters along the way!
- SPECIAL EVENTS and REWARDS: Participate in daily special events and earn great rewards! Join tournaments for even bigger wins.
- COOK TASTY FOOD: Rebuild Sunny's Diner in the village and serve tasty cuisine to the villagers through the Sunny Kitchen Cooking Event!
- MAKE FRIENDS: Join a family to interact and chat with other players and exchange lives and game boosters!
Flowers are blossoming and Sunny's House is ready for its makeover! Are you ready to decorate and renovate this beautiful garden?
Sunny's House will be updated with more blast merges to solve and more romantic chapters regularly! Stay tuned for updates and drop us a review!

bluejetty:00044664:ios.description:
Coloring advantages: It helps fussy children calm down and become more patient, and helps adults relieve stress, improve concentration, drive away anxiety and obviously - it’s fun!
Coloring disadvantages: it’s considered childish, it’s messy, carrying around a coloring book is both troublesome and kind of awkward.
The Color Options app is here to bring you all the advantages of coloring without a single disadvantage! All in a modern, easy-to-use, professional looking design that appeals to both children and adults. 
Why choose Color Options?
You can select an image to color from the app’s rich gallery
You can also upload an image of your choice
The lines in the images are closed, so coloring is easy
The recently used colors are saved for easy access
The ‘cancel last step’ feature makes it easy to fix mistakes
The ‘share’ feature lets you share your art with friends!
Coloring is a great activity for both children and adults, and with Color Options you can take coloring with you anywhere, anytime!

Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.

One married couple buys a suspiciously underpriced house. They move in and realize that there’s nothing but locked empty rooms and weird notes left by the previous owner…

MATCH & MERGE
- Merge matching items, and create new ones as you progress through the game.

RESTORE & DECORATE
- Solve the house mystery, decorate its rooms, and enjoy the family atmosphere;
- Open various rooms: their own gym and home theatre, their barbecue zone and swimming pool, etc. Moreover, they will find the secret room or rooms?!

ADVENTURE & TRAVEL
- Discover the world around you, visit different countries, and look for exotic animals and plants.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
- Make friends, help them water their plants, and feed their animals.

Welcome to the Travel Merge Family! It is an adventure casual game, the go-to merge game that takes you on a journey like no other! Dive into an immersive blend of merge puzzle mechanics. Do you like to play the casual merge puzzle game and decorate your home? Then this game is for you!
All in all, find your satisfaction in the family atmosphere and the perfect home space creation. Decorate, explore, and socialize! Make your life truly vibrant!

bluejetty:00149111:ios.description:
O aplicativo Fale Coreano, idealizado pelo professor Kevin Lee, transcende os limites de um curso de idiomas convencional. Esse aplicativo inovador não apenas ensina a língua coreana, mas também proporciona uma imersão profunda na rica cultura do país.
Com uma abordagem centrada no aluno, o Fale Coreano promove um aprendizado dinâmico e progressivo, permitindo que cada um avance no seu próprio ritmo. O diferencial do curso é sua perspectiva cultural, pois para dominar uma língua, é preciso compreender a cultura na qual ela está inserida.
A acessibilidade e o conforto são os pilares deste curso. Disponível 24/7, permite que você estude quando e onde quiser.
Em suma, o aplicativo Fale Coreano, abre a porta para um novo universo de conhecimento e cultura. É mais do que aprender um idioma - é vivenciar uma experiência cultural única.

bluejetty:00158202:ios.name: ABC Phonics for Kids: Spelling
bluejetty:00158202:ios.summary:
Discover the Joy of Learning with Our Interactive Educational App!
Transformative Learning Experience:
Our app introduces an innovative way for children aged 3-8 to master "blends" and "digraphs," fundamental elements in language developme
bluejetty:00158202:ios.description:
Discover the Joy of Learning with Our Interactive Educational App!
Transformative Learning Experience:
Our app introduces an innovative way for children aged 3-8 to master "blends" and "digraphs," fundamental elements in language development. Understanding these phonetic combinations, like the digraph "sh," is critical for reading proficiency. Our curriculum is designed to make this journey both fun and effective.
80 Letter Combinations, 118 Word Egg Surprises:
Dive into the world of letters with our Dinosaur English feature! Here, children learn to smoothly blend sounds in words through engaging activities. They'll encounter a T-Rex operating a submarine to transport letters, quirky letter-combining monsters, and a magical egg machine crafting various words. These playful approaches help keep learning to read fun.
16 Dazzling Mechs for Thrilling Reading Battles:
Ready for an adventure? Pilot our cool mechs to overcome villains in an exhilarating reading challenge. As words come together, kids will need to apply their phonics skills quickly and accurately to win. This exciting mode is complemented by four adventurous maps, offering a creatively stimulating experience.
9 Animated Stories for Engaging Reading:
Journey through captivating stories, like a trapped little crab seeking a way out of a swamp, or a chick aspiring to swim. Each tale incorporates key vocabulary in pivotal scenes, allowing children to naturally use and understand new words. These animated narratives deepen comprehension and vocabulary retention.
Rewarding Progress with Customizable Factories:
After each learning session, children earn rewards to unlock factory props. This incentive mechanism fuels their desire to learn, actively engaging them in phonics. Choose favorite props and start producing!
Product Highlights:
Gradual, structured phonics activities for mastering spelling rules.
Learn 80 letter combinations in a fun, educational setting.
Pilot 16 striking mechs to boost reading skills.
Engaging animated stories to spark reading interest.
Collect stars to unlock a variety of factory props.
Playable without internet connectivity.
Free from third-party advertisements.
Key Features:
• Fun educational games that blend learning with play.
• Tailored games for toddlers, focusing on colors and shapes.
• Games that put motor skills, memory, and logical thinking to work.
• Introduces counting and the alphabet in an engaging way.
• Pre-K activities designed for early learning success.
• Educational games specifically developed for toddlers.
• Brain games for kids, fostering cognitive development.
• Incorporates the Montessori method for holistic education.
• Interactive learning games for kids, making education enjoyable.
Discover a world where learning and fun come together, designed to nurture young minds through innovative educational games. Join us on this exciting learning adventure!
About Yateland:
Yateland's educational apps ignite the passion for learning through play among preschool children worldwide. We stand by our motto: "Apps that children love and parents trust." For more information about Yateland and our apps, please visit https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy:
Yateland is committed to protecting user privacy. To understand how we handle these matters, please read our complete privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.

bluejetty:00062974:ios.name: Audyssey MultEQ Editor app
bluejetty:00062974:ios.summary: The latest Denon Marantz audio video products use Audyssey MultEQ for simple, accurate set-up calibration of your system to the room in which it’s used. But, now you can go further with the Audyssey MultEQ Editor app, going ‘under the hood’
bluejetty:00062974:ios.description:
The latest Denon Marantz audio video products use Audyssey MultEQ for simple, accurate set-up calibration of your system to the room in which it’s used. But, now you can go further with the Audyssey MultEQ Editor app, going ‘under the hood’ to view and adjust settings for detailed tuning – allowing you to customize the sound more precisely to the specific problems in your room, and tailor the sound to your personal preferences. With this comprehensive app, you can harness the power of Audyssey MultEQ to take total control of the way your home cinema sounds.
This app will allow you to: 
•View the speaker detection results, to check correct installation
•View before and after results of the Audyssey calibration, making it easy to identify room problems.
•Edit the Audyssey target curve for each channel pair to suit your tastes
•Adjust the overall EQ frequency rolloff for each channel pair
•Switch between 2 high frequency rolloff target curves
•Enable/Disable midrange compensation to make the sound brighter or smoother
•Save and load calibration results
This app requires specific hardware in your product to function: please double-check that your Denon or Marantz model is supported - see list below - before purchasing.
•Multi-Language Support (English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Swedish, Polish, Russian, Japanese and Simplified Chinese. The OS language setting is automatically detected; when not available, English is selected.)
Compatible models: (Product availability varies depending on regions.)
Denon AV Receiver: AVR-X6300H, AVR-X4300H, AVR-X3300W, AVR-X2300W, AVR-X1300W, AVR-S920W, AVR-S720W, AVR-S730H, AVR-S930H, AVR-X1400H, AVR-X2400H, AVR-X3400H, AVR-X4400H, AVR-X6400H, AVR-X8500H, AVR-S740H, AVR-S940H, AVR-X1500H, AVR-X2500H, AVR-X3500H, AVR-X4500H, AVR-X6500H, AVR-X1600H, AVR-X2600H, AVR-X3600H, AVR-S750H, AVR-S950H, AVR-A110, AVR-X6700H, AVR-X4700H, AVR-X3700H, AVR-X2700H, AVR-S960H, AVR-X8500HA, AVR-X1700H, AVR-S760H, AVR-A1H, AVR-X4800H, AVR-X3800H, AVR-X2800H, AVR-S970H, AVR-X1800H, AVR-S770H, AVR-X6800H, AVR-A10H, AVR-S980H, AVR-X2900H, AVR-X3900H

bluejetty:00153231:ios.description:
Arena of Dreams: The Ultimate Party Royale!
YOU'VE SCORED an invite to Cloud 99, where anything is possible!
YES, YOU'RE DREAMING! Only the top DREAMERS in the world get an invite to this epic gaming competition where being the best means achieving the unimaginable, learning new things, and having a blast!
Arena of Dreams is a free multiplayer party royale packed with mini-games.
Survive and Thrive: Be the last one standing! Survive, advance and win medals if you reach the podium at the end of the rounds! Ensure your survival by teaming up in Co-op mode to tackle challenges that can only be found in your wildest dreams. Dive into a surreal and thrilling universe full of fun, action-packed adventure challenges!
Welcome to Arena of Dreams: Where competition meets fun in a one-of-a-kind multiplayer game!
Dream World Adventures: Journey through Cloud 99, a dream realm created by PJ Max and his team, where even the unimaginable can happen, and there’s no limit to how much fun you can have! Face challenges that test your skills as you travel through fantastical worlds. With a unique mix of strategy, racing and fun, you'll partake in thrilling adventures like never before!
Mini-Games Galore!:
- Sneaky Snakes 
- Letter Falls 
- Trailblazers Trivia 
- Lab Grab
- Rock, Paper, Tag!
- Night Falls 
- Beehive Hustle
- Wild West Sunset
- Glowy Chaos
- Campsite Buzz
- Riverside Rush
- Long Shot
- Memory Meltdown
- Cross Countries
- Flag Frenzy
Letter Falls and Trailblazers Trivia are back by popular demand! Challenge yourself with fun trivia questions!
The Battle Royale of dreams!
- 3 elimination minigames
- 24 DREAMERS in the running
- Only ONE winner
Unlock your power-ups: Gadgets will throw off your rivals and skills will make you faster, stronger and much more - your unique skills can completely turn the tide of the match. 
Collect cards to unlock new gadgets and skills, or upgrade the ones you already have to make them even more powerful.
Invite your friends, see who's online, connect with new friends via profiles and form teams in an instant!
Now you can create parties with 6 players! Build your ultimate squad to be victorious in the Arena!
In Arena's Dream Road you can level up to earn rewards and unlock new features!
Or play the events available for a limited time!
Brain exercises: combine logic, agility and strategy to advance!
Keep an eye on your performance by analyzing statistics to improve!
Brain Busters!: Combine logic and strategy to continue advancing to the next level!
The new profile page features records and stats to help you keep an eye on your performance!
Now you can also see other players' profiles. Challenge your friends!
Be Your True Self, in Style!:
- Choose your look.
- Earn and collect epic skins.
- New characters and skins dropping all the time!
Experience Arena of Dreams, the online multiplayer game that takes you on a unique, fun-filled ride of laughs and challenges. Dive in and become a legend in the Arena, where the wackiest dreams come to life in the palm of your hand!

Nova Water Mobile Application Nova natural drinking water has established itself as a true leader in the bottled water industry in the kingdom of Saudi Arabia by pioneering in its natural source of water, plant, and nation-wide distribution. 
Nova natural drinking water is the sole and primary product of Health Water Bottling Co. Ltd. The company was founded in 1973 and it maintained its quest to always be innovative and capitalizing upon over 40 years of experience within the bottled water industry.
Nova Water mobile application is here to provide their valuable customers with an easy to use interface and a convenient method of placing and tracking the delivery of their favorite bottled water.
The Nova Water mobile application will enable both existing Nova customers and new customers to experience the rich experience to easily order from the available range of products; Standard, Glass, Big Format that suits the needs from households to offices.
Nova Water mobile application has been designed keeping in focus to offer the right value to its customers as well as an exclusive feature 'Hydration Partner' that will help Nova customers to track their daily water intake, setting personalized reminders and integrating with Apple’s HealthKit / CareKit to see your daily step count on your favorite application. All for gearing you towards maintaining a healthier lifestyle.

bluejetty:00131741:ios.description:
Easy sound playback for your live show! From the makers of QLab™.
SIMPLE AND CONSISTENT
- Incredibly easy to run your show - just press GO.
- Play your music and sound effects at the same time.
- Take your show anywhere! Runs on iPad, iPhone, and iPod touch.
- Free to build 1 show. Unlock unlimited shows with a one-time In-App Purchase.
USE IT FOR
- Theater
- Dance Recitals
- Weddings
- Church Services
- Puppetry
- Magic Shows
SUPPORT
- Friendly help when you need it!
- Contact Support from the in-app sidebar, or email support@figure53.com.
- Complete documentation online at gobutton.app/docs.
NEWS AND UPDATES
- groups.google.com/g/gobutton
FEATURES
• Play multiple sounds at the same time.
• Play a list of sounds in sequence by tapping the "GO" button.
• Play ad-libbed sounds with always-ready "Hit" buttons.
• Auto-stop, fade in, fade out, loop, duck, and more.
• Adjust volume, pan, speed, and pitch independently for every cue.
• Import your audio files and share shows via AirDrop or the iOS Files app.
• Remote control with Bluetooth and MIDI.
• OSC control API for remote triggering from QLab or other OSC sources.
• Passcode lock your shows to prevent unauthorized edits.
• Ultra-efficient & low latency playback built on core iOS technologies.
• Supports DRM-free WAV, AIFF, M4A, AAC, MP3, MOV, 3GP, CAF, and FLAC.
• Requires iOS 15 or later.
Produced by Figure 53.

bluejetty:00069396:ios.description:
Anti-Theft Guard will get you alert by siren when someone takes your phone's current position, remove it from charging, eject sim and proximity. Someone has pickup your phone then it'll ring.
Top Features 
- Get alerted while moving the phone.
- Rang siren while proximity sensor detects something in front of them
- Sim Eject Siren
- Alerted while someone removes your device from charging
- When your phone get charged with 100% it'll alert
- Passcode protection for App
- Easy to use
How to use the app?
1. Set Passcode
2. Add Protection area based on your need
3. Turn on Protection from Home Screen button will be green while on and Put on a fixed position
4. App will run and put your device without closing an app
5. Based on the protection area it'll alert by the siren
Tips and Note:
- Make sure your phone is not silent and the volume is full
- Put your device on the stable surface based on protection area for i.e. Move Detection
- Don't lock your phone while using the Anti Theft app screen should be run
- App is constantly running so may use more battery power
Terms of Use (EULA) : https://appzforest.com/AppPolicy/Terms_of_Use_EULA_AntiTheft.html
Privacy Policy : https://appzforest.com/AppPolicy/AntiTheftAlert.html
Share your feedback, suggestions with us so we can improve the app.

bluejetty:00016320:ios.description:
WHAT’S ON IT?
-New original series like Dimension 20, Game Changer, Um Actually, Breaking News, What the F 101, Ultramechatron Team Go, Bad Internet, and more.
-Exclusive content you won't find anywhere else - all uncensored and ad-free - with talent like Brennan Lee Mulligan, Sam Reich, Zac Oyama, Emily Axford, Ally Beardsley, Lou Wilson, Aabria Iyengar, Erika Ishii, and more.
-Weekly releases of new episodes, including Dimension 20, Adventuring Party, Game Changer, and more.
-The definitive way to browse our extensive library of the CH video content you know and love.
-The knowledge that you are supporting an independent comedy channel for the cost of one sorta okay sandwich per month.
But hey, big blocks of text are pretty boring. Instead, how about just trying DROPOUT for a week totally free? Download the app and sign up for a trial of 3 free-as-heck days to watch everything your eyes can handle. Cancel anytime in the 3 day trial and never be charged!
Don’t like it? I mean, we’re deeply hurt, but we understand. Cancel your membership, throw your phone in a lake, however you cope with disappointment. DO like it? Just kick back and keep watching, and your first month will automatically begin at the end of the free trial. Annual plans are also available at a discount, if you’re a money whiz. So go ahead and give it a try!
This text isn’t gonna get any more interesting. I mean, I think we’ve pretty much covered all the good stuff. Still here? Um, ok. How’s everything? Good? Cool, cool. What are you looking for? The app description is over. For real. We’re not gonna say any more stuff. Check out the free trial. It’s way better than hanging out in the App Store this long.
Wow, you’re dedicated. Do you just love app descriptions? Weird. OK, we’re gonna go. Bye.
To access all features and content you can subscribe to DROPOUT By CollegeHumor on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app.* Pricing can vary by region and will be confirmed before purchase in the app. In app subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of their cycle.
* All payments will be paid through your Apple Account and may be managed under Account Settings after the initial payment. Subscription payments will automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24-hours before the end of the current cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current cycle. Any unused portion of your free trial will be forfeited upon payment. Cancellations are incurred by disabling auto-renewal.
Terms of Service: https://watch.dropout.tv/tos
Privacy Policy: https://watch.dropout.tv/privacy

bluejetty:00176381:ios.name: FashionDraw by Fashionary
bluejetty:00176381:ios.summary: FashionDraw is a drawing app created for designers, illustrators and other fashion creators in mind. With technical brushes, materials and more than 1,800 templates, FashionDraw makes it easier than ever to bring your vision – and your coll
bluejetty:00176381:ios.description:
FashionDraw is a drawing app created for designers, illustrators and other fashion creators in mind. With technical brushes, materials and more than 1,800 templates, FashionDraw makes it easier than ever to bring your vision – and your collection – to life.
Key features:
- 1,800+ Fashion Templates
- Material Brushes for Fabric Textures
- Technical Brushes for Production Drawings
- AI-powered video generation
- Presentation Board Layouts
- CLASS Tutorials for fashion illustrations
** 1,800+ Fashion Templates **
Choose from hundreds of figures for menswear, womenswear and childrenswear, as well as technical drawings of clothing and accessories. With more than 1,800 templates, FashionDraw will give you a solid foundation for your creative vision.
** Material Brushes for Fabric Textures **
From plain canvas to sumptuous velvet, FashionDraw’s 150+ material brushes help you experiment easily and quickly with fabric textures. Our time-saving material brush library offers realistic coverage like no other app in history.
** Technical Brushes for Production Drawings **
Precision is key; that’s why we’ve included an extensive library of technical brushes, with stitches, trims, buttons, zippers and more. The FashionDraw brush library provides everything you need to create professional drawings faster than ever.
** Brushes Tailor-made for Fashion Drawing **
The FashionDraw brush library lets you work with everything from super-fine pencils to smearable oil pastels and splattered spray paint. And our texture brushes allow you to depict realistic skin, hair and fur, to name but a few. The brushes are also customizable, so you can create your own or import new ones.
** Presentation Board Layouts **
Create professional, cohesive presentations quickly. Showcase your collections, mood boards, and individual designs in a polished, industry-standard format. This feature streamlines the process of presenting your ideas to clients, fashion houses, or at fashion week events.
** Tutorial for fashion illustrations **
FashionDraw Class is your go-to learning tool for mastering professional digital fashion illustration. With step-by-step tutorials and layered demonstrations, learn the essential skills to draw clothing styles and depict a variety of materials and textures using digital tools. All modules are accessible anytime, allowing you to learn at your own pace and convenience.
** FashionDraw AI **
Transform your fashion illustrations into animations with a single tap. Our AI-powered video generation help you to visualize concepts in motion, explore ideas from different angle, and showcase 360-degree presentations of your creations.
Please note that your monthly subscription will automatically renew unless you disable the auto-renewal feature at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period. Your payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase. You may manage your app subscriptions at any time through your iTunes Account settings. If you upgrade from a trial period to a paid subscription, any unused portion of the trial will be forfeited. It is important to note that there is no lock-in contract, and you are free to cancel your subscription at any time.
https://fashiondraw.app/pages/terms-and-conditions
https://fashiondraw.app/pages/privacy-statement

bluejetty:00040839:ios.description:
We all need a little help sometimes.
You're not alone - one in two people in the Middle East suffer from a mental health challenge once in their lifetime!
Anxiety, stress, and depression are the most common issues people face while going through life. This can affect both your personal and professional lives and can lead to other mood disorders or relationship issues, be it in marriage, while dating, or even at work. Other people struggle with OCD or trauma from past events. 
You will gain:
> a new perspective on things
> trust & confidence in yourself
> ways to set healthy boundaries
> the ability to process trauma, loss, & grief
> the ability to overcome loneliness & learn to be kind to yourself
Online therapy through Ayadi is:
* Private: you never have to be in a waiting room (#awkwardmoments)
* Convenient: you can do it anytime, anywhere (literally)
* Effective: it works exactly the same as in-person therapy (bonus: you don't need to dress up to talk about your problems)
*Safe: our therapists are professional and will never judge you
*Validation: our therapists are from the Middle East; they speak your language & understand your culture
Ayadi is an online therapy platform for Arabs around the world. We are available everywhere (except in the US), and we aim to connect you with experienced, qualified Middle Eastern therapists through a secure mobile app.
If you're still reading, download Ayadi now and book your session.
You've got nothing to lose.
All you need:
* the willingness to dig deeper
* a stable internet connection
Email: info@ayadihealth.co
Instagram: @ayadihealth
TikTok: @ayadihealth
Twitter: @ayadihealth
Yours confidentially, 
~Ayadi

bluejetty:00063016:ios.description:
Bingo Frenzy is the free bingo game that takes you somewhere new every round. Instead of one dull bingo hall, every room drops you into a different destination — vibrant cityscapes, world-famous landmarks, festive celebrations and breathtaking scenic backdrops. Daub your tickets, call BINGO, collect your coins and travel on.
A NEW DESTINATION EVERY ROUND
• Dozens of beautifully themed casino rooms inspired by famous places around the world
• Classic casino rooms alongside special event and holiday themes
• Every session feels fresh — new backdrop, new atmosphere, new reason to play
• Always somewhere new unlocked and waiting for you
SPOTLIGHT DESTINATIONS
• Limited-time casino rooms that appear regularly
• Celebrating iconic locations, historic moments, legendary personalities and national or international occasions
• Each spotlight brings a unique theme and a fresh way to play popular offline board game
• Come back often — spotlights rotate
SMART TICKET PLAY — SWAP MID-GAME
• Swap your tickets while the round is still running
• Read the called numbers, change your strategy in real time and improve your odds
• Pick the ticket that's actually working instead of hoping for the best
• Real game-play strategy, not just luck
PERSONALIZED TICKETS 
• Customizable ticket styles and unique ticket designs
• Pick the look that matches your mood and your play style
• Your offline game, your way — every single round
• Enjoy personalized tickets, fast-paced Blitz action, and exciting housie rounds for endless fun!
MULTIPLE TICKETS, MORE CHANCES
• Play several tickets at once in select destinations 
• More tickets, more numbers covered, more chances to shout BINGO
• Big multi-ticket rounds for players who want the pressure
SPIN & WIN FREE COINS
• Spin to earn free coins instantly between matches
• Daily bonuses, boosters and reward drops
• Generous free coins so you can keep playing without paying
LEADERBOARDS & ACHIEVEMENTS
• Climb global leaderboards and compete with real players worldwide
• Track your progress and unlock achievements as you play
• Earn bragging rights plus extra coin rewards
SMART REMINDERS IN #1 GAME
• Improved notifications that tell you when rewards, bonuses and special events are ready
• Never miss a spotlight room or a free coin drop
• Fully in your control — turn them off any time
BLITZ-SPEED, PLAYER-FRIENDLY BINGO LIVE
• Free to play with quick rounds that fit into a coffee break
• Smooth, freshly redesigned interface
• Great for relaxing solo play and for competitive offline game
QUICK ANSWERS
Is Bingo Frenzy free? Yes — free to download and play, with free coins, boosters and daily bonuses.
Is this real-money gambling? No. Bingo Frenzy: Live casino board game, uses virtual coins only. Nothing can be cashed out and no real money can be won.
What makes it different from other bingo frenzy games? Travel-themed destination rooms, rotating Spotlight rooms, and the ability to swap your tickets mid-game.
Can I play multiple bingo tickets? Yes, in select destinations.
Sit back, unwind and enjoy the game like never before. Your next bingo Live adventure is one tap away.
This Bingo Frenzy game is free to play and includes optional in-app items and ads. This game does not offer real-money gambling and there is no opportunity to win real money or prizes. It is intended for entertainment purposes only.

bluejetty:00031754:ios.name: Cross Number: Math Game Puzzle
bluejetty:00031754:ios.summary:
Looking for a game that puts your MATH skills to the test? Look no further! You'll love Cross Number - the best math puzzle game!
Whether you're a math enthusiast or just looking for a brain-teasing adventure, this game is for YOU.
HOW TO
bluejetty:00031754:ios.description:
Looking for a game that puts your MATH skills to the test? Look no further! You'll love Cross Number - the best math puzzle game!
Whether you're a math enthusiast or just looking for a brain-teasing adventure, this game is for YOU.
HOW TO PLAY
- Select Your Level: Begin by choosing your preferred difficulty level - Easy, Medium, Hard, or Expert
- Each level presents a grid of squares, with some filled in with numbers. Your goal is to fill in the empty spaces by following the given math clues
- Fill in the Grid: Use addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division to complete the math puzzle
- Be Strategic: Logical thinking and attention are keys to figuring out the best way to solve the game
- Complete the Puzzle: Once you've completed the grid, submit your solution and see if you've successfully cracked the puzzle
Cross Number: Math Game Puzzle is not just about solving equations - it's where numbers meet wooden charm. Join in a journey that challenges your logical thinking and numerical prowess.
NEW FEATURES
- Tailored Difficulty Levels: You can choose the difficulty of levels. Whether you're looking for a gentle warm-up or a mind-bending challenge, customize the gameplay to match your skills and pace
- Daily Brain Workout: One cross math puzzle a day keeps the neurologist away. Start your day with a mental boost and keep those brain cells active!
- Endless Thrills: No error checks until your final submission in Endless Mode. How many levels can you conquer with just three mistakes allowed? Aim for the highest score by completing more levels!
- Wooden-Style: We transform your puzzle-solving journey into a rustic and visually appealing experience. Dive into a world where numbers meet craftsmanship, combining the joy of math challenges with the warmth of wood
- Intuitive gameplay suitable for all ages and skill levels. Join the adventure today and discover the thrill of Cross Number - where everyone is invited to play and conquer!
If you are a fan of mind puzzle games like Number Match, Crossword, Merge Number, Cross Math, Math Puzzle, Wordle or Wordscape - this definitely a perfect game for you. You can play it either online or offline by using a sheet of paper, but nowadays, we prefer mobile versions of tile puzzle games, which you can play on the go :) Solving a daily puzzle will help you with logic, memory, and math skills training!
There are a lot of ways to solve the logic number puzzle. But it’s not as easy as it seems. People say this super addictive and relaxing puzzle game helps their mental health and lets them relax, especially after a hard day. Tease your brain and enjoy an engaging number games experience! If you like merging numbers mechanics, you will enjoy this logic game!
If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us: support@matchgames.io
Ready for a brain boost? Join the fun, sharpen your mind, and embrace the joy of solving puzzles with Cross Number: Math Game Puzzle today!

bluejetty:00100748:ios.description:
Search, browse, or just listen to your favorite hymns with ichSing. This app can replace your heavy hymnal while bringing you comforting delight with the beautiful music of those hymns you love most. ichSing is loaded with thousands of songs that are sure to include the ones closest to your heart.
Das Große Gesangbuch: Often known as “Lutherische Gesangbuch” or just "Gesangbuch" this monumental collection is a cornerstone of spiritual life from the 16th century onward. It encompasses a vast array of hymns that have served as the bedrock of communal and individual worship. Each song is a profound expression of theological reflection, designed not just to be sung, but to be lived. It invites believers into a deep, contemplative experience where each verse echoes with the wisdom and devotion of centuries. It challenges the mind with its rich doctrinal insights while simultaneously uplifting the spirit, making it an essential companion for anyone seeking to enrich their faith and understanding of God.
Das Kleine Gesangbuch: Among its treasured hymns, this book uniquely tells a multitude of Bible stories through song, bringing scripture to life in a melodic and memorable way. They provide comfort and spiritual guidance, helping believers to navigate the complexities of life with faith and hope, while deepening their understanding of biblical teachings.
Morgen-Abendlieder Buch: Start and end your day with spiritual devotion using this book, a collection specifically curated to guide your thoughts and prayers during the sacred moments of morning and evening. These hymns are designed to align your daily rhythm with the presence of God, inviting you to begin your day with praise and reflection, and to close it with gratitude and surrender. It serves as a spiritual anchor, helping to frame each day within the context of divine love and guidance, offering a peaceful and reflective start and end to your day.
Väterlieder: Known as the “Lieder der Hutterische Brüder,” are deeply rooted in the faith and doctrine of the 16th and 17th centuries, reflecting the core beliefs and spiritual resilience of the communities that composed and sang them. Composed by authors such as Peter Riedemann and Wolf Sailer, they are a profound expression of faith, doctrine, and devotion, capturing the essence of faith lived out in community, often under persecution and in the face of great adversity. These are particularly significant for their ability to communicate complex theological truths in a way that is both accessible and moving. Through these songs, believers today can connect with the courage, conviction, and deep spiritual insight of those who gave their lives for their faith.
In addition to preserving these precious texts, ichSing offers a unique opportunity to learn the melodies that have accompanied these songs for generations. Our comprehensive audio recordings allow you to immerse yourself in the musical heritage of these songs, ensuring that you can fully experience the beauty and depth of each song as it was intended to be sung.
Enhanced Synchronization: We’ve integrated peer-to-peer Bluetooth technology to enable faster and more accurate local syncing. Whether you’re singing along with friends or practicing with family, enjoy smoother transitions and flawless timing.
Global Connectivity Upgrade: Distance is no longer an obstacle with our enhanced internet connectivity features. Sing with your congregation, or a group of friends, no matter where they are in the world, allowing for a seamless and unified worship experience, no matter the physical distance.
Personalize Your Worship: Bookmark songs or add them to your favorites for easy access later, can help you stay organized and focused.
Share and Print: Share a verse that resonates with you or print out your favorite song to keep with you as you meditate on their spiritual depth.

bluejetty:00174739:ios.description:
Operation 36 is the #1 way to learn to play golf and see measurable improvement. Instead of starting at the full-tee box, golfers start 25 yards from the hole and try to shoot even par (score of 36) for 9 holes. Once you accomplish that goal, you back you up to the next division (50 yards from the hole). There are 10 divisions in total to try and shoot 36 from. It is that simple!
We developed the Operation 36 Mobile App to help guide you on your golf improvement journey. Your entire journey (Playing, Training, and Goals Accomplished) are tracked in the Op 36 App. Every action you log allows you to share your stats with your golf professional to guide you on your journey.
There are 525+ Golf Facilities in the Op 36 Network around the world that are centering their programs around the Op 36 format and technology. 
Are you a complete beginner?
Have you played golf your whole life and want a better way to improve?
Each facility offers coaching programs to help you become a skilled golfer. 
How do I get started?
1. Find an Op 36 training community and enroll in their coaching programs
2. Get your Op 36 invite from your golf professional
3. Begin logging your golf improvement journey and encouraging others at your golf facility!
Now is the time to learn to play golf!

bluejetty:00075215:ios.summary: A Speech to Text app is a useful tool that enables you to convert spoken words into written text, making it easier to transcribe voice recordings. With advancements in open AI technology, such apps have become more accurate and efficient, e
bluejetty:00075215:ios.description:
A Speech to Text app is a useful tool that enables you to convert spoken words into written text, making it easier to transcribe voice recordings. With advancements in open AI technology, such apps have become more accurate and efficient, enabling them to transcribe even whispered speech with ease.
One of the main advantages of a Speech to Text app is its ability to convert audio recordings into text. This is especially useful for journalists, researchers, and anyone who needs to create written records of meetings, interviews, or other events. The app works by using an audio converter to read the audio file and convert it into text, which can then be edited and shared as needed.
In addition to converting voice recordings, a Speech to Text app can also be used for dictation, allowing you to speak directly into the app and have your words transcribed in real-time. This feature can be especially useful for individuals who struggle with writing, or for those who need to create text-based documents quickly and efficiently.
Overall, a Speech to Text app is a valuable tool that can save time and improve productivity, making it easier to transcribe voice recordings and create written records of important events. With advancements in open AI technology, these apps are becoming more accurate and reliable, making them an essential tool for anyone who needs to work with audio recordings on a regular basis.
