bluejetty:00063833:ios.description:
Welcome to the Oregon Lottery Mobile App!
It’s all about convenience, utility and Lottery fun at your fingertips anywhere you go. Keep an eye on your app and check back often as we continue to develop the Oregon Lottery app and add on the features you want over the coming months and offer app-only exclusive opportunities to win, just by having the app on your favorite device. 
Our Features:
• Check-a-Ticket Scanner – Find out if your ticket (Scratch-its, Jackpot Games, Keno) is a winner. Celebrate with us when you win, learn more about how your Oregon Lottery dollars do good things in your community when you don’t.
• Notifications – Set your notifications for a friendly, fun reminder of the Jackpot game and Keno 8-Spot amounts you don’t want to miss.
• Responsible Gaming Tools & Tips – Keep your entertainment entertaining and your game play fun by learning some gaming best practices. Tools include tips, a budget tool, a timer and a cost of play calculator, all to keep you informed and to maximize your enjoyment of Lottery games of chance. 
• Live Keno – Purchase your Keno tickets and/or advance draws at an Oregon Lottery retailer and play from home via your mobile application. Double check your ticket to see if you were a winner by quickly switching over to the Oregon Lottery scanning tool.
• Special App-Only Exclusives – Special promotions and drawings, just for downloading and using the Oregon Lottery mobile app. If you’re a registered user, you’ll have opportunities to be entered to win free Lottery products and prizes. It’s that easy!
• Scanned Ticket History – Each time you scan a ticket, the app saves it in your history, so you can refer back to the games you’ve played whenever you want.
• Past Results, Winner’s Stories, Game Details and so Much More – There’s a lot to explore, and so much more to come as we evolve this app to delight Lottery customers even more in the future. Enjoy and stay tuned!
Lottery games are based on chance and should be played for entertainment not investment purposes.

bluejetty:00123653:ios.description:
Tudo na Black Friday chama Zé Delivery! Suas bebidas favoritas no precinho, gelada e em minutos. E ainda com ofertas especiais e promoções imperdíveis. É só ficar de olho nos cupons!
Com o Zé Delivery, a bebida chega até você em minutos: sem fila e sem perrengue! No app você pode comprar cervejas, destilados, vinhos, whisky, refrigerantes, petiscos e muito mais, tudo no precinho, e o melhor: bebida sempre gelada!
Durante a Black Friday, as ofertas de bebidas ficam ainda melhores, com cupons e promoções exclusivas pra você economizar no pedido.
No app do Zé Delivery, você pode comprar cervejas e as demais bebidas para seu churrasco, festa ou happy hour sem sair de casa:
1) Escolher o endereço de entrega
2) Selecionar seus produtos: no Zé Delivery você encontra diversas bebidas, como cervejas, destilados, vinhos, whisky, gin, refrigerantes e muito mais, além de petiscos e itens para seu churrasco, como carvão e gelo! Você pode aproveitar as ofertas de Black Friday pra encher o carrinho com bebidas com desconto.
3) Escolher a forma de pagamento: você pode pagar online ou na entrega — e ainda usar cupons de desconto disponíveis no app durante as promoções de Black Friday.
Ao baixar o Zé Delivery, você pode comprar cerveja, vinho, whisky, gin, bebidas e tudo o que precisa para aproveitar os melhores momentos com amigos e família: seja no churrasco, na festa, no happy hour, no esquenta ou até pra relaxar em casa. E o melhor: durante a Black Friday, tem sempre um cupom de desconto pra deixar tudo mais em conta.
Por que escolher o Zé Delivery?
Entrega rápida: em minutos, a bebida chega gelada.
Preço baixo: a melhor opção para comprar cerveja, vinhos, destilados, whisky e mais, com ofertas exclusivas, promoções.
Praticidade: você pode comprar cerveja, gin e outras bebidas sem sair de casa, sem enfrentar filas e sem carregar peso.
Onde a gente entrega?
Nossos parceiros distribuidores estão em todos os estados do Brasil. Já são mais de 700 cidades atendidas! Confira a lista completa no nosso site https://www.ze.delivery/cidades-atendidas 
Se ainda não atendemos a sua cidade, pode mandar um e-mail para atendimento_ze@ambev.com.br contando onde você gostaria de receber seu pedido. Estamos crescendo e fazemos questão de chegar aí também.
Dúvidas, elogios, reclamações, ombro amigo?
É só falar com a gente através do e-mail atendimento_ze@ambev.com.br. Nossa equipe está a postos todos os dias das 8h às 2h da manhã.
Quer ser um parceiro e entregar bebidas através do Zé Delivery?
Vale dar uma olhada em www.ze.delivery/partners

bluejetty:00127214:ios.description:
Gratitude Plus is the best way to build and maintain a consistent habit of gratitude for a healthier and happier life. Combining science-based mental health tools and community support, Gratitude Plus makes it easy to reflect on your day while deepening connections with the people you care about most. 
With Gratitude Plus, you can…
- Keep a private, personal Gratitude Journal
- Create or join Gratitude Circles with your partner, family, and/or friends
- See “memories” of gratitudes you’ve shared in the past
- Push yourself creatively with a variety of prompts
- Browse the public feed of gratitude and support others around the world with heartwarming messages of encouragement
- Get daily inspiration with positive affirmations and thoughtful quotes
- Set up push notifications to remind yourself to check in
- Track your mood each day to easily understand trends

bluejetty:00140437:ios.description:
Manage up to four WhatsApp accounts on your iPad and iPhone – Messenger Business.
Whether you have WhatsApp Business and personal accounts or need to manage multiple WhatsApp profiles, Messenger Business is your all-in-one solution for seamless organization on your iPad and iPhone. Each account remains linked to its unique phone number, giving you the flexibility to effortlessly manage different conversations.
Designed for iPad and iPhone, Messenger Business allows you to connect and manage up to four WhatsApp accounts simultaneously—no more logging in and out. Enjoy all the features of both WhatsApp Business Web and standard WhatsApp Web, and ask Business AI anything about your chats, so you can smoothly handle all your business and personal communications in one place.
Key features of Messenger Business include:
• SUPPORT FOR FOUR ACCOUNTS: Manage up to four WhatsApp accounts, including both WhatsApp Business Web and personal numbers, on one device. Give each account its own name and switch between them in a single tap. This feature is perfect for users with multiple business profiles or personal WhatsApp Web accounts, allowing for efficient communication management across all profiles.
• BUSINESS AI: Ask AI about your conversations. Find who you last talked to, what a customer asked, or what was agreed in a chat—across all your accounts at once. Get chat summaries, deep chat analysis and ready-to-send reply suggestions. Business AI can also search the web, check the weather and work with your calendar, reminders and contacts when you ask. Every source is shown with the answer, and no message is sent without your approval.
• AI-POWERED MESSAGING: Message Generator drafts on-brand messages in seconds, and Response Generator creates smart reply options instantly. With AI, you can automate repetitive messages and focus on meaningful conversations, boosting your productivity.
• PRIVACY-FIRST APPROACH: We prioritize your data security. Messenger Business never stores your WhatsApp password, and the chats Business AI reads stay on your device. On supported devices, Only Local AI keeps all AI processing on your iPad or iPhone. When a cloud model is used, only what is needed for your request is processed and nothing is kept after the session ends. You can turn AI features off at any time.
• ENHANCED PRODUCTIVITY: Messenger Business makes it easy to stay productive, enabling you to send messages to multiple contacts across different WhatsApp accounts. Our AI-powered features help create professional and timely responses, and the AI Usage screen shows your daily and monthly usage at a glance.
Messenger Business offers all the essential features you rely on—multimedia messaging, group chats, and more. Designed for iPad and iPhone, this app ensures that you can efficiently manage personal conversations and business inquiries alike.
Disclaimer: Messenger Business is a third-party app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by WhatsApp Inc.

bluejetty:00177582:ios.description:
This app features a comprehensive source of Erfan Keyhani Halgheh teachings founded by Mohammad Ali Taheri, for the purpose of human spiritual growth and Perfection.
This application provides access to the entire source materials of Erfan Keyhani Halgheh organized by categories. This new school of Erfan (spirituality) with over forty years of history is human-inclusive and leads to the positive transformation of human life through seeking Divine-Knowledge, raising the quality of knowledge, improving outlooks, and through correction of human’s existential software. 
At Taheri Academy, the theoretical and practical principles of this School are taught to those interested through lectures and Ettesāl (Link) to Halqehs. Currently, the Erfan Keyhani Halgheh Courses are offered at two distinct programs: 
Old Education Program: This is a partial introductory summary of Erfan Halgheh that is broadcast via Erfan Halgheh TV, academy website and it is also taught by Erfan Halgheh Masters (separately). 
New Education Program: This is a more comprehensive version of Erfan Halgheh at an intermediate level that is web-based and is offered through Taheri Academy website. 
The School of Erfan Keyhani Halgheh introduces and investigates the “Consciousness” and the “Intelligence” governing the universe. “Consciousness” and/ or “Intelligence” is one of the fundamental constituents of the universe that is neither matter nor energy. 
This school is comprised of the following sections:
1. Erfan Halgheh: consisting of the theoretical and practical concepts 
2. Faradarmani and Psymentology Complementary Medicines: Faradarmani in the field of physical health and Psymentology in the field of mental and psychological health and Human Existentiology
3. Consciousness: in the area of studying and application of the Intelligence governing the Cosmos
4. Sciencefact: scientifically proving the existence of the T-Consciousness, T-Consciousness Fields, and the Cosmic T-Consciousness Network (CCN)
5. T-Consciousness Cosmology: the study of the Cosmos based on Consciousness, from the beginning to the end of its current cycle of movement
6. Interuniversalism: the study of human’s status in the universe 
7. The Whole-viewing Management: Examination of the human and other organisms’ existential organization for the purpose of a more effective management 
8. Non-Organic Beings: the theoretical and practical study of these Beings and their role in human life
All resources of Erfan Keyhani Halgheh (excluding Taheri Academy courses) are made available to all interested individuals free of charge. The Faradarmani and Psymentology complementary medicines are also provided for free. There is only one exception which is that those conventional medicine practitioners who utilize these complementary medicines as part of their practice can choose to receive payment. Faradarmani and Psymentology complementary medicines offer Healing in the area of the body, mind, and psyche.

bluejetty:00125976:ios.name: PostureScreen Mobile
bluejetty:00125976:ios.summary: Attention chiropractors, physical therapists, athletic trainers, massage therapists, trainers and coaches: trade subjective visual impressions for camera-based measurements you can capture in seconds, repeat, compare and hand to the person
bluejetty:00125976:ios.description:
Attention chiropractors, physical therapists, athletic trainers, massage therapists, trainers and coaches: trade subjective visual impressions for camera-based measurements you can capture in seconds, repeat, compare and hand to the person in front of you.
PostureScreen Mobile is a professional documentation and education platform built on semi-automated, AI-assisted digitization of posture, movement, range of motion and body composition. Its measurement methods have been examined in multiple peer-reviewed studies demonstrating reliability and validity, and it has been used as a measurement tool in numerous published studies.
Used in practices, gyms, studios, corporate wellness programs and classrooms by professionals who document posture and movement.
NEW — PostureScribe.AI Ambient Scribe Module (USA Only)
An optional documentation assistant that drafts structured notes, narratives and client summaries from your client interaction history fused with captured measurements. You are the author: you review, edit and approve every word.
WHAT YOU CAN DOCUMENT
• Advanced posture documentation with markerless AI-assisted digitization
• Functional movement screens (squats, planks, push-ups, single-leg tests)
• Spinal & shoulder ROM using computer vision + accelerometer/gyroscopic sensor fusion
• Body composition with LeanScreen® — validated and reliable, examined alongside DEXA and BIA in a UCLA-led study
• Side-by-side comparative reports for progress tracking
• Patient-friendly & clinician-detailed PDF reports
• Remote capture using the RemoteScreen® app
• Metric/Imperial units
COMPREHENSIVE DOCUMENTATION SUITE — POWERED BY COMPUTER VISION
Postural Documentation (AP & Lateral)
• Automatic calculation of postural metrics from points you place or confirm
• CVA (left, right, average), gaze angle, thoracolumbar displacement, sagittal plane tangent angles, pelvic tilt and Q angle
• Semi-automated 2-view and 4-view reports, linear (mm) and angular (degrees)
• Editable templates for documentation, education or research workflows
Range of Motion & Mobility
• Cervical: flexion, extension, lateral flexion, rotation
• Thoracic/lumbar mobility and trunk motion
• Shoulder: abduction/adduction, flexion/extension, internal/external rotation
Movement Screening
• SquatScreen® (lateral, AP, PA, single-leg) and Push-Up Screen
PostureScreen records and displays what you digitize or confirm and what the gyroscope and accelerometers measure under your control. Where published reference ranges exist, it shows them beside your measurements and marks values above or below range — how the numbers compare, not what they mean or what to do about them. That judgment is yours, and it stays yours.
PURCHASE AND SUBSCRIPTIONS
Initial purchase includes 30 days Unlimited Assessment and Modules. After that, a monthly or annual Unlimited Assessment subscription is required to keep capturing new screenings.
Optional In-App Upgrades & 3rd-Party Integrations:
• PostureScribe.AI In-App upgrade subscription — documentation assistant, notes and narratives
• Cloud Services In-App upgrade subscription — RemoteScreen, secure backup and to share data between devices
• WebExercises® — integration
• 3D Practice® — integration
• Select EHR integrations and Google Drive integrations
INTENDED USE
PostureScreen Mobile is a documentation and educational tool for professionals. It is not a medical device and is not intended for the diagnosis, cure, mitigation, treatment or prevention of any disease or condition, and it does not provide medical advice or clinical recommendations. Professionals using the app remain solely responsible for interpreting any information it records and for every decision about care.
Cloud is optional; data is hosted on AWS in the USA.
Privacy: http://postureanalysis.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://www.postureanalysis.com/end-user-license-agreement.html
HIPAA & GDPR: https://www.postureanalysis.com/knowledge-base/hipaa-gdpr-regulations/

bluejetty:00062305:ios.description:
Want to get the desired band score in IELTS speaking fast and easily? 
No worries! Install the IELTS Speaking Assistant app now and get all necessary materials for efficient IELTS speaking practice: 
1) step-by-step instructions for effective speaking practice
2) all the real exam IELTS speaking questions that you'll be asked in your real IELTS speaking test
3) a rich collection of ideas which you can use to make relevant and extended answers regardless of your likes and dislikes, habits, cultural differences, and other factors 
4) ready-made answers to all the questions 
5) IELTS speaking progress chart (a printable pdf document which will help you control your progress)
How will you benefit from using IELTS Speaking Assistant?
• You will get fully prepared for your speaking test without wasting your time on searching for questions and ideas and model answers. Just learn everything that's in the app and you will never dry up in the middle of your speaking test
• Using the app, you will increase the efficiency of your IELTS speaking classes with a tutor to 100%
• During your IELTS speaking classes you will have a chance to focus on intonation instead of coming up with ideas to answer questions
• You will prepare for the speaking test anywhere, anytime
What makes IELTS Speaking Assistant different from the other apps for IELTS speaking? 
• new answers are added almost every day
• you get unique content that you won't find elsewhere
• the app has been created by experienced IELTS tutors according to the British Council test format 
• use one application instead of many websites, apps and books
Free account: 
• access to all real test IELTS speaking questions 
• access to vocabulary, ideas and answers in 3 topics in each part 
• the Complete Guide to IELTS Speaking (e-book)
• IELTS speaking progress chart (printable pdf)
Premium account: 
• access to all real test IELTS speaking questions 
• access to vocabulary, ideas and answers in ALL topics 
• the Complete Guide to IELTS Speaking (e-book)
• IELTS speaking progress chart (printable pdf)
IELTS Speaking Assistant offers 3 subscription options:
1-month subscription for $9.99
3-month subscription for $18.99
12-month subscription for $29.99
Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You will not be able to cancel the subscription once activated. Manage your subscriptions in Account Settings after purchase. 
Visit our website for more information: 
www.ielts-assistant.net 
If you have any questions, write to us:
support@ielts-assistant.com 
Privacy policy: https://virtualeducation.ee/privacy_policy.html 
Terms of use: https://virtualeducation.ee/ISA_terms_of_use.html

Ops! Here we go again. The house is a mess! The silly Dachshund is stuck in the duck float! And the English Shepherd can't pull his Paw out of the jar! The spoiled Pomeranian needs an urgent haircut - her fur got tangled and dirty! Oh no!! The mischievous pug tried to reach the honey but the bees stung him right in the nose! The clumsy Husky got tangled in the toilet paper!

Treat the puppies with love and compassion, help them get out of awkward situations and nurture them back to health.

the player can choose one pup at a time with randomly generated problems that he will need to choose the right tools to treat the pup.

Our family companions:

bluejetty:00042112:ios.name: CallHub
bluejetty:00042112:ios.summary: Use the CallHub Mobile App to make calls and send texts for the causes you support. Join phone banking and peer-to-peer texting campaigns and encourage people to take action from the comfort of your home or while on the go. You can aid vote
bluejetty:00042112:ios.description:
Use the CallHub Mobile App to make calls and send texts for the causes you support. Join phone banking and peer-to-peer texting campaigns and encourage people to take action from the comfort of your home or while on the go. You can aid voter identification, voter persuasion, GOTV, fundraising, and supporter mobilization efforts.
You can:
MAKE 3X MORE CALLS Maximise your productivity by skipping answering machines, bad numbers, and busy lines.
STREAMLINE CALL CONVERSATIONS Guide volunteers to the right section of the script depending on the survey response.
CALL PEOPLE WHEN THEY’RE MORE LIKELY TO PICK UP Schedule a time that’s more convenient for the people you call. 
RECEIVE INCOMING CALLS Route calls to ensure you don’t miss potential conversations
FAST PEER TO PEER TEXTING Autosend initial message so that volunteers only handle responses
ENGAGE IN 1:1 CONVERSATION VIA TEXTING Drive engagement with higher response rate than email
REPLY QUICKLY Create your own templated responses or utilize added templates for frequently asked questions
PERSONALIZE CONVERSATION Use personalized tags, emojis, surveys, and interaction history to personalize your contact’s experience
Fast Peer to Peer Texting Autosend
Other features include:
* Automated dialers to match every calling requirement
Make calls one at a time with Power Dialer, dial multiple numbers in one go with Auto Dialer or let our predictive algorithm connect callers to contacts instantly with Predictive Dialer.
* Bi-directional data sync with popular campaigning tools
CallHub connects to tools like NGPVAN, NationBuilder, Action Network and Salesforce to let you sync data in real-time.
* Monitor and record calls
Join live calls to guide training sessions and help maintain quality standards — or review call recordings at a later time.
*Drop pre recorded voicemails
Send voicemails when call is picked up by answering machines
* Survey types
Collect support data with multiple survey forms. You can also bring in surveys and events from connected CRMs.
CallHub is a SaaS software suite of voice and text communication tools that help organizations make mass communication more human. Our Voice and SMS software connect campaigns to their audience through Phone Banking, Peer to Peer Texting, Text Broadcast, Voice Broadcasting, and Text to Join software. Social impact organizations across 200+ countries with more than 30 million contacts use CallHub to identify, nurture and build relationships with supporters and beneficiaries.

bluejetty:00062211:ios.description:
The huge difference is that toddlers often lack the self-control and language skills to express their feelings. We are here to help them, to help you. Join this wonderful adventure where solving problems is easy and fun. 
Fun features:
* Learn to recognize and communicate emotions. 
* Learn to understand others' feelings. 
There are a lot of animals waiting for you: a friendly panda, a lovely penguin, a cute rabbit and a little dog. Join the fun with BabyBus.
___________
▶Design concepts：
We focus on inspiration, not just learning.
We focus on capacity-building, rather than a single cognition.
We focus on entertaining, rather than spoon-feeding teaching.
Take the baby bus, which is loaded with a happy childhood!
___________
▶The series introduction:
Baby Bus is the first trusted brand in early childhood educational software. The mobile applications are designed and developed specifically for preschoolers, and they are divided into two groups by age, the Starter Group for toddlers between the ages of 1 and 3 and the Prodigy Group for children between the ages of 3 and 6. 
The educational series in the Starter Group pursuits early learning by introducing games and songs tailored to your tots. The applications are aimed at improving their hand-eye coordination and nurturing their creativity from an early age.
___________

Feel free to tell us your thoughts on our games and services using the contact methods listed below:

bluejetty:00099416:ios.name: Forge Master – Idle RPG
bluejetty:00099416:ios.summary: Forge and equip weapons from different civilizations! Start by forging gear from the Stone Age. Then upgrade your anvil in order to forge gear from the Medieval Age. Work your way up to the Modern Age, Space Age and even up to the Quantum A
bluejetty:00099416:ios.description:
Forge and equip weapons from different civilizations! Start by forging gear from the Stone Age. Then upgrade your anvil in order to forge gear from the Medieval Age. Work your way up to the Modern Age, Space Age and even up to the Quantum Age! 
Are you ready for this adventure?
Forge, Upgrade, and Compete Across the Ages!
Step into an online world where progress never stops. In this competitive multiplayer game, you’ll forge weapons and armor from different civilizations, research new technologies, train pets, and climb the global leaderboard.
Forge Gear Through the Ages
Start in the Stone Age and forge your first weapons and armor in your anvil. As you play, upgrade your forge to unlock new materials, designs, and powerful equipment from the Medieval, Modern, Space, and Quantum Ages. Each upgrade takes you further through time and closer to the top of the competition.
Compete with Other Players
Challenge players from around the world in online battles. Equip your best gear, use your hero’s unique abilities, and test your strength against others. Every win earns rewards and helps you climb the global leaderboard — or represent your clan in team competitions.
Research and Progress

bluejetty:00185144:ios.description:
Application to mirror the screen and audio of your iPhone or iPad to a Chromecast 1, 2, 3, Ultra, or Google TV. You can mirror any app on your iPhone or iPad to your Chromecast.
In using the app, there will be a couple of seconds of latency (usually between 2 and 4). So this mirroring is not suitable for gaming. 
However, it is very suitable for watching movies, giving presentations, watching photos, and much more!
How the app works:
1. Make sure that your iPhone or iPad is connected to the same local network as your Chromecast. Don't use multiple VLANs or subnets.
2. Launch the Mirror for Chromecast app. It will start looking for your Chromecast devices on your local network. When a Chromecast is found, please select it.
3. Turn on notifications for this app. We will not spam you, but we will use this to let you know if your Chromecast is working correctly or not. So please, please allow it, otherwise when things don't work as they should, you are left in the dark.
4. Click on Start Mirroring to start mirroring on the Chromecast that is currently selected. After that, you can just go to any other app on your iPhone or iPad and the mirroring just continues to run.
5. To stop mirroring, there are two options. (1) click on the red top bar that you will see on your iPhone or iPad. (2) Go to the Mirror for Chromecast app and click on Stop Mirroring.
You can purchase the Mirror for Chromecast Pro Version through an in app purchase. 
The Pro Version has the following features:
1. Removes the watermark from the player on TV
2. Provides for free lifetime updates of the app
3. Enables sound even when the watermark is displayed on TV
* Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
* Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. 
* Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. 
* Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
* Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Feel free to check:
Our Terms of Use: http://bit.ly/ToU-MfC
Our Privacy Policy: https://www.airbeam.tv/privacy-policy/
Limitations and known issues:
DRM
Some apps block Screen Mirroring. This means that application developers can choose themselves if they want to block Screen Mirroring. For instance, Netflix, Disney and AppleTV+ have decided to block this.
There is a simple test that you can do to see if the app that you want to mirror has blocked Screen Mirroring:
Open that particular app and slide up Control Center on your iPhone/iPad. Then, click on Screen Recording and start recording the screen to your Camera Roll. Watch the app that you want to mirror and at some point stop the screen recording. Then go to your Photos app and watch the video that was recorded. If the recorded video shows the app you want to mirror, it works fine. If the video is empty, then the app you want to mirror does not allow Screen Mirroring.
About Screen Recording and Privacy
Even though there are notifications about Screen Recording, we don't record your screen into files and we don't send any content to a server. We only temporarily store data in memory, before it is streamed to TV. Upon streaming, the content is removed from memory.
Support:
If you have questions or would like to provide feedback, please send us an e-mail or chat with us on our Facebook page.
When you like the app, please don't forget to give it a positive rating! Thanks in advance from the AirBeamTV development team!
Please give us feedback by mailing to support@airbeam.tv
Chromecast is a trademark of Google LLC.

bluejetty:00094188:ios.description:
With Powergate, you can customize your vehicle's performance at any time! In just a few simple steps, you can adjust the parameters of the ECU directly from your smartphone. Getting ready for a day at the track? Reprogram your vehicle right in the paddock! Planning a road trip? Choose to reduce fuel consumption and make changes right from your home! With Powergate, there are no limits; unleash your tuning desires wherever and whenever you want, even to restore your vehicle to its original performance. It's all in your hands.
Connect your Powergate to your vehicle's OBD diagnostic port, pair it with your smartphone, and follow the Powergate App's flow to enjoy the fun! Powergate offers the world's largest list of compatible vehicles. Thanks to the Bluetooth connection to your Powergate device, you can manage modification operations like a true chiptuning professional. You can reprogram the engine ECU or the automatic transmission ECU - the choice is yours!
The Powergate App is a free service designed to work in conjunction with Powergate to manage all its functions directly from your smartphone. The Powergate App is produced by Alientech srl, a multinational company and a world leader in the chiptuning industry, ensuring quality and reliability.
Your favorite Powergate Manager will send you the modified files you need to customize your vehicle's performance directly in the app. Choose up to 4 configurations to increase your vehicle's performance, reduce fuel consumption, or simply have some fun turning heads. Additionally, your personal Powergate Manager will provide assistance when you need it.
The support section contains all the necessary information, organized by topics, to help you resolve any doubts at every stage of using the Powergate app.
Create your profile, connect Powergate to your vehicle, and dive into the passion of chiptuning!

Introducing Ninja, the quintessential app that redefines your educational and professional experience with its unparalleled capabilities. Ninja is a comprehensive tool that elevates your work to new heights, tailor-made for students, professionals, and anyone in need of a powerful assistant.

* Image Understanding for Homework Help: Stuck on a math problem or a complex science question? Simply snap a photo of your homework, and Ninja's AI will not only explain it but also guide you through solving it.

bluejetty:00168185:ios.description:
Tattoo AI: Your Go-To App for Creating Unique Tattoos Effortlessly! Whether you’re a tattoo enthusiast, a first-timer considering getting inked, or a tattoo artist looking for inspiration, Tattoo AI has everything you need. Describe what you want, pick a style, and preview it, before you book an appointment. 
HOW IT WORKS
- Describe your tattoo idea in your own words, or start from a style
- Choose a style: blackwork, fine line, Japanese (irezumi), tribal, lettering, realism and more
- Generate multiple concepts, refine the one you like, and preview it on your arm, hand, back or leg
- Export a clean, high-quality stencil to take straight to your tattoo artist
Key Features:
AI Tattoo Generator
Our AI tattoo generator is at the heart of Tattoo AI. Simply enter your ideas or themes, and our advanced AI will generate unique tattoo designs tailored to your preferences. It’s like having a personal tattoo artist in your pocket!
Diverse Style Options
Tattoo AI offers a wide variety of styles to suit any taste. Whether you prefer the timeless elegance of black & white tattoos, the intricate details of Japanese art, or the bold creativity of gaming characters, you’ll find the perfect design here.
Text-Based Tattoos
Looking for a meaningful quote or phrase to ink? Tattoo AI allows you to create stunning text-based tattoos with customizable fonts and styles. Simply input your favorite words, and our AI will transform them into beautifully designed tattoos.
Customization
Design tattoos for any part of youself with ease. Our app allows you to visualize tattoos, helping you see how the design will look before you commit.
High-Quality Tattoo Stencils
Turn your designs into high-quality tattoo stencils. Perfect for tattoo artists or anyone who wants to bring their digital designs to life.
Save and Share
Save your favorite designs and share them with friends or your tattoo artist.
Why You’ll Love Tattoo AI
• Get Inspired: Our AI tattoo generator gives you endless tattoo ideas. No more scrolling through generic images – get custom designs that reflect your style and personality.
• Personalized Designs: Every tattoo is unique. Tattoo AI creates personalized tattoo designs based on your inputs, making sure your tattoo is one of a kind.
• Time-Saving: Skip the hours of brainstorming and sketching. Let our AI do the heavy lifting, so you can focus on what matters – choosing and enjoying your new tattoo.
• Easy Visualization: Unsure about placement? Use our app to visualize how different designs look on. Make confident decisions about your tattoo’s size and location.
WHY PEOPLE CHOOSE TATTOO AI
- One app covers many styles (blackwork, fine line, Japanese, tribal, geometric, realism and lettering) instead of a single look
- Built for tattoos specifically, not a general image generator
- Fast, private, and made to hand straight to your artist

Your subscription will automatically renew unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time through your Apple Account Settings after purchase. If a free trial is offered, any unused portion of the trial period will be forfeited upon purchasing a subscription.

bluejetty:00099031:ios.summary:

Baby AI is an AI photo studio for parents. Add your baby's photos once, then ta
bluejetty:00099031:ios.description:
Turn 1–3 photos of your baby into studio-style portraits, themed photoshoots and short baby videos, with your little one's real features kept in every picture.
Baby AI is an AI photo studio for parents. Add your baby's photos once, then tap any template to see your baby as a newborn in a cozy wrap, a pumpkin-patch cutie, a little astronaut or a tiny chef. Most photos are ready in under a minute.
WHAT YOU CAN CREATE
• 150+ photo & video templates: newborn studio, holidays & seasons, fantasy, adventure, cute animals, family and monthly milestones (1–12 months)
• Themed photoshoots: a matching set of 6–9 photos in one go (Christmas Morning, Halloween Cuties, Under the Sea, When I Grow Up and more)
• Baby videos: turn a photo into a 5-second clip: a wave, a smile, a ride on a husky
• Future baby: add a photo of mom and dad to imagine what your child could look like, with a playful resemblance score. Just for fun, not a genetic or medical prediction.
• Family videos: mom, dad and baby together in one short animated clip
• Save in high quality, share with family, regenerate a result or turn your favorite photo into a video
LOOKS LIKE YOUR BABY
Baby AI is built to keep your baby's face: eyes, nose, cheeks and expression. Upload 2–3 clear, well-lit photos for the best likeness.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Add 1–3 photos of your baby (and, for future baby, one of mom and one of dad)
2. Pick a template or a photoshoot
3. Save, share or create more
YOUR PHOTOS STAY PRIVATE
• Your photos are used only to create the images and videos you ask for. They are processed by our AI service provider and are never used to train AI models or sold.
• Profile photos are kept so you can create again with one tap. Delete a profile at any time and its photos are deleted.
• Other uploaded photos are deleted automatically within 24 hours.
• Your results are not shown to other users.
COINS AND SUBSCRIPTION
Each creation uses coins, and the cost is shown before you create. A Baby AI subscription adds coins every week; coin packs are also available as one-time purchases.
• Plans: weekly (with a 3-day free trial for eligible new users) and yearly. Prices and included coins are shown in the app before you buy.
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase, or when the free trial ends.
• The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple ID account settings at any time.
• Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://sunmaredijital.net/baby/privacy
Terms of Use: https://sunmaredijital.net/baby/terms
Baby AI creates artistic, AI-generated images and videos for fun and keepsakes; they are not real photographs. Please upload only photos you have the right to use.

Put safety first with Famio.

What can you do with Famio
bluejetty:00178867:ios.description:
Put safety first with Famio.
Designed for your peace of mind, Famio keeps track of your loved ones so that you don't have to. Thanks to Famio, you will always know where they are and whether they need any help. 
What can you do with Famio?
- Locate your family members, kids, friends, and loved ones.
- See your loved ones' location history to make sure everyone is staying safe.
- Receive notifications when they arrive or leave home, work, or school.
- Create separate groups for family and friends.
- Get a heads up when someone's phone is low on battery, which can affect your communication.
Take your safety to the next level and focus on your day, knowing that everyone is doing well. Famio will keep you updated 24/7. 
Famio offers a variety of features that go beyond location tracking: 
- SOS Messages: Send notifications and your precise location to your chosen contacts with one tap.
- Map Reactions: Stay connected with quick reactions and emojis. 
- Private Chat: Share quick updates without leaving the app.
- Driving Mode: Build better driving habits and make sure your loved ones drive safely.
- Child Mode: Make Famio super easy and helpful for the little ones. 
- Data Breach Alerts: Get notified if your information appears in a known data breach.
Are you always worrying about your loved ones' safety and waiting for their texts? Famio helps you stay informed and connected throughout the day.
An extra safety measure never hurts. Download Famio now and stay in the loop 24/7!
Disclaimer
Please note that real-time location tracking relies on obtaining permission from another user to access their geodata.
The app offers the following subscription options:
- Weekly at $7.99 with a 3-day free trial; $29.99 per 12 weeks.
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current subscription period.
- The account is charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period.
- Subscriptions can be managed by the user and auto-renewal can be turned in the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
- The cost of renewal is equal to the value that Apple’s App Store Matrix determines as the equivalent of the subscription price in $USD.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://myfamio.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://myfamio.com/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00014316:ios.summary:
Investing.com is a real-time financial data app used by over 50 million investors and traders worldwide to track stock markets, monitor portfolios, research financial markets, and stay ahead of economic events. 
Whether you are a beginner
bluejetty:00014316:ios.description:
Investing.com is a real-time financial data app used by over 50 million investors and traders worldwide to track stock markets, monitor portfolios, research financial markets, and stay ahead of economic events. 
Whether you are a beginner building your first portfolio or an active trader watching real-time charts, Investing.com gives you the data, tools, and news to make informed financial decisions.
WHO INVESTING.COM IS FOR
• Investors building and monitoring portfolios
• Traders following real-time stock market movements
• Market researchers tracking stocks, ETFs, crypto & forex
• Users following financial news and events 
REAL-TIME MARKET DATA
Track live stock market data, prices, charts, and movements for 300,000+ instruments — stocks, ETFs, indices, commodities, currencies, bonds, crypto, and futures. Get real-time quotes and historical data for US markets including the Dow Jones, NASDAQ, and S&P 500; European indices including the FTSE 100, DAX, and CAC 40; and markets across Asia, Latin America, and the Middle East.
PORTFOLIO TRACKER
Build and monitor a personalised portfolio to see all your holdings in one place. Add stocks, ETFs, crypto, and other assets, then track performance, view profit and loss, and receive price alerts when your targets are hit.
ECONOMIC CALENDAR
Prepare for market-moving events with the Investing.com Economic Calendar. Track central bank decisions (Fed, ECB, Bank of England), GDP releases, inflation reports, jobs data, and earnings announcements — filtered by country, impact level, and date.
FINANCIAL NEWS & ANALYSIS
Stay informed with breaking financial news, expert market analysis, and earnings reports covering stocks, forex, commodities, and crypto. Set personalized news alerts so you never miss a story that matters to your portfolio.
ADVANCED CHARTS & TECHNICAL ANALYSIS
Analyse price movements with interactive charts, 100+ technical indicators, and drawing tools. Use candlestick, bar, and line charts across multiple timeframes to identify trends and support your trading decisions.
CUSTOM PRICE ALERTS
Set price alerts for any instrument and receive push notifications the moment your target is reached. Customise alerts for percentage moves, news triggers, or key economic events so you can act quickly when markets move.
INVESTING.COM PRO
Upgrade to Investing.com Pro for an ad-free experience, exclusive financial data, advanced stock screeners, extended historical data, deeper market analysis tools, and priority access to new features. A free version of the app is available with full access to core features.
WHAT YOU CAN TRACK
• Stocks, penny stocks & small-caps
• ETFs & mutual funds
• Crypto, including Bitcoin, Ethereum & altcoins
• Forex (170+ currency pairs)
• Commodities like gold, silver, oil & natural gas
• Bonds & government yields
• Global indices & futures
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Is Investing.com free? 
Yes. The app is free to download and use. Investing.com Pro is an optional paid subscription with additional features and an ad-free experience.
Can I track crypto with Investing.com? 
Yes. The app covers thousands of cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and altcoins, with real-time prices, charts, and news.
Does Investing.com have a stock screener? 
Yes. The app includes stock screening tools to filter equities by sector, market cap, technical signals, and fundamental metrics.
Is Investing.com a trading platform? 
No. Investing.com is a financial data and analysis app. Users cannot buy or sell financial instruments directly through the app.
Investing.com is a financial data and research platform used by investors and traders in over 200 countries. The app is available in 30+ languages.
Investing.com is not a trading platform. Users cannot trade financial instruments directly through the app. All investments carry risk, including loss of the full amount invested. This app is for informational purposes only and does not constitute financial advice.

Play with your legendary hero in intense kung fu and karate battles.
Face challenging tournaments and earn big rewards.
Execute fast combos to knock down challenger energy rapidly.
Battle against dangerous fighters in a stunning 3D fighting arena.
Experience intuitive and smooth touchscreen controls for seamless action gameplay.

bluejetty:00082550:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00082550:ios.description:
Welcome to SoBet — where social meets wagering, and strategy meets excitement.
Join competitive betting contests against real users and build your virtual bankroll over 7 days. The top performers earn real cash prizes. It’s not about luck — it’s skill, timing, and psychological edge.
-- What Is SoBet? --
Competitive Social Betting
With SoBet, betting becomes a game you play against others — not just against odds. When you enter one of our contests, you receive a virtual bankroll (i.e. play money). Over the next 7 days, you make your plays (sports, events, or other markets) and compete to have the highest ending virtual balance. At the close of each 7-day cycle, top users win real cash rewards.
Unlike traditional gambling, you’re not just wagering — you’re competing in strategy, prediction, and risk management against fellow bettors.
-- Why You’ll Love SoBet --
Level playing field. Everyone starts with the same virtual bankroll — the contest is decided by skill, not by how much you can spend.
Real cash prizes. Winners don’t just get bragging rights — they walk away with actual cash rewards.
Social competition. See how you stack up against others. Leaderboards, rankings, and rivalry add excitement.
Responsible play. Since you’re dealing with virtual bankrolls during each contest, you never risk your own cash while competing.
-- How It Works (In 3 Simple Steps) --
Subscribe & join a contest. $25.99 / month for a SoBet Edge Subscription
Make plays (place bets) over 7 days. Use your virtual bankroll to place bets across sports or events.
Win or lose — compete smart. At the end of 7 days, the top users win cash prizes proportional to their standings.
-- Key Features --
Weekly Tournaments — Fresh contests start weekly so there’s always a new chance to compete.
Leaderboard & Rankings — View real-time standings, see how far ahead or behind you are, and stay motivated.
Notifications & Alerts — Get push notifications on big moves, odds changes, and contest deadlines.
Analytics Dashboard — Track your historical performance: ROI, win/loss ratio, bet types, and more.
Secure & Fair — Our platform ensures fairness, transparency, and robust security of all contest operations.
Customer Support — We’re here to help — support, FAQs, and live chat to assist you.
-- Who Is This App For? --
SoBet appeals to users who:
- Love the thrill of prediction, sports, or event-based betting
- Enjoy social and competitive environments
- Want a low-risk way to test wagering strategies
- Are curious to compare their performance against others
- Want fun and meaningful engagement (with prizes) — not just passive odds-based betting
-- Why It’s Unique (Our Value) -- 
- Not conventional gambling. You never risk your own funds while placing bets — you use a virtual bankroll within the contest.
- Contest-based. The experience is structured around performance, strategy, and head-to-head competition.
- Real rewards. Winning is rewarded — not just bragging rights.
- Community & social energy. Rivalry, rankings, and momentum drive engagement.
-- Things to Know -- 
- Subscription required to enter contests.
- Real cash prizes. Payouts are handled per contest rules (terms apply).
- Multiple contest sizes. Some contests may require a minimum number of participants.
- Fair play policy. We monitor for fraud, collusion, or abuse. Violations may result in disqualification.
- Legal & compliance. Compatible with local laws and regulations—only available in jurisdictions where permitted.
- Cash prizes available for US Citizens only

bluejetty:00061423:ios.name: Morni مرني
bluejetty:00061423:ios.summary: The everyday process of driving your car can often result in unforeseen issues that put you in the position to need assistance, be it with a flat tire, accident, or transport of your vehicle. In such situations, it is critical that the help
bluejetty:00061423:ios.description:
The everyday process of driving your car can often result in unforeseen issues that put you in the position to need assistance, be it with a flat tire, accident, or transport of your vehicle. In such situations, it is critical that the help you would need arrives in a timely fashion, at a consistent level of quality, and a fair price. Morni has responded to this challenge in the GCC’s most difficult market, KSA, through the deployment of a suite of mobility solutions accessible via an intuitive app that is designed around optimizing the driving experience of all vehicles regardless of who owns it, where it came from or its condition.
Morni is the largest transport and Roadside Assistance network in the Middle East, you can request our services when needed or subscribe to our annual membership, which allows you to request services free of charge when needed through one-time payment for a full year
You can use and request our services through the application when there is no internet connection in your device, you do not need to describe your location to the service provider, all you have to do is contact our customer service and provide them with the three words appearing in the application, your location will be recognized and identified by the three words and the closest service provider will come to you .
Our services are available 24/7 inside and outside cities in all regions of Saudi Arabia.
Morni offers:
- Towing services of all types: Regular Tow truck, hydraulic Flatbed Tow truck, Covered Flatbed Tow truck and Winch Tow truck.
- Tire services: Spare tire installation, tire repair in station, tire change in station, tire repair on site, tire inflation on site.
- Battery services: battery jump-start and battery replacement..
- Fuel delivery service, a fuel or diesel delivery service inside or outside cities.
- Locksmith Services: unlock vehicle doors in case of lockdown the vehicle, this is only unlocking the locked vehicle, doesn’t include any programming neither replacement key nor key repair
- Between cities is for transport vehicles from outside the city into inside city anywhere in middle east 
- Accident Full-Solution Services: provides a comprehensive full solution service, where the vehicle is taken care of from the accident scene and complete the Damage Assessment until it is delivered to the client's home.
How to start:
- Download the app .
- Sign up with your phone number.
- Request your service.
Payment methods:
- Cash.
- Credit card /Apple Pay/mada.
Disclaimer:
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

The Shiv Puran is one of eighteen Puran genre of Sanskrit texts in Hinduism and part of the Shaivism literature corpus.It primarily centers around the Hindu god Shiva and goddess Parvati, but references and reveres all gods.
It was written by Rishi Ved Vyas. It consists of 24,000 Shlokas in 7 Samhitas.
The red flavor of our values and traditions could be experienced by studying Vedas, Upanishads, and Puranas. Our day-to-day conduct, thinking, and beliefs reflect our cultural values. Puranas. have contributed a great deal in preserving these principles and values.
Puranas are as important as Vedas. They have made it easier for a common man to understand the divine knowledge explained by Vedas

bluejetty:00073373:ios.name: Word Farm Adventure
bluejetty:00073373:ios.summary:
Save the farm animals on this Free word scrabble puzzle game!
In our new challenging best word game for adults and kids, you will word swipe your way into becoming the beloved hero of the ranch.
Unlike other word puzzle games, Word Farm Adv
bluejetty:00073373:ios.description:
Save the farm animals on this Free word scrabble puzzle game!
In our new challenging best word game for adults and kids, you will word swipe your way into becoming the beloved hero of the ranch.
Unlike other word puzzle games, Word Farm Adventure is not just about solving cross word puzzles for Free - it is also about enjoying a great story, while fighting the evil forces that want to destroy the farm.
So let’s get going, fast - the animals need you at your best!
In this free challenging words game, you will:
● Solve crossword puzzles, word find challenges, word scramble missions, word swipe scrabble quests and more challenges for your brain. Free Online learning!
● Unveil the story of Perry the Parrot, Rex the Dog and the other farm heroes on their adventure in this awesome word puzzle game!
The farm needs a hero, and you are that hero. Get ready to save the farm!
Game Highlights
It's time to skip those ordinary scrabble games and crossword puzzles. Join us on the farm! The Word Farm Adventure game offers so much more than a word search!
To solve each level, you need to complete a word puzzle by connecting the letters and spelling words that fit perfectly into the crossword puzzle blocks. 
After you solve each puzzle of words, you'll be rewarded with coins and shovels to help you complete missions and restore the farm to its glory days. Once you help the animals rebuild the farm and prove to uncle Jeff that it's worth saving, you'll venture on to the county fair.
Long ago, the animals built the fair to prove to uncle Jeff that the farm could turn a profit. The fair was once a place filled with fun and laughter, but it's been neglected. It's up to you to redesign and renovate the fairgrounds so everyone can come back and enjoy the atmosphere.
Now, like any farm, there's always more work to be done! The once extravagant farmhouse is in complete disrepair, but it doesn't have to stay that way. Keep solving word puzzles and earning shovels so you can redesign the farmhouse and make it beautiful again! Continue playing and you’ll keep discovering more of the story and additional areas of the farm that need your help. 
Every level of this exciting free word game is more challenging than the last so get ready for hours of fun with your new farm animal friends. 
If you're ever having trouble solving a word puzzle, tap on the fireworks or hammer to reveal puzzle letters, or blast away an entire word with dynamite. Don't forget that the magic wand is also only a tap away.
Visit the farm for daily puzzles. Don't miss out on each month's special event because you'll never experience the same one twice! This brings a whole new challenge to puzzle word games! 
If you enjoy word search games, crossword puzzles, or scrabble, you'll love playing Word Farm Adventure. 
Download and play the best word game today! 
--
Word Farm Adventure is free to play, though some in-game items can also be purchased for real money. If you don't want to use this option, simply turn it off in your device's restrictions menu.
Questions? Contact our Tech Support by sending an email to support@wordfarmadventure.com
Terms of use: https://braingames.net/terms-of-service
Want to enjoy exclusive bonuses, meet other word puzzle enthusiasts and dive deeper into the Van Der Farm story? Let’s connect!

bluejetty:00126053:ios.description:
Realtime traffic information anytime & anywhere with İBB CepTrafik!
You can access realtime information via your mobile phone at any time with the İBBCepTrafik application (service of the Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality). İBBCepTrafik is an application that allows you to get realtime information with traffic cameras and heat map developed by Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality. You can access speed information received from traffic sensors of Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality, traffic camera images and traffic announcements published by the Transportation Management Center with this application.
You can make traffic-related notifications, share your opinions and suggestions through the application. For further information please contact us via uym@ibb.gov.tr 
In İBBCepTrafik application, traffic camera images are shown with 3 pictures that are played sequentially and changed every minute in order to minimize the internet traffic of users. You can add cameras and car parks to your favorite lists for the ones that you use frequently.
You need to zoom in/out on the map to see traffic sensors, more cameras, signalized junctions, charging stations, Isbike or car parks.
You can use the application over wireless and mobile operators. Data traffic that will occur during the usage of the application through operators may be deducted from your internet package or may be charged by your operators if you do not have an internet package. Make sure you are using the latest version

Forgot your bike, miss the bus, flat tire? Find a nextbike near you with the nextbike app and start cycling right away - available at any hour and with just a few easy steps.
To hire a bike, simply select it, scan the QR code or enter the bike number - then off you go! You can return the bike at one of our stations or anywhere in the Flexzone. Our app provides you with everything you need at a glance. You can easily find the right return location with the map function or manage your customer account. You can also use the app to redeem vouchers, discover news, give feedback, or contact our customer service.
With your account, you can use nextbikes in over 300 locations throughout Europe including KVB-Rad in Cologne, WienMobil Rad in Vienna, Stadtrad Innsbruck, Styr & Ställ in Götheburg, nextbike Berlin, and many more. You can see whether your city is included using the map function in the app or find all the cities with a nextbike system on our website at www.nextbike.de.

bluejetty:00016326:ios.summary:
Best way to experience why dog is a man’s best friend!

bluejetty:00016326:ios.description:
Best way to experience why dog is a man’s best friend!
Let us introduce you Duddu, our new dog! He is a super nice dog who lives in a wonderful world full of fun and adventure. Become a part of Duddu’s everyday life and build a true friendship with your new virtual pet. 
• As a new pet owner, you are responsible for feeding, putting asleep, entertaining and looking after your own dog in his lovely house. In addition, you will have to take care of your scout dog in the wild as well!
• Oops, Duddu needs doctor's help! Welcome to the animal hospital full of doctor games to give your dog the treatments he needs. Appoint him to the right vet’s office to solve a problem with fleas, stomach, leg, virus or wound. You can also pick some medicinal herbs and cook potions at the outdoor fireplace.
• It’s time for a spa adventure! Have fun in the pool or sauna with Duddu’s pet friends and enjoy preparing smoothies or coloring mandala in the cutest pet beauty salon. 
• Visit every corner of Duddu’s world and all of his friends, too. Take him on vacation to the sunny island with a cosy hammock and coconut palms. Customize your own pirate ship and teach Duddu different tricks at the dog school. Enjoy dancing in the club, exercising in the gym, painting and doodling in the gallery or playing drums and piano in the music centre. Have fun exploring the colorful world where the Sun goes up and down whenever you want. 
• Play over 30 different mini games and earn some coins or other goods. Have fun playing Bubble Shooter, Solitaire, Archer, Pirate Battle, Brick Breaker, Block Puzzle, Treasure Island, Moto Racer, Fruit Connect, Space Explorer, Hen Farm, various cooking games and many others. Go shopping and buy some unique pieces of furniture, food and clothes or customize your pirate ship and your house. 
• Complete daily challenges to learn about the dog’s habits and become a master of achievements to get some extra rewards. Check your mailbox everyday, you may find a surprise gift from a special friend.
This game is a guaranteed fun for people of all ages. Taking care of a pet gives you a sense of responsibility and loyalty. All you need to begin the fun journey is your own Duddu dog!
This game is free to play but certain in-game items and features, also some of those mentioned in game description, may require payment via in-app purchases which cost real money. Please check your device settings for more detailed options regarding in-app purchases.
The game contains advertising for Bubadu’s products or some third parties which will redirect users to our or third-party site or app.
This game is certified compliant with the Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) by FTC approved COPPA safe harbor PRIVO. If you would like to know more about the measures we have in place for protecting child privacy please see our policies here: https://bubadu.com/privacy-policy.shtml .
Terms of service: https://bubadu.com/tos.shtml

bluejetty:00134930:ios.description:
Pinellas County residents – looking for a way to connect with your county? The official Pinellas County app is your connection to events, news and activities that can benefit you. From getting the latest county news to finding a quiet beach oasis, there’s something for everyone. 
Report issues in your neighborhood, get status updates on their resolution and vote on issues that are important to maintaining your community’s well being. 
The app’s intuitive interface puts the power in your hands to explore, check out informative videos and become an active participant in your county’s government. Get the latest news on what’s happening in the county, find out when the next Board of County Commissioners meeting will be held and watch the latest videos from PCC-TV.
Find your evacuation zone, discover new biking trails and learn about the county’s award-winning parks and preserves. Get info on where – and when – to catch the next bus, what you can recycle and so much more. Link to the county’s calendar to be sure to never miss another fun county event. 
Connect directly with Pinellas County on Twitter, Facebook, YouTube and other social media platforms.

* تصبح اللعبة أحلى عندما تكون جماعية حيث يتعاون اللاعبين مع بعضهم لمعرفة الكلمات *

bluejetty:00150754:ios.summary:
Robot Math: Infinite Challenges, Fun Learning
Robot Math is an innovative and entertaining mobile learning app designed specifically for children. Through a series of carefully crafted math challenges, it aims to spark kids' interest and e
bluejetty:00150754:ios.description:
Robot Math: Infinite Challenges, Fun Learning
Robot Math is an innovative and entertaining mobile learning app designed specifically for children. Through a series of carefully crafted math challenges, it aims to spark kids' interest and enthusiasm for learning.
Learn Through Play, Grow in Challenges
In Robot Math, children can control their own robot and compete against AI opponents by solving math problems to win. This edutainment approach not only makes learning fun but also helps kids grow through challenges, enhancing their problem-solving skills.
Play at Your Own Pace, Unlimited Challenges
Robot Math grows with your child, so every kid can enjoy the fun of learning and challenge themselves. Whether a math beginner or a little mathematician, every child can find content suited to their level.
Over 3000 Problems, Covering a Wide Range of Topics
The app includes over 3000 problems, spanning six core math areas from basic arithmetic to complex geometry. The diverse problem design suits children of different ages and abilities.
Dynamic Difficulty Adjustment, More Efficient Learning
As children progress, the difficulty of the problems automatically adjusts, ensuring that the challenges remain stimulating while avoiding frustration from excessive difficulty.
36 Cool Robots, New Experiences
Kids can unlock and collect up to 36 different robots, each with unique designs and features, adding to the fun of exploration and a sense of achievement.
18 Amazing Scenes, Explore Unknown Worlds
From mysterious forests to modern cities, the app features 18 different scenes, each providing unique backgrounds and challenges, making the learning journey full of surprises and discoveries.
Achievement System, Motivating Progress
Through a rich achievement system, every step of a child's learning progress is recognized and rewarded, motivating them to persist in learning and helping them see their growth and build confidence.
Robot Math is more than just an app; it’s a new learning tool. Through innovative interaction, it allows children to enjoy the fun while mastering practical math knowledge. Its design philosophy is to make math learning intuitive, fun, and challenging, truly capturing children’s attention and inspiring their learning potential.
Download Robot Math now and start your child's math adventure, exploring the infinite possibilities of knowledge together!
Features:
• Unlimited challenges to keep young mathematicians going!
• Combines problem-solving with battles for a fun learning experience
• Over 3000 problems covering six different math areas, including arithmetic and geometry
• Dynamic difficulty balancing system to ensure appropriate challenge levels
• 36 cool robots to collect and challenge difficult problems with
• 18 different scenes to explore in this wonderful world
• Achievement system to record learning milestones
• Playable without internet connection
• No third-party ads
About Yateland:
Yateland's educational apps ignite the passion for learning through play among preschool children worldwide. We stand by our motto: "Apps that children love and parents trust." For more information about Yateland and our apps, please visit https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy:
Yateland is committed to protecting user privacy. To understand how we handle these matters, please read our complete privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.

bluejetty:00031558:ios.summary: Welcome to Tangled Line 3D: Knot Twisted, a world where your strategic skills get tested in an enthralling puzzle adventure! Get ready to dive into a mesmerizing universe, untangling intricate rope puzzles within a certain number of moves,
bluejetty:00031558:ios.description:
Welcome to Tangled Line 3D: Knot Twisted, a world where your strategic skills get tested in an enthralling puzzle adventure! Get ready to dive into a mesmerizing universe, untangling intricate rope puzzles within a certain number of moves, and freeing the ends of the ropes.
This game is packed with captivating visuals and intuitive mechanics that make you feel like a master untangler. Your mission? To unravel the knots and free the ends of the ropes with calculated and precise moves. Be strategic, plan your moves wisely, and conquer the game level by level.
Each level presents you with a unique tangled rope puzzle that's like stepping into a maze of knots, loops, and twists. Move the rope in various directions by simply swiping or tapping on the screen. Your challenge? To figure out the smartest moves to untangle the knots and free the trapped ends of the rope. Get ready to flex your brain muscles and embark on this exciting quest! 
How to play Tangled Line 3D: Knot Twisted:
- Select the rope judiciously to avoid creating additional knots.
- Move the rope by tapping and draping, aiming to position it correctly and unravel all knots.
- Organize the ropes sequentially for optimal results.
- Think quickly and deploy strategic planning as you guide the ropes to disentangle the knots.
- Successfully unknot all the ropes to triumph.
Features of Tangled Line 3D: Knot Twisted:
- The gameplay of "Tangled Line 3D: Knot Twisted" is a true work of art, offering an aesthetic and engaging experience.
- Relish in the beautifully rendered 3D graphics and a vivid color palette.
- Test your skills with more than 100 levels, featuring diverse maps and escalating challenges.
- Personalize your play with an array of unique rope skins.
- Encounter octopus pins, each presenting a distinctive twist to the puzzles.
- Navigate the intricate interplay between keys and locks, adding depth to the puzzles.
Download Tangled Line 3D: Knot Twisted now and demonstrate your mastery over the most daunting of knots, one level at a time. Embark on an unforgettable puzzle-solving odyssey!

bluejetty:00122346:ios.description:
The WUNC Radio App: 
The WUNC Radio App allows you to listen to WUNC, pause and rewind the live audio, and view the program schedule for WUNC all at once! You can explore and listen to On Demand content whenever you want, share stories with your friends and wake up to WUNC with the alarm clock!
Live Streaming
• DVR-like controls (pause, rewind, and fast forward). You can pause the live stream to have a conversation and pick up right where you left off! Or rewind to catch a comment you just missed!
• Listen to live streams from WUNC even while traveling! Start the app and your favorite station starts playing.
• Integrated program schedules for WUNC streams! 
• One click stream switching – flip over to the program you noticed on another stream with a single click.
• Listen to WUNC Radio in the background while browsing the web or catching up on your emails!
On Demand
• Access WUNC programs easily and quickly.
• DVR-like controls. Pause, rewind and fast forward your program with ease. 
• When listening to programs, individual segments (when available) are listed so you can review and choose one or listen to the entire program.
• The WUNC App displays the web page associated with the program or program segment you are listening to On Demand so you can explore for more information.
Additional features
• Easily share stories and programs with family and friends via the “Share” button.
• A built in Sleep Timer and Alarm Clock allows you to go to sleep and wake up to your favorite station.
The WUNC Radio App is brought to you by the people at The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill and Public Media Apps. We work to provide our valued listeners with great solutions to find what you want, when you want it, on whatever device you have!
Please support WUNC by becoming a member today!

bluejetty:00180801:ios.name: Roland Zenbeats
bluejetty:00180801:ios.summary:
Find your creative flow. 
Roland Zenbeats is a music creation app that keeps you in an effortless artistic flow. Get started on any mobile device or computer platform and make music anywhere, anytime. With its collection of both modern an
bluejetty:00180801:ios.description:
Find your creative flow. 
Roland Zenbeats is a music creation app that keeps you in an effortless artistic flow. Get started on any mobile device or computer platform and make music anywhere, anytime. With its collection of both modern and legendary sounds, Zenbeats brings Roland’s history of innovation into a new, mobile-friendly format. 
The app is your instrument. 
Whether you’re an emerging musician or an established producer, Zenbeats makes music creation easy. Build beats, compose full multitrack songs, or sample the world around you. Wherever you are, no matter what platform or device you use, capture your creative spark with Zenbeats. 
A universe of sound. 
Whatever style you’re working in, you’ll find the perfect sounds for your tracks in Zenbeats. From vintage Roland JUNO and JUPITER tones to diverse and progressive instruments for any genre, the 14,000-plus presets will keep your compositions fresh and exciting. 
ZR1. The future of beatmaking. 
Our ZR1 Drum Sampler is a new kind of beat machine. Fast track your percussive prowess with seminal Roland drum tones from the TR-808, TR-909, and more. 
Sample your world. 
Sample and import directly into ZR1’s drum pads with the touch of a finger. 
Edit. Refine. Repeat. 
Tweak your sounds with advanced editing functionality. Manipulate and chop your one-shot samples with the slice editor and quickly crop and fade as needed. 
ZC1. Roland’s most advanced synth engine. 
ZC1 is a versatile synthesizer based on our powerful ZEN-Core Synthesis System. The free version features signature Roland synth sounds and 60 presets, driven by a sleek touch-based interface with an X/Y pad for easy sound manipulation. When you unlock the full version of ZC1, you get over 900 additional presets and 90 MFX that are all fully compatible with ZENOLOGY and supported ZEN-Core hardware. 
Deep MIDI and audio power at your fingertips. 
The Zenbeats ecosystem offers tons of time-saving tools to document, edit, and refine your ideas. Quickly capture and play sounds with LoopBuilder, or use a traditional approach with the Timeline view for more sophisticated arrangements and automation options. 
Fresh sounds. Fresh ideas. 
The Zenbeats Store is loaded with sounds, loops, and creative tools to expand your musical palette. Whatever sound or genre you’re chasing, the Zenbeats Store has you covered. All sounds are royalty-free and new tones are added weekly. 
Mix and match. 
With the full-screen mixer view, it’s simple to control volume, filter, panning, and more. Browse through 17 native FX, EQ tracks to your liking, and balance all your audio, instrument, and drum tracks from one streamlined location. 
Easy Sharing. 
Effortless transfers between phone, tablet, and desktop make the distance between you and your finished product even shorter. Use Google Drive™ or OneDrive to share Zenbeats projects and export stems and loops for use in other DAWs. 
Free, unlock, or membership. The choice is yours. 
With the free version of Zenbeats, you get music production essentials plus the ability to purchase additional loops and presets in the Zenbeats Store. When you’re ready to expand, there are three ways to unlock the full Zenbeats experience: 
Platform Unlock: Get all features, instruments, and effects on your favorite platform. Platform Unlock includes over 2,500 presets, loops, and sounds (2.5 GB), ZR1 Drum Sampler with sampling/editing, ZC1 Synthesizer with 90 built-in MFX, full SampleVerse modular synthesizer with editor, VST/AU/AUv3 support, and unlimited mixing and export capabilities. 
Max Unlock: Get all features, instruments, effects, and store packs on all platforms and devices. 
Roland Cloud Membership: All Roland Cloud membership tiers include Zenbeats Max Unlock. All memberships come with Zenbeats Max Unlock for as little as $2.99 USD per month.

bluejetty:00162750:ios.description:
＼利用者数100万人突破／ ケアミーは生理・PMSの共有アプリです。 生理予定日や生理開始日、生理前後の不調、妊娠しやすい期間などをLINEでパートナーに共有できます。あなたの代わりにケアミーがLINEでパートナーに通知するので、自分の言葉でうまく説明できない、心理的にうまく伝えられないという方におすすめです。目障りな広告がなく、ストレスを感じずにご利用いただけます。通知には産婦人科医監修の基礎知識も添えられているので、パートナーに生理やPMSのことを理解してもらえます。
◇◇ ケアミーの特徴 ◇◇
1.生理やPMSをパートナーのLINEに通知
生理予定日や生理開始日、生理前後の不調、妊娠しやすい期間などををパートナーに知ってもらうことができます。あなたの代わりにケアミーがパートナーのLINEに通知するので、生理やPMSのことを自分の言葉でうまく説明できない、心理的にうまく伝えられないという方におすすめです。
2.広告なし
目障りな広告がなく、ストレスを感じずにご利用いただけます。
3.カレンダーをパートナーに共有
パートナーにケアミーをインストールしてもらうことで、パートナーも生理予定日や生理前後の不調、妊娠しやすい期間をカレンダーで確認できます。
4.カラダやココロの変化を自動で通知
生理前後に起こるカラダやココロの変化を自動で通知することができます。自分からはパートナーにうまく伝えられないことを、あなたの代わりにケアミーが通知します。
5.生理やPMSの基礎知識を自動で通知
パートナー共有のLINE通知には産婦人科医監修の生理やPMSの基礎知識が添えられているので、生理やPMSのことをパートナーに理解してもらえます。
6.PMSを予測してカレンダーに表示
不調が起こりやすい期間を予測してカレンダーに表示します。そろそろ生理前かな？と思ったらアプリを開くだけでパッとチェックできます。不調が起こりやすい期間をあらかじめ知ることができるので、スケジュール調整にも役立ちます。
7.生理前後の不調を予測
今日や明日以降に起こりやすい不調がわかります。
◇◇ ケアミーの機能一覧 ◇◇
・生理やPMSのことを共有できる「パートナー共有」
・生理予定日やPMSの期間を確認できるカレンダー
・PMSによるカラダの症状やココロの状態をワンタップで記録
・PMSの症状をセルフチェックできる振り返り機能
・生理周期とPMSの記録にもとづいた医師監修の記事
・生理周期にあわせた医師監修のアドバイス
・選べるテーマカラー
・ダークモード対応
・生理不順のセルフチェックができる
・ピルの服用記録ができる「ピル服用モード」
・妊娠しやすい日がわかる「妊活モード」
・生理がきたらワンタップで入力
・過去の生理期間や周期を一覧で見れる
・生理周期と生理日数の平均日数がわかる
・次の排卵予定日がわかる
・今日の妊娠の可能性をわかりやすく表示
・基礎体温を記録してグラフでチェックできる
・生理日入力を忘れないようにする通知機能
・万が一のときも安心、アプリの画面ロック機能
・スマホの機種変更時も安心の、データ引き継ぎ機能
◇◇ 監修医師 ◇◇（一部）
産婦人科専門医

bluejetty:00015340:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00015340:ios.description:
Ride ’N Rampage: Colossal Chase™
Accelerate into adventure on land, sea, and air! Ride ’N Rampage: Colossal Chase™ game lets you race a rugged off-road vehicle, pilot an attack boat, or fly a helicopter! When you spot the dinosaur you’re after, launch a dart to capture a sample of her DNA and then race on to complete your mission!
CATCH THE LATEST IN-APP VIDEOS
Viral video alert! Don’t miss the latest videos posted in the Jurassic World Play App. You can watch epic dinosaur battles, awesome music videos, exciting scene re-creations, and so much more!
MORE DINOSAURS TO COLLECT
There are even more species to discover! Scan the Tracking Code under the feet on your Mattel Jurassic World dinosaur toy to unlock the dinosaur and add it to your collection. You can hear your dinosaurs roar, watch them move, and check out fun facts and dinosaur video clips. Your previous collections are still available, too!
DINOSAUR IN YOUR WORLD
Watch out! You can now bring dinosaurs into your world through AR! With the Dinosaur in Your World feature, you can watch a Mattel Jurassic World dinosaur appear right in front of you in AR. Don’t be afraid to scale and rotate the dinosaur or tap it to hear a booming roar! Plus, you can snap a picture and save the Dinosaur in Your World photo to your device.
RESCUE ’N RELEASE MISSION GAME
Ready to rescue? The Rescue ’N Release Mission game enables you to rescue a dinosaur and go directly to the Rescue Lab to help care for the dinosaur and bring it back to health. With the right tools, techniques, and treatments, you can take care of the dinosaur and release it into the correct habitat.
TRACK ’N CATCH CHALLENGE GAME
Look out for some tracking action! With the Track ’N Catch Challenge game, you’re in the driver’s seat and able to track and rescue dinosaurs. Remember, you’ll want to be sure to collect tracking badges along the way to help you gain energy on your ride! Plus, once you catch the dinosaur, you can head to the Rescue Lab to help heal your dinosaur and release it back to its proper habitat.
SOUND ADVENTURE ACTIVITY
More Mattel Jurassic World dinosaurs have arrived! And with the Sound Adventure, you can create your own soundtrack to enhance your play experience and be your own dinosaur DJ. Pick from three different sound themes and record and play your own audio masterpiece to keep the Jurassic World fun and excitement going!
